facts.zh: 大喬木，高 15–25 米，樹冠寬大
5 月至 12 月
森林。亦廣泛栽培。

items.en: Large tree, 15–25 m, with an ample crown.
items.zh: 大喬木，高 15–25 米，樹冠寬大。

items.en: Deep grey.
items.zh: 深灰色。

items.en: Branches often bear pendulous aerial roots.
items.zh: 枝上常有下垂氣根。

items.en: Leathery; elliptic, ovate-elliptic or obovate. Base cuneate. Apex bluntly apiculate. Margin entire.
items.zh: 革質；橢圓形、卵狀橢圓形或倒卵形。基部楔形。先端鈍而具短尖。全緣。

items.en: Blade 4–8 × 3–4 cm. Petiole stout, 5–10 mm, glabrous.
items.zh: 葉片 4–8 × 3–4 厘米。葉柄粗，5–10 毫米，無毛。

items.en: Basal veins 3. Lateral veins 3–10 pairs.
items.zh: 基出脈 3 條。側脈 3–10 對。

items.en: Yellowish or reddish, paired or solitary in the leaf axils, obovoid, 6–8 mm, without peduncles. Basal bracts 3.
items.zh: 黃或紅色，成對或單生於葉腋，倒卵形，6–8 毫米，無花序柄。基部苞片 3。

ecology.en: Native. Common in Hong Kong, and also widely cultivated.
ecology.zh: 原生。香港常見，亦廣泛栽培。

ecology.en: Southwest, south to southeast China; south and southeast Asia to Australia.
ecology.zh: 中國西南、南至東南；南亞及東南亞至澳洲。

photos.en: Park tree with a curtain of pendulous aerial roots.
photos.zh: 公園大樹，下垂氣根成簾。

photos.en: Deep grey bark and a column of aerial roots.
Leathery leaves and sessile axillary figs.
photos.zh: 革質葉，無柄的腋生隱頭花序。

photos.en: Cuneate bases and bluntly apiculate tips.
photos.zh: 楔形葉基，先端鈍而具短尖。
樹冠上的無柄隱頭花序。

photos.en: A hanging shoot: cuneate bases and blunt tips.
photos.zh: 下垂的枝，楔形葉基，先端鈍。

facts.zh: 小喬木，高可達 3 米
全年
紅樹林沼澤邊緣。

items.en: Small tree to 3 m. Bark smooth, reddish brown.
items.zh: 小喬木，高可達 3 米。樹皮平滑，紅褐色。

items.en: Oblong to obovate-oblong. Base broadly cuneate. Apex rounded or obtuse. Veins inconspicuous.
items.zh: 長圓形至倒卵狀長圓形。基部闊楔形。先端圓或鈍。葉脈不明顯。

items.en: Petiole 1–1.8 cm. Blade 5–10 × 2.5–4 cm.
Sepals white, lanceolate, 1.2–1.6 cm, reflexed in fruit. Petals white, bifid.
items.zh: 萼片白色，披針形，1.2–1.6 厘米，結果時反折。花瓣白色，二裂。

items.en: Ovoid, 1.0–1.5 cm, with persistent reflexed sepals.
items.zh: 卵形，1.0–1.5 厘米，宿存反折的萼片。

items.en: Viviparous, 12–20 cm, acuminate at the apex.
items.zh: 胎生，長 12–20 厘米，先端漸尖。

photos.en: Flowering tree at the edge of flooded mangrove.
photos.zh: 水淹紅樹林邊緣的開花植株。

photos.en: Oblong leaf with a rounded apex.
An open flower, with the stamens.
Buds and flowers on a leafy shoot.
Hypocotyls still hanging on the tree.
Bracteoles at the base of the flower.

facts.zh: 灌木，高 1.5–3 米
全年。高峰通常在 8 月至 10 月。

facts.en: Disturbed forests, streamsides, thickets on low hills, roadsides.
facts.zh: 受干擾的森林、溪邊、低丘灌叢、路旁。

items.en: Shrub, 1.5–3 m tall.
Stems, branches, petioles and pedicels densely covered with spreading bristles up to 8 mm.
items.zh: 莖、枝、葉柄和花梗密被開展的刺毛，長可達 8 毫米。

items.en: Opposite. Lanceolate to elliptic-lanceolate. Base obtuse to rounded. Apex acuminate. Margin entire. Strigose on both surfaces.
items.zh: 對生。披針形至橢圓狀披針形。基部鈍至圓。先端漸尖。全緣。兩面被糙伏毛。

items.en: Five-nerved: midvein plus two pairs of lateral primary veins.
items.zh: 5 條基出脈：中脈加兩對側生主脈。

items.en: Terminal, usually 5-merous, solitary or 3–5 in cymes. Petals purple, broadly obovate, apex emarginate.
items.zh: 頂生，通常 5 數，單生或 3–5 朵組成聚傘花序。花瓣紫色，闊倒卵形，先端微凹。

items.en: 10, rarely 8 or 12, dimorphic.
items.zh: 10 枚，罕為 8 或 12，二型。

items.en: Calyx tube 1–2 cm, densely covered with spreading red bristles.
items.zh: 萼管長 1–2 厘米，密被開展的紅色刺毛。

items.en: Fleshy capsule, 1.5–2.2 × 1.5–2 cm, dehiscing irregularly at maturity.
items.zh: 肉質蒴果，1.5–2.2 × 1.5–2 厘米，成熟時不規則開裂。

ecology.en: Disturbed forests, streamsides, thickets on low hills, roadsides.
ecology.zh: 受干擾的森林、溪邊、低丘灌叢、路旁。

ecology.en: Long spreading bristles on the stem and hypanthium, not the appressed scales of Melastoma malabathricum.
ecology.zh: 莖和花被管具長而開展的刺毛，不是野牡丹那種貼伏的鱗片。

photos.en: Erect shrub on a trail, among ferns.
photos.zh: 小徑上的直立灌木，生於芒萁之間。

photos.en: Five purple petals and dimorphic stamens.
photos.zh: 五片紫色花瓣，雄蕊二型。

photos.en: Young fruits with long spreading bristles.
photos.zh: 幼果，具長而開展的刺毛。

photos.en: The flower, with the dimorphic stamens.
A young leaf, the veins flushed.

facts.en: Tree to 45 m; bark red-brown, irregularly scaly
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 45 米；樹皮紅褐色，不規則鱗片狀

facts.en: Pollinating April–May. Seed maturing October–December of the second year.
facts.zh: 傳粉期 4 月至 5 月。種子於翌年 10 月至 12 月成熟。

facts.en: On hills. Also widely planted in the countryside.
facts.zh: 丘陵。亦廣泛植於郊野。

items.en: Tree to 45 m. Crown broadly pyramidal or umbrella-like. Bark red-brown, irregularly scaly and flaking.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 45 米。樹冠闊金字塔形或傘形。樹皮紅褐色，不規則鱗片狀並剝落。

items.en: 2 per bundle, rarely 3. Slender, slightly twisted, 10–18 cm, with a persistent sheath.
items.zh: 每束 2 枚，稀 3 枚。細長，微扭曲，長 10–18 厘米，基部具宿存葉鞘。

items.en: Pendulous, ovoid to ovoid-cylindric, 4–7 × 2.5–5 cm, chestnut brown at maturity.
items.zh: 下垂，卵形至卵狀圓柱形，4–7 × 2.5–5 厘米，成熟時栗褐色。

ecology.en: Native. Common in Hong Kong, and also widely planted in the countryside.
ecology.zh: 原生。香港常見，亦廣泛植於郊野。

ecology.en: Areas south of the Changjiang River.

photos.en: Hillside tree with a red-brown trunk.
photos.zh: 丘陵上的樹，樹幹紅褐色。

photos.en: Two slender needles in a bundle, and brown winter buds.
photos.zh: 每束兩枚細長針葉，冬芽褐色。

photos.en: Candles of the new shoot, with young needles.
photos.zh: 新梢的蠟燭狀嫩枝，帶幼針葉。

facts.zh: 喬木或小喬木
花期 6 月至 8 月。果期 10 月至 12 月。
森林。

items.en: Tree or small tree. Branches greyish brown or reddish brown, glabrescent.
items.zh: 喬木或小喬木。小枝灰褐或紅褐色，漸變無毛。

items.en: Elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 7–13 × 3–6 cm. Base cuneate. Apex acuminate. Margin crenulate to crenulate-serrate.
items.zh: 橢圓形至長圓狀橢圓形，7–13 × 3–6 厘米。基部楔形。先端漸尖。邊緣具圓齒至圓齒狀鋸齒。

items.en: White, 2–3 cm, in short terminal racemes. Petals 5, obovate.
items.zh: 白色，直徑 2–3 厘米，排成短的頂生總狀花序。花瓣 5，倒卵形。

items.en: Subglobose, 1–1.5 cm.
items.zh: 近球形，直徑 1–1.5 厘米。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Hunan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Taiwan.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、湖南、江西、浙江、福建、台灣。

photos.en: Leaf with a crenulate margin and cuneate base.
The lower leaf surface, before flowering.
A red flush of young leaves.

facts.en: Evergreen shrub or tree, up to 10 m
facts.zh: 常綠灌木或喬木，高可達 10 米

facts.en: Flowering August–September. Fruiting December–February of the following year.
facts.zh: 花期 8 月至 9 月。果期 12 月至翌年 2 月。
森林。

items.en: Evergreen shrub or tree, up to 10 m. Young parts tawny tomentose, later glabrescent.
items.zh: 常綠灌木或喬木，高可達 10 米。幼時黃褐色絨毛，後漸無毛。

items.en: Digitately compound, generally 6–8-foliolate. Leaflets elliptic or ovate-elliptic, 7–17 × 3–7.5 cm, margin entire.
items.zh: 掌狀複葉，通常 6–8 小葉。小葉橢圓形或卵狀橢圓形，7–17 × 3–7.5 厘米，全緣。

items.en: Many-flowered umbels in a large terminal panicle. Petals 5.
items.zh: 多花的傘形花序組成大型頂生圓錐花序。花瓣 5。

items.en: Globose, 3–4 mm.
items.zh: 球形，直徑 3–4 毫米。

ecology.en: Southern China to Japan, the Philippines, Vietnam and India.
ecology.zh: 華南至日本、菲律賓、越南及印度。

photos.zh: 圓錐花序上的乳白色傘形花序。
傘形果序上的綠色球形果。

photos.en: The flower: five petals and five stamens.

photos.zh: 圓錐花序上的成熟果實。

photos.en: A panicle of buds, the axes tawny.
photos.zh: 花蕾組成的圓錐花序，花軸黃褐色。

facts.zh: 灌木，高 1–2 米

facts.en: Flowering April–May. Fruiting late summer to early autumn.
facts.zh: 花期 4 月至 5 月。果期夏末至秋初。
灌叢。

items.en: Shrub, 1–2 m. Young branchlets greyish pubescent.
items.zh: 灌木，高 1–2 米。幼枝灰色短柔毛。

items.en: Leathery, elliptic to obovate, 3–8 × 1–4 cm. Grey tomentose abaxially. Reticulate veins conspicuous.
items.zh: 革質，橢圓形至倒卵形，3–8 × 1–4 厘米。背面灰色絨毛。網脈明顯。

items.en: Purplish red, 2–4 cm. Petals 5. Stamens red, 7–8 mm.
items.zh: 紫紅色，直徑 2–4 厘米。花瓣 5。雄蕊紅色，長 7–8 毫米。

items.en: Purplish black when mature, urceolate, 1.5–2 × 1–1.5 cm.
items.zh: 成熟時紫黑色，壇狀，1.5–2 × 1–1.5 厘米。

ecology.en: Southern China to India, Southeast Asia and the Ryukyu Islands.
ecology.zh: 華南至印度、東南亞及琉球群島。

photos.en: Flowering shrubs on a grassy ridge.
Five magenta petals and red stamens.
photos.zh: 五枚洋紅色花瓣，雄蕊紅色。

photos.en: A young fruit, with five calyx lobes.
A young urceolate fruit, and the five calyx lobes.
photos.zh: 幼嫩的壇狀果，五枚萼裂片。

photos.en: An open flower among young fruits.
The lower leaf surface: grey tomentum and netted veins.
An open flower, with the leaf.

facts.zh: 大型木質藤本
花期 4 月至 6 月。果期 6 月至 11 月。
森林。

items.en: Large woody climber. Leaves pinnately 3-foliolate.
items.zh: 大型木質藤本。羽狀三出複葉。

items.en: Terminal leaflet elliptic, ovate or somewhat obovate, 3–16 × 2–6 cm, apex caudate-acuminate.
items.zh: 頂生小葉橢圓形、卵形或略倒卵形，3–16 × 2–6 厘米，先端尾狀漸尖。

items.en: Axillary or on old branches, 20–38 cm. Corolla greyish white. Keel 7.5–8.7 cm.
items.zh: 腋生或生於老枝，長 20–38 厘米。花冠灰白色。龍骨瓣長 7.5–8.7 厘米。

items.en: Loriform, 30–45 × 3.5–4 cm, densely rusty-pubescent, slightly constricted between the seeds.
items.zh: 條形，30–45 × 3.5–4 厘米，密被銹色短柔毛，種子間微縊縮。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Sichuan, Jiangxi, Fujian.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、貴州、四川、江西、福建。

photos.en: Pendulous greyish-white racemes on the woody climber.
photos.zh: 木質藤上的下垂灰白色總狀花序。

photos.en: Open greyish-white flower, with a long keel.
photos.zh: 開放的灰白色花，龍骨瓣長。

photos.en: Flowers borne on the old wood.
A leaf with three caudate leaflets.

facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木；莖粗而略肉質
花期 4 月至 12 月。果期 7 月至 12 月。
沙質及岩石海岸。

items.en: Shrub or small tree. Stem thick and more or less succulent.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木。莖粗而略肉質。

items.en: Crowded towards the branch tips, obovate-oblong to spathulate, 10–22 × 4–8 cm. Margin entire.
items.zh: 聚生於枝端，倒卵狀長圓形至匙形，10–22 × 4–8 厘米。全緣。

items.en: Usually white, 20–22 mm. The five lobes spread as a half-split fan.
items.zh: 通常白色，長 20–22 毫米。五裂片開展成半邊扇形。

items.en: Ovoid or globose, 8–12 mm, crowned with the enlarged calyx lobes.
items.zh: 卵形或球形，直徑 8–12 毫米，頂端冠以增大的萼裂片。

ecology.en: Southern China to Japan, the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia and Australia.
ecology.zh: 華南至日本、菲律賓、馬來西亞、印度尼西亞及澳洲。

photos.en: Thick stem and crowded leaf tips.
White fruits with the fan flowers.
Fruits, with the calyx still on.
The face of the fan flower.
Flowers and fruits on the same shoot.

facts.en: Evergreen tree, 5–15 m; bark dark grey
facts.zh: 常綠喬木，高 5–15 米；樹皮深灰色
花期 3 月至 5 月。果期 9 月至 10 月。
低地森林。

items.en: Evergreen tree, 5–15 m. Bark dark grey.
items.zh: 常綠喬木，高 5–15 米。樹皮深灰色。

items.en: Elliptic to obovate, 5–10 × 2–5 cm. Lateral veins 15–20 on each side, slender and subparallel.
items.zh: 橢圓形至倒卵形，5–10 × 2–5 厘米。側脈每邊 15–20 條，纖細而近平行。

items.en: Yellowish green. Calyx shallowly campanulate, with 5 lobes. Petals 10, scale-like. Stamens 10.
items.zh: 黃綠色。萼筒淺鐘形，裂片 5。花瓣 10，鱗片狀。雄蕊 10。

items.en: Capsule obovoid, 2–3 × 2 cm. Seed dark brown, with a tail-shaped appendage about 2 cm.
items.zh: 蒴果倒卵形，2–3 × 2 厘米。種子深褐色，具長約 2 厘米的尾狀附屬物。

photos.en: Leaf with many subparallel lateral veins.
photos.zh: 葉具多條近平行的側脈。

photos.en: Yellowish-green flower with five calyx lobes.
Seed hanging with its tail-shaped appendage.
photos.zh: 種子連尾狀附屬物懸垂。

photos.en: Roots at the base of the trunk.
Stamens, and scales in the throat.
The face of the flower, with the stamens.

facts.en: Tree, up to 30 m; all parts strongly camphor-scented
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 30 米；全株有濃烈樟腦氣味
花期 4 月至 5 月。果期 8 月至 11 月。
村落附近的林中。亦有栽培。

items.en: Tree, up to 30 m tall. All parts strongly camphor-scented.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 30 米。全株有濃烈樟腦氣味。

items.en: Alternate. Petiole slender, 2–3 cm, glabrous. Blade ovate-elliptic, 6–12 × 2.5–5.5 cm, base broadly cuneate to rounded, apex acute, margin entire, subleathery. Triplinerved, with domatia in the axils of the secondary and tertiary veins.
items.zh: 互生。葉柄細，2–3 厘米，無毛。葉片卵狀橢圓形，6–12 × 2.5–5.5 厘米，基部闊楔形至圓形，先端急尖，全緣，近革質。離基三出脈，二級脈與三級脈腋內有腺窩。

items.en: Yellowish white, ca. 3 mm. Panicles or cymes axillary, 3.5–7 cm. Stamens 9, filaments pubescent.
items.zh: 黃白色，約 3 毫米。圓錐花序或聚傘花序腋生，3.5–7 厘米。雄蕊 9，花絲被毛。

items.en: Ovoid or subglobose, 6–8 mm in diam., purplish black when mature.
items.zh: 卵形或近球形，直徑 6–8 毫米，成熟時紫黑色。

ecology.zh: 村落附近的林中。亦有栽培。

ecology.en: Native. Common in Hong Kong, and also widely cultivated.
ecology.zh: 原生。香港常見，亦廣泛栽培。

ecology.en: Widely distributed in south to southwest China; Vietnam, Korea and Japan.
ecology.zh: 中國南至西南廣泛分布；越南、韓國及日本。

photos.en: Buds at the node, and a purple petiole.
Five leaves, lower surface, with domatia.
photos.zh: 五片葉的背面，具葉腋窩。
開放的花，直徑約 3 毫米。

photos.en: An open flower and buds on the panicle.
photos.zh: 圓錐花序上的開放花與花蕾。

photos.en: Immature green fruits on a triplinerved leaf.
photos.zh: 三出脈的葉上，未成熟的綠色果實。

photos.en: Yellowish-white flowers in an axillary panicle, with the leaf.
photos.zh: 腋生圓錐花序，花黃白色，連葉。

photos.en: A bract opening around the enclosed buds.

facts.en: Shrub or tree, 1–10 m; bark yellowish white
facts.zh: 灌木或喬木，高 1–10 米；樹皮黃白色
花期 4 月至 5 月。果期 6 月。
灌叢或次生林。

items.en: Shrubs or trees, 1–10 m tall. Bark yellowish white, glabrous.
items.zh: 灌木或喬木，高 1–10 米。樹皮黃白色，無毛。

items.en: Petiole 2–5 mm. Blade elliptic, narrow-elliptic, ovate-oblong or rarely subovate, 3–11 × 1.5–4 cm. Base cuneate, rarely rounded. Apex acute, shortly acuminate or slightly obtuse. Lateral veins slightly obvious on both surfaces.
items.zh: 葉柄 2–5 毫米。葉片橢圓形、狹橢圓形、卵狀長圓形，稀近卵形，3–11 × 1.5–4 厘米。基部楔形，稀圓形。先端急尖、短漸尖或稍鈍。側脈兩面稍明顯。

items.en: Red, ca. 1 cm in diam. Cymes axillary or extra-axillary, 1–5-flowered. Stamens usually united into 3 bundles, 4–8 mm. Glands 3, alternate with the staminal bundles, conic, 2–3 mm.
items.zh: 紅色，直徑約 1 厘米。聚傘花序腋生或腋外生，有花 1–5 朵。雄蕊通常合生為 3 束，長 4–8 毫米。腺體 3，與雄蕊束互生，圓錐狀，2–3 毫米。

items.en: Elliptic, 8–12 mm, with a persistent calyx. Seeds 6 mm, winged on one side.
items.zh: 橢圓形，8–12 毫米，具宿存萼。種子 6 毫米，一側有翅。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi and southern Yunnan; Indochina, Thailand, Myanmar, the Philippines and Indonesia.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西及雲南南部；中南半島、泰國、緬甸、菲律賓及印度尼西亞。

photos.en: Elliptic leaves on a short petiole.

photos.zh: 紅色花，直徑約 1 厘米。

photos.en: A red flower, face on, with stamen bundles.
photos.zh: 紅色的花，正面，雄蕊成束。

photos.en: Yellow glands on the face of the flower.
A deep red flower with white stamens.
Stamens of the red flower, at finger scale.
photos.zh: 紅色花的雄蕊，以手指作比例。

photos.en: Spent capsules, and the lower leaf surface.
A flower closing, the sepals around the bud.
Capsules with the calyx still attached.

facts.zh: 常綠喬木，高可達 40 米
花期 4 月至 5 月。果期 8 月至 10 月。

facts.en: Lowland forests and streamsides. Often cultivated.
facts.zh: 低地森林及溪邊。常有栽培。

items.en: Evergreen tree, up to 40 m. Branchlets glabrous.
items.zh: 常綠喬木，高可達 40 米。小枝無毛。

items.en: Papery, palmately 3(–5)-foliolate. Petioles 8–20 cm. Leaflets ovate, elliptic or obovate, 7–15 × 4–8 cm. Base broadly cuneate to obtuse. Apex acute or caudate-acuminate. Margin denticulate, 2–3 denticles per cm.
items.zh: 紙質，掌狀 3（–5）小葉。葉柄 8–20 厘米。小葉卵形、橢圓形或倒卵形，7–15 × 4–8 厘米。基部闊楔形至鈍。先端急尖或尾狀漸尖。邊緣具細齒，每厘米 2–3 齒。

items.en: Axillary panicles, pendent. Male panicles 8–13 cm; sepals 5. Female panicles 15–27 cm. Ovary smooth, glabrous, 3–4-locular. Styles 3–4, linear, entire.
items.zh: 腋生圓錐花序，下垂。雄花序 8–13 厘米，萼片 5。雌花序 15–27 厘米。子房平滑，無毛，3–4 室。花柱 3–4，線形，全緣。

items.en: Globose or subglobose, 6–13 mm in diam., brownish. Seeds oblong, ca. 5 mm.
items.zh: 球形或近球形，直徑 6–13 毫米，褐色。種子長圓形，約 5 毫米。

ecology.en: Lowland forests and streamsides. Often cultivated in gardens or as a roadside tree.
ecology.zh: 低地森林及溪邊。常栽培於花園或作行道樹。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Henan, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian and Taiwan; widely distributed in Southeast Asia, Malesia and Australia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、四川、陝西、河南、湖北、湖南、江西、安徽、江蘇、浙江、福建及台灣；東南亞、馬來群島及澳洲廣泛分布。

photos.en: Five sepals of the male flower.
Female flowers, with three or four styles.
Young green fruits, and the bark.
photos.zh: 幼嫩的綠色果實，連樹皮。

photos.en: A trifoliolate leaf, with a red flush.

facts.en: Tree or shrub, 3–15 m; brown stellate tomentum
facts.zh: 喬木或灌木，高 3–15 米；被褐色星狀絨毛
花期 7 月至 10 月。果期 11 月至 12 月。
疏林及灌叢。

items.en: Tree or shrub, 3–15 m. Branchlets, petioles and inflorescence brown-stellate-tomentose.
items.zh: 喬木或灌木，高 3–15 米。小枝、葉柄及花序被褐色星狀絨毛。

items.en: Alternate, slightly peltate. Petioles 2–15 cm. Blade ovate, ovate-triangular or rhombic, 5–15 × 3–10 cm. Base cuneate or broadly cuneate. Apex long-acuminate. Margin undulate, subentire, 2-lobed or sparsely toothed. Grey-yellow- or white-tomentose when young, glabrous in age. Veins 5, basal.
items.zh: 互生，稍盾狀。葉柄 2–15 厘米。葉片卵形、卵狀三角形或菱形，5–15 × 3–10 厘米。基部楔形或闊楔形。先端長漸尖。邊緣波狀、近全緣、2 裂或疏生齒。幼時被灰黃或白色絨毛，老時無毛。基出脈 5。

items.en: Terminal, racemose or paniculate. Male inflorescence 10–20 cm; stamens 50–60. Female inflorescence 5–25 cm. Stigma 2–3 mm, plumose.
items.zh: 頂生，總狀或圓錐狀。雄花序 10–20 厘米，雄蕊 50–60。雌花序 5–25 厘米。柱頭 2–3 毫米，羽毛狀。

items.en: Oblate, 1–1.5 cm in diam., brown-stellate-tomentose and sparsely spiny. Spines soft, 4–5 mm.
items.zh: 扁球形，直徑 1–1.5 厘米，被褐色星狀絨毛並疏生軟刺。刺柔軟，4–5 毫米。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Fujian and Taiwan; Southeast Asia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、福建及台灣；東南亞。

photos.en: A capsule split open, with black seeds.
A male raceme, and rhombic leaves.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1.5–4 米
花期 12 月至 2 月。果期 10 月至 12 月。

facts.en: Sea coasts, mangroves and muddy flats.
facts.zh: 海岸、紅樹林及泥灘。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–4 m, much branched. Branchlets terete, glabrous.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1.5–4 米，多分枝。小枝圓柱形，無毛。

items.en: Alternate. Petiole 5–10 mm. Blade obovate or elliptic, 3–10 × 2–4.5 cm, leathery, glabrous. Base cuneate. Apex rounded or emarginate. Margin entire, slightly recurved. Many minute pores on both surfaces. Lateral veins 7–11 pairs.
items.zh: 互生。葉柄 5–10 毫米。葉片倒卵形或橢圓形，3–10 × 2–4.5 厘米，革質，無毛。基部楔形。先端圓或微凹。全緣，稍反卷。兩面有許多細孔。側脈 7–11 對。

items.en: Umbels terminal, axillary or leaf-opposed, many-flowered. Flowers white. Corolla lobes ovate to lanceolate, apex acute, reflexed.
items.zh: 傘形花序頂生、腋生或與葉對生，多花。花白色。花冠裂片卵形至披針形，先端急尖，反折。

items.en: Cylindric, curved, falcate or crescent-shaped, 5–8 cm, acuminate at the apex.
items.zh: 圓柱形，彎曲，鐮狀或新月形，5–8 厘米，先端漸尖。

ecology.en: Sea coasts, mangroves and muddy flats.
Hainan, Guangdong, Fujian and Guangxi; India, Malaysia, the Philippines, Sri Lanka, Vietnam and Australia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、福建及廣西；印度、馬來西亞、菲律賓、斯里蘭卡、越南及澳洲。

photos.zh: 白色傘形花序，裂片反折。

photos.en: Flowers, and glands on the leaf.
The shrub, with roots at the base.
A leaf, and the scar at the node.

facts.zh: 常綠喬木；幼枝被白色鱗秕
花期 10 月至 11 月。
海岸。

items.en: Evergreen tree. Branchlets white-lepidote when young.
items.zh: 常綠喬木。幼枝被白色鱗秕。

items.en: Petioles 1–2 cm. Leaves leathery, oblong-lanceolate, elliptic or ovate, 10–20 × 5–10 cm. Base obtuse. Apex acute or obtuse. Margin entire. Densely silvery-lepidote abaxially.
items.zh: 葉柄 1–2 厘米。葉革質，長圓狀披針形、橢圓形或卵形，10–20 × 5–10 厘米。基部鈍。先端急尖或鈍。全緣。背面密被銀色鱗秕。

items.en: Panicles axillary, many-flowered. Flowers red-brown. Calyx campanulate, 4–6 mm.
items.zh: 圓錐花序腋生，多花。花紅褐色。萼鐘形，4–6 毫米。

items.en: Ripe carpels woody, yellow-brown, nut-like, ovoid, ca. 6 × 3.5 cm, with a strong, almost winged keel along the outer edge.
items.zh: 成熟心皮木質，黃褐色，堅果狀，卵形，約 6 × 3.5 厘米，外緣有一條近翅狀的強龍骨。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan and Taiwan; Japan, the Philippines, Southeast Asia, East Africa and Australia.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、海南及台灣；日本、菲律賓、東南亞、東非及澳洲。

photos.en: Woody fruit with a keeled outer edge.
Leaves green above and silvery below.
A flower, and a young fruit.
The lower surface, silvery with scales.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 常綠喬木，高 2–5 米
花果期 1 月至 9 月。

facts.en: Littoral muddy swamps and mangrove forests.
facts.zh: 海岸泥沼及紅樹林。

items.en: Evergreen tree, 2–5 m. Branchlets stout, glabrous.
items.zh: 常綠喬木，高 2–5 米。小枝粗，無毛。

items.en: Alternate, papery to subleathery. Petioles stout, 1.5–3 cm, with 2 glands at the apex. Blade elliptic or broad-elliptic, 4.5–10 × 3–5 cm, glabrous. Base obtuse or broadly cuneate. Apex acute, the tip blunt. Margin entire or more or less crenulate.
items.zh: 互生，紙質至近革質。葉柄粗，1.5–3 厘米，先端有腺體 2。葉片橢圓形或闊橢圓形，4.5–10 × 3–5 厘米，無毛。基部鈍或闊楔形。先端急尖，尖端鈍。全緣或多少具圓齒。

items.en: Racemes axillary. Male racemes 3–4.5 cm. Male flowers with 3 sepals and 3 stamens, the stamens usually exceeding the sepals.
items.zh: 總狀花序腋生。雄花序 3–4.5 厘米。雄花萼片 3，雄蕊 3，雄蕊通常長於萼片。

items.en: Globose, 7–8 × ca. 10 mm, trisulcate.
items.zh: 球形，7–8 × 約 10 毫米，具 3 溝。

ecology.en: Littoral muddy swamps and mangrove forests.
Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi and Taiwan; the Philippines, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand, India, Sri Lanka, Australia and the Pacific Islands.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西及台灣；菲律賓、越南、柬埔寨、泰國、印度、斯里蘭卡、澳洲及太平洋島嶼。

photos.en: Elliptic leaves on a stout petiole.
A male raceme, each flower with three stamens.
photos.zh: 雄花序，每朵花三枚雄蕊。

photos.en: Male racemes among the elliptic leaves.
Glands at the node, and a stout petiole.
Alternate leaves, and lenticels on the twig.
The base of the tree on the mud.
Leaves and flowers in the canopy.

facts.en: Shrub or small tree, 1–4 m, with aerial roots
facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1–4 米，具氣根
花期 5 月至 8 月。果期 1 月至 10 月。

facts.en: Sandy beaches. Also cultivated in gardens.
facts.zh: 沙灘。亦栽培於花園。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, 1–4 m. Stem branched, with aerial roots.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1–4 米。莖分枝，具氣根。

items.en: Aggregated at the stem tip, leathery, loriform, usually more than 1 m × 2–5 cm. Margin and the abaxial midrib with strong upward spines. Apex long-caudate.
items.zh: 聚生於莖頂，革質，帶形，通常長逾 1 米、寬 2–5 厘米。邊緣及背面中脈有向上的硬刺。先端長尾狀。

items.en: Male inflorescence of several spikes, 4–8 cm. Female inflorescence terminal, globular.
items.zh: 雄花序由數個長 4–8 厘米的穗狀花序組成。雌花序頂生，球形。

items.en: Pendent, red, yellow to orange, of 40–80 drupes. Drupe obconical, ca. 4 cm, truncate, angular.
items.zh: 下垂，紅色、黃色至橙色，由 40–80 枚核果組成。核果倒圓錐形，約 4 厘米，截形，有棱。

ecology.en: Sandy beaches, or cultivated in gardens.
Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Fujian and Taiwan; tropical Asia to Australia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、福建及台灣；熱帶亞洲至澳洲。

photos.en: A branched tree, with aerial roots at the base.
photos.zh: 分枝的喬木，基部有氣根。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Woody liana, to 10 m or longer
facts.zh: 木質藤本，長可達 10 米或更長
花期 2 月至 6 月。

facts.en: Sunny edges of forests and thickets.
facts.zh: 林緣向陽處及灌叢。

items.en: Woody liana, to 10 m or longer. Stems brownish, lenticellate. Young branchlets pubescent, glabrous when older.
items.zh: 木質藤本，長可達 10 米或更長。莖褐色，具皮孔。幼枝被毛，老時無毛。

items.en: Petiole 3–12 mm. Blade ovate to obovate or narrowly elliptic, 2–10 × 1–4.5 cm, papery, glabrous or sparsely pubescent abaxially.
items.zh: 葉柄 3–12 毫米。葉片卵形至倒卵形或狹橢圓形，2–10 × 1–4.5 厘米，紙質，無毛或背面疏被毛。

items.en: Cymes paniculate, terminal and axillary. Sepals narrowly oblong, 2–5 mm, spreading or reflexed. Corolla white; tube dilated at the middle, 5–10 mm; lobes obovate, as long as the tube. Stamens included.
items.zh: 聚傘花序排列成圓錐狀，頂生及腋生。萼片狹長圓形，2–5 毫米，開展或反折。花冠白色；冠筒中部膨大，5–10 毫米；裂片倒卵形，與冠筒等長。雄蕊內藏。

items.en: Linear, 10–25 cm × 3–10 mm. Seeds oblong, 1.5–2 cm, coma 1.5–4 cm.
items.zh: 線形，10–25 厘米 × 3–10 毫米。種子長圓形，1.5–2 厘米，種纓 1.5–4 厘米。

ecology.en: Sunny edges of forests and thickets.
East, central, south and southwest China, Shanxi, Shaanxi and Xizang; Japan and Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 中國東、中、南及西南，山西、陝西及西藏；日本及越南。

photos.en: Ovate to elliptic leaves, lower surface.
photos.zh: 卵形至橢圓形葉的背面。

photos.en: The liana on a tree trunk.
An open flower, the lobes star-shaped.
A mass of flowers on the vine.

reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 常綠無刺灌木，高 1–3 米
花期 4 月至 8 月。果期 5 月至 12 月。
山溝及山坡灌叢。

items.en: Evergreen, unarmed shrub, 1–3 m tall, glabrous throughout, or young shoots pulverulent.
items.zh: 常綠無刺灌木，高 1–3 米，全株無毛，或幼枝被粉狀毛。

items.en: Opposite, or rarely in whorls of 3, subleathery. Petioles 2–4 mm. Blade elliptic, oblong-elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, 3–10 × 1–4.5 cm. Base cuneate to broadly cuneate. Apex acute or acuminate. Lateral veins 7–12 on each side. Stipules ca. 1 cm, united into a sheath.
items.zh: 對生，稀 3 葉輪生，近革質。葉柄 2–4 毫米。葉片橢圓形、長圓狀橢圓形或長圓狀披針形，3–10 × 1–4.5 厘米。基部楔形至闊楔形。先端急尖或漸尖。側脈每邊 7–12 條。托葉約 1 厘米，合生成鞘。

items.en: Terminal, solitary. Calyx tube obconical, 8–20 mm, with 5–6 sharp ribs; limb usually 6-lobed. Corolla salverform; tube cylindric, 2.5–4 cm, green; limb 5–6 cm in diam., usually 6-lobed, the lobes white. Anthers linear, 1.2–1.6 cm, exserted.
items.zh: 頂生，單生。萼筒倒圓錐形，8–20 毫米，具 5–6 條銳棱；萼檐通常 6 裂。花冠高腳碟狀；冠筒圓柱形，2.5–4 厘米，綠色；檐部直徑 5–6 厘米，通常 6 裂，裂片白色。花藥線形，1.2–1.6 厘米，伸出。

items.en: Ellipsoidal, 2.5–3 cm, crowned by the long persistent calyx lobes, and marked outside by as many raised ribs.
items.zh: 橢圓形，2.5–3 厘米，頂端有宿存的長萼裂片，外面有同樣數目的隆起棱。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui, Shandong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian and Taiwan; Japan, Indochina, and cultivated elsewhere.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、四川、湖南、江西、安徽、山東、江蘇、浙江、福建及台灣；日本、中南半島，其他地方有栽培。

photos.en: Ellipsoidal fruit with persistent calyx lobes.
photos.zh: 橢圓形果，具宿存萼裂片。

photos.en: The corolla tube, from the side.
A bud, and the corolla tube.

reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Tree, up to 25 m; young trunks and older branches usually very spiny
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 25 米；幼樹樹幹及老枝通常多刺
花期 3 月至 4 月。果期 5 月。
栽培。

items.en: Tree, up to 25 m tall. Bark greyish white. Trunk of young trees, and branches of older trees, usually very spiny.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 25 米。樹皮灰白色。幼樹的樹幹，以及老樹的枝，通常多刺。

items.en: Palmately compound. Petioles 10–20 cm. Petiolules 1.5–4 cm. Leaflets 5–7, oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 10–20 × 3.5–7 cm, base broadly cuneate, apex acuminate, margin entire, glabrous. Lateral veins 15–17 pairs.
items.zh: 掌狀複葉。葉柄 10–20 厘米。小葉柄 1.5–4 厘米。小葉 5–7 枚，長圓形至長圓狀披針形，10–20 × 3.5–7 厘米，基部闊楔形，先端漸尖，全緣，無毛。側脈 15–17 對。

items.en: Usually red, sometimes orange-red, about 10 cm across. Calyx 2–4.5 cm, 3–5-lobed. Petals fleshy, obovate-oblong, 8–10 × 3–4 cm. Style longer than the stamens.
items.zh: 花通常紅色，有時橙紅色，直徑約 10 厘米。萼長 2–4.5 厘米，3–5 裂。花瓣肉質，倒卵狀長圓形，8–10 × 3–4 厘米。花柱長於雄蕊。

items.en: Ellipsoid, 10–15 × 4.5–5 cm, densely greyish-white villous. Seeds many, obovate, smooth.
items.zh: 橢圓形，10–15 × 4.5–5 厘米，密被灰白色長柔毛。種子多數，倒卵形，平滑。

ecology.en: South and southwest China; tropical Asia.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Tree to 20 m, with spreading branches
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 20 米，枝開展
花期 6 月至 7 月。果期 8 月至 10 月。
栽培。

items.en: Tree to 20 m tall, with spreading branches. Bark rough, greyish brown.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 20 米，枝開展。樹皮粗糙，灰褐色。

items.en: Leaves 20–60 cm. Pinnae 15–20 pairs. Leaflets 10–25 pairs, oblong, 4–8 × 3–4 mm, base oblique, apex obtuse, sericeous on both surfaces.
items.zh: 葉長 20–60 厘米。羽片 15–20 對。小葉 10–25 對，長圓形，4–8 × 3–4 毫米，基部偏斜，先端鈍，兩面被絹毛。

items.en: Racemes 20–40 cm. Flowers 7–10 cm across. Petals bright scarlet, mixed with yellow and white patches, suborbicular, 5–7 cm including the stalk. Stamens red.
items.zh: 總狀花序長 20–40 厘米。花直徑 7–10 厘米。花瓣鮮緋紅色，雜有黃斑及白斑，近圓形，連柄長 5–7 厘米。雄蕊紅色。

items.en: 30–60 × 3.5–5 cm, blackish brown when mature, the style persistent at the apex. Seeds many, yellow with brown patches.
items.zh: 長 30–60 厘米，寬 3.5–5 厘米，成熟時黑褐色，先端有宿存花柱。種子多數，黃色而有褐斑。

ecology.en: Exotic. Cultivated in Hong Kong. Native to Madagascar.
ecology.zh: 外來。香港有栽培。原產馬達加斯加。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Fujian and Taiwan (cultivated); native to Madagascar, and widely cultivated in the tropics.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、雲南、福建及台灣（栽培）；原產馬達加斯加，熱帶地區廣泛栽培。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Shrub or small tree, up to 10 m
facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高可達 10 米
花期 12 月至 1 月。果期 8 月至 9 月。
森林。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, up to 10 m tall. Young branches reddish brown, glabrous.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高可達 10 米。幼枝紅褐色，無毛。

items.en: Leathery. Petioles about 1 cm. Blade oblong, 7–13 × 2–4 cm, base cuneate to obtuse, apex acuminate, margin entire or obscurely undulate-denticulate. Lateral veins 7–10 on each side.
items.zh: 革質。葉柄約 1 厘米。葉片長圓形，7–13 × 2–4 厘米，基部楔形至鈍，先端漸尖，全緣或不明顯的波狀齒。側脈每邊 7–10 條。

items.en: Subterminal, solitary, subsessile. Petals 6–7, broadly obovate, 3.5–4 cm, connate at the base. Stamens many, about 3 cm. Styles 3–4, free.
items.zh: 近頂生，單生，近無柄。花瓣 6–7，闊倒卵形，3.5–4 厘米，基部合生。雄蕊多數，長約 3 厘米。花柱 3–4，分離。

items.en: Brown, globose to oblate, about 3 cm across, 3–4-locular, with 1–2 seeds in each locule. Seeds brown, subglobose, about 1.5 cm across.
items.zh: 褐色，球形至扁球形，直徑約 3 厘米，3–4 室，每室有種子 1–2 顆。種子褐色，近球形，直徑約 1.5 厘米。

ecology.en: Native. Victoria Peak, Pok Fu Lam, Mount Nicholson and Mount Parker. The type was collected in a ravine on Victoria Peak in 1849. Listed in Rare and Precious Plants of Hong Kong.
ecology.zh: 原生。太平山、薄扶林、聶高信山及柏架山。模式標本於 1849 年採自太平山一處山溝。列入《香港稀有及珍貴植物》。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

photos.en: White enlarged calyx lobe and yellow corolla.
photos.zh: 白色增大的萼裂片，花冠黃色。

facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 30 米；樹皮灰褐色
花期 3 月至 6 月。果期 7 月至 9 月。
森林。亦廣泛栽植。

items.en: Tree to 30 m tall. Bark grey-brown. Branchlets pubescent or glabrous, slightly lenticellate. Buds ovoid, glossy.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 30 米。樹皮灰褐色。小枝被毛或無毛，稍具皮孔。芽卵形，有光澤。

items.en: Petioles to 12 cm. Blade broadly ovate, palmately 3-lobed and 3-veined, the central lobe longer, base rounded, apex caudate-acuminate, margin glandular-serrate.
items.zh: 葉柄長可達 12 厘米。葉片闊卵形，掌狀 3 裂並具 3 脈，中裂片較長，基部圓形，先端尾狀漸尖，邊緣有腺鋸齒。

items.en: Male inflorescence a short spike, several arranged in a raceme. Female inflorescence capitate, 20–40-flowered, the peduncle 3–6 cm.
items.zh: 雄花序為短穗狀，數個排成總狀。雌花序頭狀，有花 20–40 朵，花序柄長 3–6 厘米。

items.en: Globose, 3–4 cm wide. Capsules with persistent staminodes and styles.
items.zh: 球形，寬 3–4 厘米。蒴果有宿存的退化雄蕊及花柱。

ecology.en: Native. Common in Hong Kong, and also widely planted.
ecology.zh: 原生。香港常見，亦廣泛栽植。

ecology.en: South, southwest, east and central China; South Korea, Laos and Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 華南、西南、華東及華中；南韓、老撾及越南。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Shrub, rarely a small tree, 1–4 m
facts.zh: 灌木，稀為小喬木，高 1–4 米
花期 2 月至 4 月。果期 5 月至 12 月。
森林或空曠地。

items.en: Shrub, rarely a small tree, 1–4 m tall. Branchlets initially brown-tomentose, becoming glabrous.
items.zh: 灌木，稀為小喬木，高 1–4 米。小枝初時被褐色絨毛，後變無毛。

items.en: Often crowded at the branchlet tip. Petioles 5–18 mm. Blade leathery, oblong to ovate-lanceolate, 2–8 × 1.5–4 cm, base attenuate and decurrent, margin dentate. Lateral veins 5–7 on each side.
items.zh: 常聚生於小枝先端。葉柄 5–18 毫米。葉片革質，長圓形至卵狀披針形，2–8 × 1.5–4 厘米，基部漸狹並下延，邊緣有齒。側脈每邊 5–7 條。

items.en: Terminal panicles or racemes, many-flowered. Flowers fragrant, 1–1.3 cm across. Petals white or pink, obovate-lanceolate. Stamens 15.
items.zh: 頂生圓錐花序或總狀花序，多花。花芳香，直徑 1–1.3 厘米。花瓣白色或粉紅色，倒卵狀披針形。雄蕊 15。

items.en: Globose, purplish black, about 5 mm across, crowned by the remains of the calyx teeth.
items.zh: 球形，紫黑色，直徑約 5 毫米，頂端有宿存的萼齒環。

ecology.en: Anhui, Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Hainan, Hunan, Jiangxi, Taiwan, Yunnan and Zhejiang; Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Thailand, Vietnam and Japan.
ecology.zh: 安徽、福建、廣東、廣西、貴州、海南、湖南、江西、台灣、雲南及浙江；柬埔寨、印尼、老撾、泰國、越南及日本。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 20 米
花期 4 月至 6 月。果期 7 月至 10 月。
栽培。

items.en: Tree up to 20 m tall. Young branches and leaves yellowish pubescent, glabrous in age.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 20 米。幼枝及幼葉被淡黃色毛，老時無毛。

items.en: Petioles 7–17 cm, with 2 stipitate cupular glands at the apex. Blade broadly ovate, 8–20 × 5–18 cm, base cordate to truncate, apex acute to acuminate, 2–5-lobed or entire, usually with cupular glands in the sinuses.
items.zh: 葉柄 7–17 厘米，先端有杯狀腺體 2 枚，具柄。葉片闊卵形，8–20 × 5–18 厘米，基部心形至截形，先端急尖至漸尖，2–5 裂或全緣，裂片凹缺處通常有杯狀腺體。

items.en: Panicles usually terminal. Petals obovate, 2–3 cm, white, or purple-red at the base with purple-red stripes. Stamens 8–10. Ovary 3-locular.
items.zh: 圓錐花序通常頂生。花瓣倒卵形，2–3 厘米，白色，或基部紫紅色並有紫紅色條紋。雄蕊 8–10。子房 3 室。

items.en: Ovoid, 3–5 cm across, 3-ribbed. Pericarp leathery, wrinkled. Seeds compressed-globose, verrucose.
items.zh: 卵形，直徑 3–5 厘米，具 3 棱。果皮革質，有皺紋。種子扁球形，有疣狀突起。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Hunan, Hubei, Jiangxi, Anhui, Zhejiang, Fujian and Taiwan; Vietnam, Myanmar and Thailand, and cultivated in Japan.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、湖南、湖北、江西、安徽、浙江、福建及台灣；越南、緬甸及泰國，日本有栽培。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 常綠攀援灌木
花期 4 月至 7 月。果期 5 月至 10 月。

facts.en: Thickets on roadsides and in ravines.
facts.zh: 路邊及山溝的灌叢。

items.en: Evergreen scandent shrub. Branchlets densely appressed-pubescent.
items.zh: 常綠攀援灌木。小枝密被伏貼短柔毛。

items.en: Opposite, or sometimes subverticillate. Petioles 3–8 mm. Blade oblong-elliptic, obovate-elliptic to ovate-lanceolate, 5–9 × 2–3.5 cm, base cuneate, apex shortly acuminate, pubescent, the hairs denser beneath. Stipules 5–7 mm, lobed.
items.zh: 對生，有時近輪生。葉柄 3–8 毫米。葉片長圓狀橢圓形、倒卵狀橢圓形至卵狀披針形，5–9 × 2–3.5 厘米，基部楔形，先端短漸尖，被毛，背面的毛較密。托葉 5–7 毫米，分裂。

items.en: Terminal corymbiform cymes. One calyx lobe of some outer flowers enlarged, white, broadly ovate or orbicular, 2–4.5 × 1–3.5 cm. Corolla salverform; tube 1.2–1.8 cm, green; lobes bright yellow, about 4 × 2 mm.
items.zh: 頂生傘房狀聚繖花序。部分外圍花的一枚萼裂片增大，白色，闊卵形或圓形，2–4.5 × 1–3.5 厘米。花冠高腳碟狀；冠筒 1.2–1.8 厘米，綠色；裂片鮮黃色，約 4 × 2 毫米。

items.en: Globular, 8–10 mm across, sparsely pubescent.
items.zh: 球形，直徑 8–10 毫米，疏被短柔毛。

ecology.en: Thickets on roadsides and in ravines.
Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hunan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian and Taiwan.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、湖南、江西、浙江、福建及台灣。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Tree, 6–20 m; bark grey, coarsely fissured
facts.zh: 喬木，高 6–20 米；樹皮灰色，粗裂

facts.en: Flowering and fruiting nearly all year.
facts.zh: 幾乎全年開花結果。
紅樹林。

items.en: Tree 6–20 m tall. Bark grey, coarsely fissured. Stipules often reddish, about 4 cm.
items.zh: 喬木，高 6–20 米。樹皮灰色，粗裂。托葉常帶紅色，約 4 厘米。

items.en: Petiole 2–4.5 cm. Blade elliptic-oblong, 7–15 × 3–5.5 cm, base cuneate or rarely obtuse, apex acute, thickly leathery, glabrous.
items.zh: 葉柄 2–4.5 厘米。葉片橢圓狀長圓形，7–15 × 3–5.5 厘米，基部楔形，稀鈍，先端急尖，厚革質，無毛。

items.en: Solitary, red or pinkish red, about 3–3.5 cm across when open. Calyx lobes 11–13, linear, 1.5–2 cm. Petals 1.1–1.5 cm, 2-cleft, with 3 or 4 bristles in the sinus.
items.zh: 單生，紅色或帶粉紅色，盛開時直徑約 3–3.5 厘米。萼裂片 11–13，線形，1.5–2 厘米。花瓣 1.1–1.5 厘米，2 裂，凹缺處有剛毛 3 或 4 條。

items.en: 15–25 cm, smooth.
items.zh: 長 15–25 厘米，平滑。

ecology.en: Native. Shek O, Sai Kung, Kiu Tsui, Yung Shue Au, Tai Po, Plover Cove, Mai Po and Lantau Island.
ecology.zh: 原生。石澳、西貢、橋咀、榕樹澳、大埔、船灣、米埔及大嶼山。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian and Taiwan; Cambodia, India, Indonesia, the Ryukyu Islands, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Vietnam, East Africa, northern Australia, Madagascar, New Guinea and the Pacific islands.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、福建及台灣；柬埔寨、印度、印尼、琉球群島、馬來西亞、緬甸、菲律賓、斯里蘭卡、泰國、越南、東非、澳洲北部、馬達加斯加、新幾內亞及太平洋島嶼。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Prostrate or creeping shrub, rooting from the sterile branches
facts.zh: 平臥或匍匐灌木，不結果的枝生不定根
花果期 4 月至 12 月。
生於牆上及樹上。

items.en: Shrub, prostrate or creeping. Adventitious roots arise from the unfruiting branches.
items.zh: 灌木，平臥或匍匐。不結果的枝生不定根。

items.en: Leaves on sterile branches thin-leathery, ovate-cordate, about 2.5 cm. Leaves on fertile branches leathery, ovate-elliptic, 5–10 × 2–3.5 cm, base rounded to shallowly cordate, margin entire, yellow-brown pubescent beneath. Lateral veins 3–4 pairs.
items.zh: 不育枝上的葉薄革質，卵狀心形，約 2.5 厘米。能育枝上的葉革質，卵狀橢圓形，5–10 × 2–3.5 厘米，基部圓形至淺心形，全緣，背面被黃褐色短柔毛。側脈 3–4 對。

items.en: Solitary or paired in the leaf axils, yellow-green or reddish, pear-shaped or turbinate, 3.5–6.5 cm across. Stalk short and thick, 0.5–1.5 cm. Basal bracts 3.
items.zh: 單生或成對腋生，黃綠色或帶紅色，梨形或陀螺形，直徑 3.5–6.5 厘米。柄短而粗，0.5–1.5 厘米。基部苞片 3。

ecology.en: Areas south of the Changjiang; Japan, India and Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 長江以南各地；日本、印度及越南。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 常綠小喬木，高 6–8 米
幾乎全年開花。
海岸附近向陽處。

items.en: Evergreen small tree, 6–8 m tall. Branchlets scabrous, densely covered with brown scurfy scales.
items.zh: 常綠小喬木，高 6–8 米。小枝粗糙，密被褐色糠秕狀鱗片。

items.en: Petioles 4–10 cm. Blade ovate-cordate, 7–18 × 4.5–11 cm, base cordate, apex long-caudate, margin entire, glabrous above, sparsely scurfy beneath.
items.zh: 葉柄 4–10 厘米。葉片卵狀心形，7–18 × 4.5–11 厘米，基部心形，先端長尾狀，全緣，上面無毛，下面疏被糠秕。

items.en: Solitary, axillary. Calyx cup-shaped, about 15 mm across, truncate and 5-toothed. Corolla campanulate, about 5 cm, yellow, with purple blotches at the base inside.
items.zh: 單生，腋生。萼杯狀，直徑約 15 毫米，先端截形並有 5 齒。花冠鐘狀，約 5 厘米，黃色，內面基部有紫色斑塊。

items.en: Pyriform, about 5 cm across. Seed triangular-ovoid, striate, lanuginose.
items.zh: 梨形，直徑約 5 厘米。種子三角狀卵形，有條紋，被綿毛。

ecology.en: Native. Tai Tam Reservoir, Tai Po, Butterfly Beach, Lung Kwu Tan, Nam Chung, Luk Keng, Lantau Island, Ma Wan and Po Toi.
ecology.zh: 原生。大潭水塘、大埔、蝴蝶灣、龍鼓灘、南涌、鹿頸、大嶼山、馬灣及蒲台。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangxi, Guangdong and Taiwan; Indochina, Thailand, India, Sri Lanka, the Philippines and tropical Africa.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣西、廣東及台灣；中南半島、泰國、印度、斯里蘭卡、菲律賓及熱帶非洲。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Tree to 15 m; bark grey or greyish brown, irregularly fissured
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 15 米；樹皮灰色或灰褐色，不規則縱裂
傳粉期 4 月至 5 月。種子於 8 月至 9 月成熟。

facts.en: Open thickets. Coastal hillslopes on eastern seashores; also cultivated in urban parks and gardens.
facts.zh: 開闊灌叢。東部海岸的沿海山坡；亦栽培於市區公園及花園。

items.en: Tree to 15 m; trunk to 30 cm d.b.h.; branches dense, spreading, pale brown.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 15 米；胸徑可達 30 厘米；枝密集開展，淡褐色。

items.en: Grey or greyish brown, irregularly fissured.
items.zh: 灰色或灰褐色，不規則縱裂。

items.en: Spirally arranged on the upper half of branchlets, sessile.
items.zh: 螺旋狀排列於小枝上半部，無柄。

items.en: Linear-lanceolate, oblanceolate, or oblong-oblanceolate, 7–12 cm × 7–10 mm. Base cuneate. Apex mucronate or acute to long acuminate. Margin slightly recurved.
items.zh: 線狀披針形、倒披針形或長圓狀倒披針形，7–12 厘米 × 7–10 毫米。基部楔形。先端具短尖或急尖至長漸尖。邊緣微反卷。

items.en: Dark green and glossy adaxially; greyish green or pale green abaxially. Midvein prominently raised adaxially, slightly raised abaxially.
items.zh: 上面深綠色而有光澤；下面灰綠色或淺綠色。中脈在上面明顯隆起，在下面稍隆起。

items.en: Axillary, usually in clusters of 3–5, spikelike, 3–5 cm, subsessile.
items.zh: 腋生，通常 3–5 枚簇生，穗狀，長 3–5 厘米，近無柄。

items.en: Axillary, solitary, shortly pedunculate. Receptacle red or purplish red when ripe, columnar. Epimatium purplish black when ripe, with white powder. Seed ellipsoid or ovoid, ca. 1 cm in diam.
items.zh: 腋生，單生，具短梗。種托成熟時紅色或紫紅色，柱狀。套被成熟時紫黑色，被白粉。種子橢圓形或卵形，直徑約 1 厘米。

ecology.en: Native. Coastal hillslopes on eastern seashores; also cultivated in urban parks and gardens.
ecology.zh: 原生。東部海岸的沿海山坡；亦栽培於市區公園及花園。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan, Hunan, Anhui, Jiangxi, Fujian, Zhejiang and Jiangsu; Japan.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、四川、湖南、安徽、江西、福建、浙江及江蘇；日本。

photos.en: Wild shrub-tree in an open hillside thicket.
photos.zh: 開闊山坡灌叢中的野生灌木狀小樹。

photos.en: Cultivated tree with a forked trunk and a dense crown of linear leaves.
photos.zh: 栽培的樹，樹幹分叉，樹冠密生線形葉。

photos.en: Massive trunks with grey fissured bark.
photos.zh: 粗大的樹幹，樹皮灰色縱裂。

photos.en: Linear-lanceolate leaves on a grey branchlet.
photos.zh: 灰色小枝上的線狀披針形葉。

photos.en: Pale leaf undersides in the canopy.
A pair of young spikelike pollen cones.
photos.zh: 一對幼嫩的穗狀花粉球花。

photos.en: An axillary cluster of spikelike pollen cones.
photos.zh: 葉腋生的一簇穗狀花粉球花。
伸長的花粉球花，正在散粉。

photos.en: Glaucous seeds on a columnar receptacle.
photos.zh: 柱狀種托上帶白粉的種子。

photos.en: A dense crop of glaucous seeds among linear leaves.
photos.zh: 線形葉間密生帶白粉的種子。

photos.en: Red new flush among green linear leaves.
photos.zh: 綠色線形葉間的紅色新梢。

facts.en: Small to moderate tree, 1–5 m; stems rough, with petiole-base remains
facts.zh: 小至中等喬木，高 1–5 米；莖粗糙，留有葉柄基部
花期 4 月至 5 月。果期 6 月至 10 月。
開闊的森林。

items.en: Small to moderate tree, 1–5 m. Stems solitary or clustered, 25–40 cm in diam., sometimes short and subterranean, rough, with petiole-base remains.
items.zh: 小至中等喬木，高 1–5 米。莖單生或叢生，直徑 25–40 厘米，有時短而埋於地下，粗糙，留有葉柄基部。

items.en: Pinnate, to 2 m. Pinnae 35–120, linear, solitary or in groups of 2–3, not in the same plane. Middle pinnae 20–45 × 1–3 cm.
items.zh: 羽狀，長可達 2 米。羽片 35–120 枚，線形，單生或 2–3 枚成組，不在同一平面。中部羽片 20–45 × 1–3 厘米。

items.en: About 15 per side of the rachis, on the lower rachis.
items.zh: 葉軸每側約 15 枚，生於下部葉軸。

items.en: Branched to one order, with 30–40 rachillae. Peduncles to 50 cm.
items.zh: 1 回分枝，小穗軸 30–40 條。花序梗長可達 50 厘米。

items.en: Yellowish white. Male flowers: calyx 1–1.5 mm, 3-lobed; petals 3, 4–5 × 1.5–2 mm; stamens 6.
items.zh: 黃白色。雄花：花萼 1–1.5 毫米，3 裂；花瓣 3，4–5 × 1.5–2 毫米；雄蕊 6。

items.en: Oblong, 1.5–2 cm, black or purplish black.
items.zh: 長圓形，1.5–2 厘米，黑色或紫黑色。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Fujian and Taiwan; Indian Subcontinent, Southeast Asia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、雲南、福建及台灣；印度次大陸、東南亞。

photos.en: Solitary stem with petiole-base remains, and a pinnate crown, in open forest.
photos.zh: 疏林中的單幹，幹上留有葉柄基部，樹冠羽狀。

photos.en: Fruiting crown above a scarred trunk, with orange fruiting heads.
photos.zh: 有疤的樹幹之上，樹冠結有橙黃色果序。

photos.en: A cluster of oblong orange fruits on branched rachillae.
photos.zh: 分枝小穗軸上的一簇長圓形橙色果實。

photos.en: Oblong fruits, black to purplish black, with some still orange.
photos.zh: 長圓形果實，黑色至紫黑色，部分仍為橙色。

photos.en: Linear pinnae, grouped, not in one plane.
photos.zh: 線形羽片，成組，不在同一平面。

photos.en: Spine-like pinnae on the lower rachis.
photos.zh: 下部葉軸上的刺狀羽片。

photos.en: Rough stem with persistent petiole bases.
photos.zh: 粗糙的莖幹，留有宿存的葉柄基部。

photos.en: A dense cream to yellowish-white mass of male flowers among the pinnae.
photos.zh: 羽片間密生的乳白色至淡黃白色雄花。

photos.en: Yellow male flowers, with spine-like lower pinnae.
photos.zh: 黃色雄花，下部羽片呈刺狀。

facts.en: Perennial herb; culms erect, 1.5–4 m, unbranched
facts.zh: 多年生草本；稈直立，高 1.5–4 米，不分枝

facts.en: Hillslopes, valleys and open grassy fields.
facts.zh: 山坡、山谷及開闊的草地。

items.en: Perennial herb. Culms erect, 1.5–4 m, glabrous, unbranched.
items.zh: 多年生草本。稈直立，高 1.5–4 米，無毛，不分枝。

items.en: Glabrous, or margins sparsely ciliate.
items.zh: 無毛，或邊緣疏生緣毛。

items.en: 1–3 mm, rounded, ciliate.
items.zh: 長 1–3 毫米，圓形，具緣毛。

items.en: Linear, flat, tough, 20–85 × 0.5–4 cm. Midrib prominent. Margins scabrid.
items.zh: 線形，平展，質韌，20–85 × 0.5–4 厘米。中脈明顯。邊緣粗糙。

items.en: Oblong or elliptic, dense, 30–50 cm. Axis more than two-thirds the panicle length. Racemes many, 10–30 cm, appressed or ascending.
items.zh: 長圓形或橢圓形，密集，長 30–50 厘米。軸長超過花序的三分之二。總狀花序多，長 10–30 厘米，貼生或上升。

items.en: As long as or slightly longer than the spikelet, white, spreading.
items.zh: 與小穗等長或稍長，白色，開展。

items.en: Glumes subequal, membranous. Awn straight or geniculate. Anthers 3, 1–1.5 mm.
items.zh: 穎近等長，膜質。芒直或膝曲。花藥 3，長 1–1.5 毫米。

items.en: Oblong.
items.zh: 長圓形。

ecology.en: Hillslopes, valleys and open grassy fields.
ecology.zh: 山坡、山谷及開闊的草地。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan, Henan, Hubei, Jiangxi, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian and Taiwan; Southeast Asia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、四川、河南、湖北、江西、安徽、江蘇、浙江、福建及台灣；東南亞。

photos.en: Tall culms with linear blades and dense panicles on a bank.
photos.zh: 坡地上的高稈，線形葉片，圓錐花序密集。

photos.en: A dense pink-brown panicle of many racemes.
photos.zh: 密集的粉褐色圓錐花序，總狀花序多。

photos.en: A ciliate ligule at a culm node.
A linear blade with a prominent midrib, and a glabrous sheath.
photos.zh: 線形葉片，中脈明顯，葉鞘無毛。

photos.en: Paired spikelets with yellow anthers, purple stigmas and white callus hairs.
photos.zh: 成對小穗，黃色花藥，紫色柱頭，白色基盤毛。

photos.en: A row of paired spikelets on a pink-brown raceme.
photos.zh: 粉褐色總狀花序上成行的成對小穗。

photos.en: Spikelet tips, with awns, anthers and stigmas.
photos.zh: 小穗先端，具芒、花藥及柱頭。

facts.en: Perennial herb; stem short, without a tuber
facts.zh: 多年生草本；莖短，無塊莖
3 月至 9 月。
草地及灌叢。

items.en: Perennial herb, with 1 or 2 black fibrous roots; stem short, without a tuber below ground.
items.zh: 多年生草本，具黑色纖維根 1 或 2 條；莖短，無地下塊莖。

items.en: Dense and flat. Young leaves circinately folded once toward the stipule.
items.zh: 密集而扁平。幼葉向托葉方向拳卷對摺一次。

items.en: Obovate, spathulate, or cuneate, glandular hairy.
items.zh: 倒卵形、匙形或楔形，具腺毛。

items.en: Flattened, gradually widened toward the blade, glandular hairy.
items.zh: 扁平，向葉片方向逐漸變寬，具腺毛。

items.en: Light red, narrow, 4–8 mm, scarious; apex fimbriate, setaceous.
items.zh: 淡紅色，狹，長 4–8 毫米，乾膜質；先端篦齒狀，剛毛狀。

items.en: 1–6, scapiform, sometimes branched, 4–25 cm. Peduncle densely glandular hairy. Racemes one-sided, 10–20-flowered.
items.zh: 1–6 枚，花葶狀，有時分枝，高 4–25 厘米。花葶密被腺毛。總狀花序單側，有花 10–20 朵。

items.en: Petals white or pink to reddish violet, obovate, 2–6 mm. Stamens 5. Styles 3–4, each deeply 2-lobed.
items.zh: 花瓣白色或粉紅色至紅紫色，倒卵形，長 2–6 毫米。雄蕊 5。花柱 3–4，各深 2 裂。

items.en: 3–4-valved, ca. 1.5 mm. Seeds small, black, ovoid or ellipsoid.
items.zh: 3–4 裂，長約 1.5 毫米。種子小，黑色，卵形或橢圓形。

ecology.en: Native. Hong Kong Island, Tai Mo Shan, Ho Pui, Ma On Shan, Castle Peak and Lantau Island.
ecology.zh: 原生。香港島、大帽山、河背、馬鞍山、青山及大嶼山。

ecology.en: Guangdong, southern Guangxi, Fujian and Taiwan; Japan, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Australia and Pacific Islands.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西南部、福建及台灣；日本、馬來西亞、印度尼西亞、菲律賓、澳洲及太平洋島嶼。

photos.en: A single red rosette and a tall glandular scape with pink buds.
photos.zh: 單株紅色蓮座，高的具腺花葶，粉紅色花蕾。

photos.en: A dense colony of flat red rosettes on a wet seep.
photos.zh: 濕滲處密集的扁平紅色蓮座。

photos.en: A flat rosette on wet rock, with spathulate blades and red glandular tentacles.
photos.zh: 濕石上的扁平蓮座，匙形葉片，紅色腺毛。

photos.en: Flattened petioles, widened toward the blade.
photos.zh: 扁平的葉柄，向葉片方向變寬。

photos.en: A one-sided raceme of buds on a glandular peduncle.
photos.zh: 具腺花葶上的單側總狀花蕾。

photos.en: An open pale-pink flower, five petals, yellow stamens at the centre.
photos.zh: 開放的淡粉紅色花，花瓣五枚，中央黃色雄蕊。

photos.en: An open magenta flower, with five petals and five yellow stamens.
photos.zh: 開放的洋紅色花，花瓣五枚，黃色雄蕊五枚。

photos.en: Red capsules along one side of a fruiting scape.
photos.zh: 果葶一側排列的紅色蒴果。

photos.en: A young scape still coiled, above a red rosette.
photos.zh: 紅色蓮座上仍拳卷的幼花葶。

facts.en: Terrestrial herb; stems erect, grass-like and stiff
facts.zh: 地生草本；莖直立，似草而堅硬
花期 7 月至 12 月。

facts.en: Grassy slopes or stream banks in exposed areas.
facts.zh: 開曠處的草坡，或溪岸。

items.en: Terrestrial herb. Stems erect, grass-like and stiff, leafy. Basal portion swelling into a small ovoid pseudobulb covered by overlapping brown tough scales.
items.zh: 地生草本。莖直立，似草而堅硬，具葉。基部膨大成小的卵形假鱗莖，被覆瓦狀褐色堅韌鱗片。

items.en: Linear-lanceolate, thinly leathery or papery, 5–20 × 0.6 cm. Apex acute.
items.zh: 線狀披針形，薄革質或紙質，5–20 × 0.6 厘米。先端急尖。

items.en: Amplexicaul and overlapping, 2–4 cm, articulate at the apical end.
items.zh: 抱莖而覆疊，長 2–4 厘米，頂端有關節。

items.en: Terminal, racemose or paniculate. Flowers resupinate.
items.zh: 頂生，總狀或圓錐狀。花扭轉，唇瓣位於下方。

items.en: Elliptic or elliptic-lanceolate, 2.5–4 × 0.7–0.9 cm, apex acute, pale rose-mauve.
items.zh: 橢圓形或橢圓狀披針形，2.5–4 × 0.7–0.9 厘米，先端急尖，淡玫瑰紫色。

items.en: Elliptic or ovate-elliptic, 2.5–3.5 × 1.3–1.8 cm, rose-mauve with darker median veins.
items.zh: 橢圓形或卵狀橢圓形，2.5–3.5 × 1.3–1.8 厘米，玫瑰紫色，中脈顏色較深。

items.en: Trumpet-shaped, 3–4 cm, embracing the column, wavy at the margin, deeply cleft at the apex, pale magenta deepening to bright rose-purple towards the margin and apex.
items.zh: 喇叭形，長 3–4 厘米，抱蕊柱，邊緣波狀，先端深裂，淡洋紅色，向邊緣及先端加深為亮玫瑰紫色。

items.en: Slender, curved, slightly winged at the apical end. Pollinia 8, discoid.
items.zh: 細長，彎曲，頂端稍具翅。花粉塊 8，盤狀。

ecology.en: Grassy slopes or stream banks in exposed areas.
Central, east, south and southwest China; tropical Asia.
ecology.zh: 中國中、東、南及西南；熱帶亞洲。

photos.en: A clump in a rock crevice, with grass-like leaves, two open pale rose-mauve flowers and buds.
photos.zh: 石縫中的一叢，葉似草，兩朵開放的淡玫瑰紫色花及花蕾。

photos.en: Flowering stems on a rock bank beside a path.
Stem bases with brown overlapping scales in a rock crevice.
photos.zh: 石縫中的莖基部，褐色鱗片覆疊。

photos.en: A cylindrical stem with overlapping leaf sheaths and linear-lanceolate blades.
photos.zh: 圓柱狀莖，葉鞘覆疊，葉片線狀披針形。

photos.en: Flower face: pale mauve tepals, and a magenta lip with a pale throat and a deeply cleft wavy apex.
photos.zh: 花正面：淡紫色花被片，唇瓣洋紅色，喉部淺色，先端深裂而波狀。

photos.en: Flower face, with the column visible in the lip throat.
photos.zh: 花正面，唇瓣喉部可見蕊柱。

photos.en: A flowering colony on a grassy slope.

facts.zh: 灌木，高 1–4 米
7 月至 8 月。果期 9 月至 12 月。
林緣及山谷林。

ecology.en: Forest edges and forests in valleys.
Fujian, Guangdong, Hunan, Jiangxi, Henan, Zhejiang, Taiwan; Japan and Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 福建、廣東、湖南、江西、河南、浙江、台灣；日本及越南。

items.en: Shrub, 1–4 m. Branchlets, petioles and the inflorescence are densely covered with yellowish-brown branched stellate hairs.
items.zh: 灌木，高 1–4 米。小枝、葉柄和花序密被黃褐色的分枝星狀毛。

items.en: Oblong-lanceolate, elliptic or ovate-elliptic, 12–22 × 4–8 cm. Base cuneate. Apex acuminate or acute. Margin serrate. Upper surface glabrous or slightly hairy on the veins. Lower surface densely yellowish-brown stellate-tomentose, and obscurely yellow-glandular.
items.zh: 長圓狀披針形、橢圓形或卵狀橢圓形，12–22 × 4–8 厘米。基部楔形。先端漸尖或急尖。邊緣有鋸齒。上面無毛或脈上稍被毛。下面密被黃褐色星狀絨毛，兩面有不明顯的黃色腺點。

items.en: Lateral veins 10–18 pairs, prominent beneath. Petiole 1–3 cm.
items.zh: 側脈 10–18 對，下面明顯。葉柄 1–3 厘米。

items.en: Cymes 3–6 cm across, on a peduncle 1–2 cm. Flowers almost sessile. Calyx tubular, 2–2.5 mm, hairy, with acute teeth. Corolla pink to purple, the lobes densely hairy. Stamens exserted.
items.zh: 聚傘花序寬 3–6 厘米，花序梗 1–2 厘米。花近無柄。萼筒狀，長 2–2.5 毫米，被毛，齒尖。花冠粉紅至紫色，裂片密被毛。雄蕊伸出。

items.en: Globose, about 1.5 mm across, nearly enclosed by the persistent calyx.
items.zh: 球形，直徑約 1.5 毫米，幾乎全被宿存的萼包裹。

photos.en: Lower leaf surface, densely felted, with young cyme buds.
photos.zh: 葉下面密被絨毛，並有幼小的聚傘花蕾。

photos.en: Open pink-purple flower, the lobes hairy.
photos.zh: 開放的粉紫色花，裂片被毛。

photos.en: The lower leaf surface, a carpet of stellate hairs.
Hairy flower heads still in bud.
A pair of flowers, the stamens exserted.
White fruits, partly held by the calyx.
photos.zh: 白色的果，部分被萼托住。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1–10 米
6 月至次年 2 月。
林緣及荒地。

ecology.en: Southern and central China, north to Henan; Korea, Vietnam and Malaysia.
ecology.zh: 中國南部及中部，北至河南；朝鮮、越南及馬來西亞。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, 1–10 m. Branchlets yellowish brown and pubescent.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1–10 米。小枝黃褐色，被短柔毛。

items.en: Papery, elliptic, ovate-elliptic, oblong or oblong-lanceolate, 6–20 × 3–9 cm. Base rounded to cuneate. Apex acuminate to acute. Margin entire. Glabrous, or sparsely hairy along the veins, and glandular beneath.
items.zh: 紙質，橢圓形、卵狀橢圓形、長圓形或長圓狀披針形，6–20 × 3–9 厘米。基部圓至楔形。先端漸尖至急尖。全緣。無毛，或沿脈疏被毛，下面有腺點。

items.en: Lateral veins 6–10 pairs. Petiole 1–8 cm.
items.zh: 側脈 6–10 對。葉柄 1–8 厘米。

items.en: Terminal or near-terminal corymbose cymes, 10–16 cm. Flowers small and fragrant. Corolla white, the tube slender, about 1 cm, the lobes ovate, about 5 mm. Stamens and style exserted.
items.zh: 聚傘花序排成傘房狀，頂生或近頂生，長 10–16 厘米。花小而香。花冠白色，花冠管細，長約 1 厘米，裂片卵形，長約 5 毫米。雄蕊和花柱伸出。

items.en: Fruiting calyx red. Drupe blue-purple, obovoid to globose, 5–10 mm across.
items.zh: 果萼紅色。核果藍紫色，倒卵形至球形，直徑 5–10 毫米。

photos.en: Hairs in the throat of the corolla.
A flowering shrub with many white corymbs.
photos.zh: 開花的灌木，有許多白色的聚傘花序。

photos.en: Flowering shrubs along a roadside drain.
photos.zh: 路旁排水溝邊開花的灌木。
完全開放的頂生傘房花序。

photos.en: Elliptic entire leaves on the shoot.
The pale lower surface of a leaf, with flowers behind.
photos.zh: 葉的淺色下面，後面有花。

photos.en: Green cupular calyces under the flower tube.
photos.zh: 花冠管下的綠色杯狀萼。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 多年生草本
6 月至 11 月。
山坡及受干擾的地方。

ecology.en: Southern China, north to Hubei; also from the Indian subcontinent to the Pacific islands.
ecology.zh: 中國南部，北至湖北；亦見於印度次大陸至太平洋島嶼。

items.en: Perennial grass. Culms tufted and erect, 30–100 cm. The nodes are densely bearded.
items.zh: 多年生草本。稈叢生，直立，高 30–100 厘米。節密被髯毛。

items.en: Narrowly linear, 8–30 × 0.2–0.4 cm, silky-hairy above with tubercle-based hairs, usually glabrous beneath. Apex acuminate. Ligule a dry membrane, 1–2 mm, ciliate.
items.zh: 狹線形，8–30 × 0.2–0.4 厘米，上面被基部長疣的絲狀毛，下面通常無毛。先端漸尖。葉舌乾膜質，長 1–2 毫米，有緣毛。

items.en: Two to eight racemes, almost digitate. The sessile spikelet is bisexual, 3–5 mm. The upper lemma ends in a flexuous awn 1.5–2.5 cm.
items.zh: 總狀花序 2–8 枚，近指狀。無柄小穗兩性，長 3–5 毫米。上外稃先端有一屈曲的芒，長 1.5–2.5 厘米。

photos.en: A clump on a disturbed roadside.
Tufted culms on a concrete edge.
A length of the raceme, with paired spikelets.
photos.zh: 一段總狀花序，小穗成對。

photos.en: A node with a white beard.
Silky hairs on the upper leaf surface.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Tree to 15 m, glabrous except on the young parts
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 15 米，除幼嫩部分外無毛
4 月至 9 月。
森林。

ecology.en: Southern, southwestern, central and eastern China; Bhutan, India, Indonesia, Japan, Vietnam and Australia.
ecology.zh: 中國南、西南、中及東部；不丹、印度、印度尼西亞、日本、越南及澳洲。

items.en: Tree to 15 m, glabrous except on the young parts. Bark black-grey and fissured. Branchlets brown, with conspicuous lenticels.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 15 米，除幼嫩部分外無毛。樹皮黑灰色，條裂。小枝褐色，皮孔明顯。

items.en: Elliptic to obovate or oblong-obovate, 5–15 × 4–6 cm. Base broadly cuneate. Apex acute or apiculate. Margin serrulate, the teeth curved upward.
items.zh: 橢圓形至倒卵形或長圓狀倒卵形，5–15 × 4–6 厘米。基部闊楔形。先端急尖或具短尖。邊緣有細鋸齒，齒向上彎。

items.en: Petiole 1.5–3.5 cm.
Terminal panicles, 8–15 cm. Flowers small, crowded and fragrant. Corolla white, campanulate, 3–4 mm, the lobes spreading and longer than the tube.
items.zh: 圓錐花序頂生，長 8–15 厘米。花小，密集，有香氣。花冠白色，鐘狀，長 3–4 毫米，裂片開展，長於花冠管。

items.en: Drupe yellow or orange, 3–4 mm across.
items.zh: 核果黃色或橙色，直徑 3–4 毫米。

photos.en: Leaf margin, the small teeth curved upward.
The upper surface of a leaf.
The lower surface of a leaf.
A panicle with buds and open flowers.
photos.zh: 有花蕾和開放花的圓錐花序。

photos.en: A canopy with flowers and fruit together.

facts.zh: 無刺、無毛的灌木，高 1–4 米
3 月至 8 月。果期 6 月至 11 月。
山地灌叢。

ecology.en: China south of the Qinling range; also widespread in Africa, Oceania, and East and Southeast Asia.
ecology.zh: 秦嶺以南的中國；亦廣布於非洲、大洋洲及東亞、東南亞。

items.en: Unarmed, glabrous shrub, 1–4 m. Branchlets sharply angular, reddish brown when young.
items.zh: 無刺、無毛的灌木，高 1–4 米。小枝有銳稜，幼時紅褐色。

items.en: Alternate, papery, elliptic, oblong, obovate or round, 2–5 × 1–3 cm. Apex rounded to acute, with a small mucro. Margin entire. Whitish beneath. Stipules lanceolate, 1.5–3 mm.
items.zh: 互生，紙質，橢圓形、長圓形、倒卵形或近圓形，2–5 × 1–3 厘米。先端圓至急尖，有小短尖。全緣。下面帶白色。托葉披針形，長 1.5–3 毫米。

items.en: Small, yellowish, in axillary clusters. Male flowers have five stamens. Female flowers have a 3-locular ovary and three styles.
items.zh: 花小，黃綠色，簇生於葉腋。雄花有雄蕊 5 枚。雌花子房 3 室，花柱 3。

items.en: Berry-like capsule, nearly globose, 3–5 mm across, whitish when ripe, and not opening.
items.zh: 漿果狀蒴果，近球形，直徑 3–5 毫米，成熟時帶白色，不開裂。

photos.en: Male flowers in an axillary cluster.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).

facts.zh: 落葉喬木，高可達 20 米
4 月至 5 月。果期 5 月至 9 月。
廣布於中國。

ecology.en: Widely distributed in China; Vietnam and Korea.
ecology.zh: 廣布於中國；越南及朝鮮。

items.en: Deciduous tree to 20 m. Branchlets round in section. Winter buds brown and hairy.
items.zh: 落葉喬木，高可達 20 米。小枝圓柱形。冬芽褐色，被毛。

items.en: Opposite and odd-pinnate, the leaf 12–25 cm, with 3–7(–9) leaflets. Leaflet blade broadly ovate to lanceolate, or elliptic to obovate-lanceolate, 3–10 × 2–4 cm, regularly serrate.
items.zh: 對生，奇數羽狀複葉，長 12–25 厘米，小葉 3–7（–9）片。小葉闊卵形至披針形，或橢圓形至倒卵狀披針形，3–10 × 2–4 厘米，有規則鋸齒。

items.en: Panicles terminal or lateral, 5–12 cm. Flowers unisexual, opening with the leaves. There is no corolla. Male flowers are crowded, with a cup-shaped calyx about 1 mm.
items.zh: 圓錐花序頂生或側生，長 5–12 厘米。花單性，與葉同放。無花冠。雄花密集，萼杯狀，長約 1 毫米。

items.en: Samara spatulate, 3–4 cm × 4–6 mm. The wing runs down to the middle of the nutlet.
items.zh: 翅果匙形，3–4 厘米 × 4–6 毫米。翅下延至堅果中部。

photos.zh: 奇數羽狀複葉，小葉有鋸齒。

photos.en: A pendulous panicle of male flowers, without a corolla.
photos.zh: 下垂的雄花圓錐花序，無花冠。

photos.en: Male panicles on a twig with young pinnate leaves.
photos.zh: 小枝上的雄花序，並有幼嫩的羽狀葉。

photos.en: Male flowers: anthers on slender filaments, no petals.
photos.zh: 雄花：花藥生於細花絲上，無花瓣。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Shrub or small tree, usually 1–4 m
facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，通常高 1–4 米
6 月至 9 月。果期 8 月至 11 月。
疏林及灌叢。

ecology.en: Southern and central China, from Hainan and Guangdong north to Henan and Shaanxi.
ecology.zh: 中國南部及中部，自海南、廣東北至河南及陝西。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, usually 1–4 m. Branchlets, petioles and the inflorescence are densely yellowish stellate-hairy, with scattered orange glands.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，通常高 1–4 米。小枝、葉柄和花序密被黃褐色星狀毛，並散生橙色腺體。

items.en: Alternate, ovate or broadly ovate, 6–16(–25) cm. Base truncate or slightly cordate, with two brown glands where the petiole joins. Apex acute or acuminate. Margin sparsely serrate. Lower surface white with stellate hairs.
items.zh: 互生，卵形或闊卵形，6–16（–25）厘米。基部截形或稍心形，葉柄着生處有褐色腺體 2 枚。先端急尖或漸尖。邊緣疏生鋸齒。下面白色，被星狀毛。

items.en: Male spikes 15–30 cm. Male flowers have 50–75 stamens. Female flowers are solitary in each bract, with 3–4 styles.
items.zh: 雄花序穗狀，長 15–30 厘米。雄花有雄蕊 50–75 枚。雌花單生於苞片內，花柱 3–4。

items.en: Capsule nearly globose, 1–1.3 cm across, stellate-hairy and softly prickly. The prickles are 5–10 mm.
items.zh: 蒴果近球形，直徑 1–1.3 厘米，被星狀毛，並有軟刺。刺長 5–10 毫米。

photos.en: Glands at the base of the leaf.
Male flowers, the stamens burst open.
Veins on the upper leaf surface.

facts.en: Shrub or small tree, 2–7 m, occasionally to 15 m
facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 2–7 米，有時可達 15 米
4 月至 5 月。果期 10 月至 12 月。
灌叢及受干擾的常綠林。

ecology.zh: 灌叢及受干擾的常綠林。

ecology.en: Southern and central China, west to Yunnan and southeastern Xizang; Japan, Vietnam, Myanmar and Thailand.
ecology.zh: 中國南部及中部，西至雲南及西藏東南部；日本、越南、緬甸及泰國。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, 2–7 m, occasionally to 15 m. Branches greyish brown to dark brown, glabrous.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 2–7 米，有時可達 15 米。枝灰褐至深褐色，無毛。

items.en: Spirally arranged, leathery, narrowly oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 5–15 × 1.3–3 cm. Base cuneate. Apex acute or obtuse. Margin entire and narrowly recurved. The lower surface has many tiny sunken pits.
items.zh: 螺旋狀排列，革質，狹長圓形至長圓狀披針形，5–15 × 1.3–3 厘米。基部楔形。先端急尖或鈍。全緣，邊緣狹反卷。下面有許多細小的下陷小點。

items.en: Umbels of 3–10 flowers on short warty spurs. Flowers white to pale green, sometimes reddish. Corolla 2.5–3 mm, split for about three-quarters of its length.
items.zh: 傘形花序生於短而有疣的短枝上，有花 3–10 朵。花白色至淺綠色，有時帶紅。花冠長 2.5–3 毫米，約四分之三深裂。

items.en: Nearly globose, 4–5 mm across, dotted.
items.zh: 近球形，直徑 4–5 毫米，有點。

photos.en: Lower leaf surface, pale, with tiny pits.
photos.zh: 葉下面淺色，有細小的下陷小點。

photos.en: Pale yellow-green flowers in umbels on a short spur.
photos.zh: 短枝上的淺黃綠色傘形花序。
開放的花和帶紅色條紋的花蕾。
小枝上的一串傘形花序。

photos.en: A spiral cluster of entire leathery leaves, with small umbels below.
photos.zh: 螺旋排列的革質全緣葉，下面有小傘形花序。

photos.en: The pale lower leaf surface, with tiny pits.
photos.zh: 淺色的葉下面，有細小的下陷小點。
開放的花和帶洋紅色條紋的花蕾。
木質短枝上的一串傘形花序。

photos.en: The glossy upper surface of a leaf.

facts.zh: 喬木，高 4–15 米
6 月至 8 月。果期 10 月。

facts.en: Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Indonesia and northern Australia.
facts.zh: 越南、斯里蘭卡、馬來西亞、印度尼西亞及澳洲北部。

ecology.en: Not native. The Flora records it as cultivated in Guangzhou, and in Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Indonesia and northern Australia.
ecology.zh: 非原生。植物誌記為廣州有栽培，並見於越南、斯里蘭卡、馬來西亞、印度尼西亞及澳洲北部。

ecology.en: Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Indonesia and northern Australia.
ecology.zh: 越南、斯里蘭卡、馬來西亞、印度尼西亞及澳洲北部。

items.en: Tree, 4–15 m. Young branches and the inflorescence are densely rusty-hairy. Older branches have yellow lenticels.
items.zh: 喬木，高 4–15 米。幼枝和花序密被鏽色毛。老枝有黃色皮孔。

items.en: Bipinnate, 30–42 cm. Pinnae 7–15 pairs. Leaflets 10–20 pairs, sessile, oblong, 1–1.8 × 0.5–0.7 cm, the base oblique and the apex obtuse with a small mucro.
items.zh: 二回羽狀複葉，長 30–42 厘米。羽片 7–15 對。小葉 10–20 對，無柄，長圓形，1–1.8 × 0.5–0.7 厘米，基部偏斜，先端鈍而有小短尖。

items.en: Panicles terminal or axillary. Flower buds globose, 5–8 mm. Petals obovate, 1.5–1.7 cm, rusty-hairy in the middle. Filaments hairy at the base.
items.zh: 圓錐花序頂生或腋生。花蕾球形，直徑 5–8 毫米。花瓣倒卵形，長 1.5–1.7 厘米，中部被鏽色毛。花絲基部有毛。

items.en: Pod dark red when ripe, oblong, 5–8 × 1.8–2.5 cm, flat, and winged along both sutures.
items.zh: 莢果成熟時暗紅色，長圓形，5–8 × 1.8–2.5 厘米，扁平，兩邊的縫線有翅。

Flowers and a pod against the sky.
A mass of pods, with the leaf.
A leaflet and a pod, the pod marked with lines.
photos.zh: 一片小葉和一枚有條紋的莢果。

facts.en: Tree to 10 m, with spreading branches
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 10 米，枝開展
3 月至 4 月。果期 5 月至 6 月。

facts.en: Southern China; Indochina, Malaysia and Indonesia.
facts.zh: 中國南部；中南半島、馬來西亞及印度尼西亞。

ecology.en: Southern China; Indochina, Malaysia and Indonesia.
ecology.zh: 中國南部；中南半島、馬來西亞及印度尼西亞。

items.en: Tree to 10 m, with spreading branches. Branchlets round or nearly so.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 10 米，枝開展。小枝圓柱形或近圓柱形。

items.en: Opposite, leathery or firmly papery, lanceolate to oblong, 12–25 × 3–4.5 cm. Base broadly cuneate. Apex long-acuminate. Both surfaces have many small translucent glands. Lateral veins 12–16 pairs, prominent beneath.
items.zh: 對生，革質或厚紙質，披針形至長圓形，12–25 × 3–4.5 厘米。基部闊楔形。先端長漸尖。兩面有許多小的透明腺點。側脈 12–16 對，下面明顯。

items.en: Terminal cymes. Flowers greenish white, 3–4 cm across. Petals broadly ovate, 1.4–1.5 cm. Stamens 2–2.8 cm.
items.zh: 聚傘花序頂生。花綠白色，直徑 3–4 厘米。花瓣闊卵形，長 1.4–1.5 厘米。雄蕊長 2–2.8 厘米。

items.en: Pale yellow or red when ripe, globose, 3–5 cm across, fleshy, with oil glands.
items.zh: 成熟時淺黃或紅色，球形，直徑 3–5 厘米，肉質，有油腺。

A cluster of flowers on the branch.
Veins on the lower leaf surface.

One open flower and several buds.

Oil glands on a young leaf.
Fruits at more than one stage.

facts.zh: 攀援灌木
5 月至 6 月。果期 8 月至 11 月。
森林。

items.en: Scandent shrub. Young branches covered with stellate hairs.
items.zh: 攀援灌木。幼枝被星狀毛。

items.en: Leathery, ovate, obovate or elliptic, 8.5–13.5 × 3.5–5.5 cm. Densely short-stellate-hairy beneath, glabrous above. Base cuneate or rounded. Apex acuminate or acute. Secondary veins 8–12 pairs.
items.zh: 革質，卵形、倒卵形或橢圓形，8.5–13.5 × 3.5–5.5 厘米。下面密被短星狀毛，上面無毛。基部楔形或圓。先端漸尖或急尖。側脈 8–12 對。

items.en: Pale yellow, about 1.8 cm across, leaf-opposed or axillary, one to four together. Petals oblong and hairy on both sides. Outer petals 6–8 mm long. Stamens numerous.
items.zh: 花淺黃色，直徑約 1.8 厘米，與葉對生或腋生，1–4 朵。花瓣長圓形，兩面被毛。外輪花瓣長 6–8 毫米。雄蕊多數。

items.en: One to three monocarps, 2.7–3 × 2–2.2 cm, ovate and spiny.
items.zh: 果由 1–3 個分果組成，2.7–3 × 2–2.2 厘米，卵形，有刺。

photos.en: Stellate hairs on the young branch and petiole.
photos.zh: 幼枝和葉柄上的星狀毛。
閉合的淺黃色被毛花蕾。

photos.en: A flower opening, the petals oblong and hairy.
photos.zh: 正在開放的花，花瓣長圓形，被毛。

photos.en: Stellate hairs on the midrib, lower surface.
photos.zh: 葉下面中脈上的星狀毛。

photos.en: The leafy shoot in a thicket.
A spent flower, with many stamens.
The pale lower leaf surface, with young buds.
photos.zh: 淺色的葉下面，並有幼蕾。

facts.zh: 4 月至 5 月。果期 10 月至 12 月。

facts.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Fujian and Taiwan; Vietnam.
facts.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、雲南、福建及台灣；越南。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Fujian and Taiwan; Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、雲南、福建及台灣；越南。

items.en: Tree, 10–25 m. Young branchlets yellowish brown and hairy, later nearly hairless.
items.zh: 喬木，高 10–25 米。幼枝黃褐色，被毛，後來近無毛。

items.en: Odd-pinnate. Leaflets 7–11(–17), oblong-lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, 6–20 × 2–5.5 cm. Base rounded or cuneate, oblique. Apex acuminate. Margin entire. Hairless, rough beneath. Lateral veins 12–16 pairs.
items.zh: 奇數羽狀複葉。小葉 7–11（–17）片，長圓狀披針形至卵狀披針形，6–20 × 2–5.5 厘米。基部圓或楔形，偏斜。先端漸尖。全緣。無毛，下面粗糙。側脈 12–16 對。

items.en: Inflorescence axillary, shorter than the leaves. Calyx cup-shaped, shallowly 3-lobed, 2.5–3 mm. Petals white, twice as long as the calyx.
items.zh: 花序腋生，短於葉。萼杯狀，淺 3 裂，長 2.5–3 毫米。花瓣白色，長為萼的兩倍。

items.en: Drupe ovoid or spindle-shaped, 2.5–3.5 cm, yellow-green, hairless.
items.zh: 核果卵形或紡錘形，長 2.5–3.5 厘米，黃綠色，無毛。

photos.en: The crown of a cultivated tree.
The upper surface of a leaflet.
A rusty-hairy bud, and leaf scars.
photos.zh: 被鏽色毛的芽，並有葉痕。

facts.zh: 3 月至 6 月。果期 7 月至 10 月。
海南。

items.en: Tree, 10–20 m. Young branches and the inflorescence densely rusty-hairy, later nearly hairless. Old branches with many rusty lenticels.
items.zh: 喬木，高 10–20 米。幼枝和花序密被鏽色毛，後來近無毛。老枝有許多鏽色皮孔。

items.en: Bipinnate, the leaf 15–35 cm. Pinnae 6–13 pairs. Leaflets 5–14 pairs, sessile, leathery, oblong, 1.5–2 × 0.6–1 cm. Base narrowed and unequal. Apex obtuse, notched or with a small point.
items.zh: 二回羽狀複葉，長 15–35 厘米。羽片 6–13 對。小葉 5–14 對，無柄，革質，長圓形，1.5–2 × 0.6–1 厘米。基部變狹，不對稱。先端鈍、微凹或有小短尖。

items.en: Racemes almost terminal, 8–12 cm. Flower buds globose, about 8 mm across. Calyx lobes ovate, 8–9 mm, densely rusty-hairy. Petals obovate, 1.5 cm, rusty-hairy along the midvein.
items.zh: 總狀花序近頂生，長 8–12 厘米。花蕾球形，直徑約 8 毫米。萼裂片卵形，長 8–9 毫米，密被鏽色毛。花瓣倒卵形，長 1.5 厘米，沿中脈被鏽色毛。

items.en: Pod reddish brown when ripe, spindle-shaped, 8–13 × 2.5–3 cm, hairless, winged along both sutures. The wings are 5–7 mm wide.
items.zh: 莢果成熟時紅褐色，紡錘形，8–13 × 2.5–3 厘米，無毛，兩邊的縫線有翅。翅寬 5–7 毫米。

A flower and a young pod.

facts.zh: 10 月至次年 5 月。果期 3 月。

facts.en: Guizhou, Sichuan and Yunnan; widely cultivated.
facts.zh: 貴州、四川及雲南；廣泛栽培。

ecology.en: Guizhou, Sichuan and Yunnan; widely cultivated.
ecology.zh: 貴州、四川及雲南；廣泛栽培。

items.en: Tree or shrub, 3–12(–18) m. Branchlets hairless.
items.zh: 喬木或灌木，高 3–12（–18）米。小枝無毛。

items.en: Elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, 4–12 × 2–4 cm. Base cuneate. Apex acuminate. Margin entire, or usually finely toothed on the outer half. Lateral veins 6–10 on each side, sunken above and raised beneath.
items.zh: 橢圓形至橢圓狀披針形，4–12 × 2–4 厘米。基部楔形。先端漸尖。全緣，或通常在遠端一半有細齒。側脈每邊 6–10 條，上面下陷，下面隆起。

items.en: Axillary clusters of 10–20 flowers. Corolla white, yellowish or orange, 3–4 mm, 4-lobed almost to the base.
items.zh: 聚傘花序簇生於葉腋，有花 10–20 朵。花冠白色、淡黃或橙色，長 3–4 毫米，近基部 4 裂。

items.en: Drupe elliptic, slightly oblique, 1–1.5 cm, purple-black when ripe.
items.zh: 核果橢圓形，稍偏斜，長 1–1.5 厘米，成熟時紫黑色。

photos.en: Bark and the roots at the base.
An open yellow flower, four lobes.
A flower, with the leaf veins and teeth.
photos.zh: 一朵花，並有葉脈和鋸齒。

A cream-coloured flower cluster and the leaf.

facts.en: Tree. Bark smooth and peeling, persistent at the base.
facts.zh: 喬木。樹皮平滑，片狀剝落，基部宿存。

facts.en: Cultivated in Guangdong, Guangxi and Yunnan; native to Australia.
facts.zh: 廣東、廣西及雲南有栽培；原產澳洲。

ecology.en: Cultivated in Guangdong, Guangxi and Yunnan; native to Australia.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西及雲南有栽培；原產澳洲。

items.en: Tree. Bark greyish green, smooth, peeling, but persistent at the base of the trunk. Branchlets round and hairy.
items.zh: 喬木。樹皮灰綠色，平滑，片狀剝落，但在樹幹基部宿存。小枝圓柱形，被毛。

items.en: Petiole 1–2 cm, hairy. Blade thinly leathery, ovate, 10–14 × 1–7 cm. Base rounded. Apex acute. Grey and hairy beneath. Juvenile leaves are peltate and ovate, 7–15 × 4–9 cm.
items.zh: 葉柄長 1–2 厘米，被毛。葉片薄革質，卵形，10–14 × 1–7 厘米。基部圓。先端急尖。下面灰色，被毛。幼葉盾狀着生，卵形，7–15 × 4–9 厘米。

items.en: Panicles terminal or axillary, 8–11 cm. Umbels of 3–7 flowers. Flower buds obovoid, about 10 × 6–7 mm. The cap of the bud is 4–4.5 mm, with a rounded tip. Stamens 8–10 mm.
items.zh: 圓錐花序頂生或腋生，長 8–11 厘米。傘形花序有花 3–7 朵。花蕾倒卵形，約 10 × 6–7 毫米。花蓋長 4–4.5 毫米，先端圓。雄蕊長 8–10 毫米。

items.en: Capsule globose, 1–1.3 cm across, narrowed at the top. Three valves, included in the cup.
items.zh: 蒴果球形，直徑 1–1.3 厘米，上部收縮。裂片 3，包在萼筒內。

photos.en: Smooth bark, peeling, and persistent at the base.
photos.zh: 平滑的樹皮，片狀剝落，基部宿存。

3 月至 5 月。果期 5 月至 9 月。

facts.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan and Sichuan; Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand.
facts.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、雲南及四川；越南、柬埔寨及泰國。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan and Sichuan; Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、雲南及四川；越南、柬埔寨及泰國。

items.en: Tree to 17 m. Bark black to brown, split lengthways. Branchlets wrinkled, with appressed short hairs, soon nearly hairless.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 17 米。樹皮黑至褐色，縱裂。小枝有皺紋，被貼伏的短毛，很快近無毛。

items.en: Distichous, thinly leathery, oblong-elliptic to obovate-elliptic, 7–15 × 3–7 cm. Base cuneate to nearly rounded. Apex with a short or long point. Margin entire or irregularly shallowly toothed. Hairless. Secondary veins 6–10 on each side, prominent above.
items.zh: 二列，薄革質，長圓狀橢圓形至倒卵狀橢圓形，7–15 × 3–7 厘米。基部楔形至近圓。先端有短尖或長尖。全緣或不規則淺齒。無毛。側脈每邊 6–10 條，上面明顯。

items.en: Male heads obovoid or oblong, 2.5–12 × 2.7–7 mm. Male flowers with 2–4 perianth lobes.
items.zh: 雄花序頭狀，倒卵形或長圓形，2.5–12 × 2.7–7 毫米。雄花花被裂片 2–4。

items.en: Syncarp red when ripe, nearly globose, coarsely hairy.
items.zh: 聚花果成熟時紅色，近球形，被粗毛。

photos.en: Veins on the lower leaf surface.

facts.zh: 落葉喬木，高可達 15 米。
4 月至 6 月。果期 5 月至 10 月。

facts.en: Cultivated in Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian and Yunnan; native to Brazil.
facts.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、福建及雲南有栽培；原產巴西。

ecology.en: Cultivated in Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian and Yunnan; native to Brazil.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、福建及雲南有栽培；原產巴西。

items.en: Deciduous tree to 15 m. Bark grey.
items.zh: 落葉喬木，高可達 15 米。樹皮灰色。

items.en: Bipinnate, 15–30 cm. Pinnae more than 10 pairs, each 5–10 cm, with 16–24 pairs of leaflets. Leaflets sessile, narrowly elliptic, 0.6–1.2 × 0.2–0.7 cm. Margin entire and slightly rolled under.
items.zh: 二回羽狀複葉，長 15–30 厘米。羽片 10 對以上，每片長 5–10 厘米，有小葉 16–24 對。小葉無柄，狹橢圓形，0.6–1.2 × 0.2–0.7 厘米。全緣，邊緣稍反卷。

items.en: Terminal panicles, many-flowered. Corolla bluish purple and two-lipped. The tube is 3–4 mm, white inside, the throat 0.7–1.2 cm wide.
items.zh: 圓錐花序頂生，多花。花冠藍紫色，二唇形。花冠管長 3–4 毫米，內面白色，喉部寬 0.7–1.2 厘米。

items.en: Capsule nearly round, about 5 cm across.
items.zh: 蒴果近圓形，直徑約 5 厘米。

photos.en: Flowers, a leaf, and a capsule.
A street tree, the crown bipinnate.
photos.zh: 一株行道樹，樹冠為二回羽狀。

facts.zh: 大喬木，高 15–20 米。
3 月至 5 月。果期 7 月至 9 月。

facts.en: Cultivated in Guangdong and Taiwan; native to India and Sri Lanka.
facts.zh: 廣東及台灣有栽培；原產印度及斯里蘭卡。

ecology.en: Cultivated in Guangdong and Taiwan; native to India and Sri Lanka.
ecology.zh: 廣東及台灣有栽培；原產印度及斯里蘭卡。

items.en: Large tree, 15–20 m. Bark greyish white, peeling in flakes. Branches alternate and spreading.
items.zh: 大喬木，高 15–20 米。樹皮灰白色，片狀剝落。枝互生，開展。

items.en: Almost opposite. Petiole shorter than 1.2 cm, with one pair of glands near the top. Blade oblong or elliptic, 10–15(–25) × 5–10 cm. Base cordate and unequal. Apex obtuse or very shortly acute. Lateral veins 15–22 pairs.
items.zh: 近對生。葉柄短於 1.2 厘米，近頂端有腺體 1 對。葉片長圓形或橢圓形，10–15（–25）× 5–10 厘米。基部心形，不對稱。先端鈍或極短急尖。側脈 15–22 對。

items.en: Calyx teeth nearly hairless. Ovary short, densely covered with crisped brown or rusty hairs.
items.zh: 萼齒近無毛。子房短，密被卷曲的褐色或鏽色毛。

items.en: Obovoid, 2–2.6 cm across, ridged. The wings are usually cut straight across, or suddenly narrowed, at the top.
items.zh: 倒卵形，直徑 2–2.6 厘米，有稜。翅的頂端通常截形，或突然變狹。

photos.zh: 小枝上片狀剝落的樹皮。

photos.en: Winged fruits turning pink and green.
photos.zh: 轉為粉紅和綠色的有翅果。

6 月至 8 月。果期 10 月至 12 月。

facts.en: North, east, central, south and southwest China; India, Indonesia, North Korea, Malaysia and Myanmar.
facts.zh: 中國北、東、中、南及西南部；印度、印度尼西亞、朝鮮、馬來西亞及緬甸。

ecology.en: North, east, central, south and southwest China; India, Indonesia, North Korea, Malaysia and Myanmar.
ecology.zh: 中國北、東、中、南及西南部；印度、印度尼西亞、朝鮮、馬來西亞及緬甸。

items.en: Deciduous tree to 25 m.
items.zh: 落葉喬木，高可達 25 米。

items.en: Even-pinnate, 25–50(–90) cm. Leaflets 14–28, opposite or alternate, ovate-lanceolate to oblong-elliptic, 6–17 × 2.5–4.5 cm. Base oblique. Apex long-pointed to acute. Margin sparsely toothed, rarely entire. Hairless, sometimes slightly hairy when young.
items.zh: 偶數羽狀複葉，長 25–50（–90）厘米。小葉 14–28 片，對生或互生，卵狀披針形至長圓狀橢圓形，6–17 × 2.5–4.5 厘米。基部偏斜。先端尾尖至急尖。邊緣疏生鋸齒，很少全緣。無毛，幼時有時稍被毛。

items.en: Panicles as long as the leaves, or longer. Flowers small. Calyx cup-shaped, about 1 mm. Petals 5, white, oblong, 4–5 mm.
items.zh: 圓錐花序與葉等長或更長。花小。萼杯狀，長約 1 毫米。花瓣 5，白色，長圓形，長 4–5 毫米。

items.en: Capsule purplish brown, narrowly ellipsoid, 1–3.5 cm, opening into 5 valves. Seed brown, with a long wing at the tip.
items.zh: 蒴果紫褐色，狹橢圓形，長 1–3.5 厘米，裂成 5 片。種子褐色，先端有長翅。

photos.en: Leaflets and a panicle against the sky.

facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 2–5 米。
幾乎全年。
山地疏林及灌叢。

ecology.en: Thin montane forest and thickets. Common in Hong Kong.
ecology.zh: 山地疏林及灌叢。香港常見。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Fujian and Taiwan; Southeast Asia to Australia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、雲南、福建及台灣；東南亞至澳洲。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, 2–5 m, with male and female flowers on one plant or on separate plants. Young branchlets slender and tawny-hairy.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 2–5 米，雌雄同株或異株。幼枝細，被黃褐色毛。

items.en: Papery, oblong, oblong-elliptic or obovate-oblong, 3–9 × 1.5–4 cm. Base broadly cuneate to rounded. Apex acute or obtuse. Rough above, greenish and hairy beneath. Lateral veins 9–12 on each side, raised beneath.
items.zh: 紙質，長圓形、長圓狀橢圓形或倒卵狀長圓形，3–9 × 1.5–4 厘米。基部闊楔形至圓。先端急尖或鈍。上面粗糙，下面帶綠色，被毛。側脈每邊 9–12 條，下面隆起。

items.en: Very small, in stalkless round clusters in the leaf axils. Male flowers have five triangular calyx lobes and five stamens joined in the lower half. Female flowers have two styles, each split in two.
items.zh: 花很小，無柄，圓球狀簇生於葉腋。雄花萼裂片 5，三角形，雄蕊 5，下半部合生。雌花花柱 2，各 2 裂。

items.en: Drupe nearly globose, 4–7 × 5 mm, 2-locular. Seeds brown-red.
items.zh: 核果近球形，4–7 × 5 毫米，2 室。種子棕紅色。

The upper surface of a leaf.

facts.zh: 草本，高約 50 厘米。
山澗。

ecology.en: Ravines. Mount Gough, Aberdeen, Pok Fu Lam, Victoria Peak, Beacon Hill and Ma On Shan.
ecology.zh: 山澗。歌賦山、香港仔、薄扶林、太平山、筆架山及馬鞍山。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui and Fujian.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、湖南、江西、安徽及福建。

items.en: Herb, about 50 cm. Stems four-angled, grooved, with hairs pointing backwards.
items.zh: 草本，高約 50 厘米。莖四稜，有溝，被倒向的毛。

items.en: Elliptic to oblong-elliptic or ovate, 1–4(–7) × 0.5–2(–3.5) cm. Base cuneate. Apex acute or obtuse. Margin entire. Many cystoliths on the upper surface. Lateral veins 3–6 pairs.
items.zh: 橢圓形至長圓狀橢圓形或卵形，1–4（–7）× 0.5–2（–3.5）厘米。基部楔形。先端急尖或鈍。全緣。上面有許多鐘乳體。側脈 3–6 對。

items.en: One to several in each leaf axil. Bracts leaf-like, round to obovate, 5–8 × 3–6 mm. Corolla 0.8–1 cm, white, two-lipped, with two lines of purple-red streaks. Two stamens, the anther cells one above the other.
items.zh: 花 1 至數朵簇生於葉腋。苞片葉狀，圓形至倒卵形，5–8 × 3–6 毫米。花冠長 0.8–1 厘米，白色，二唇形，有紫紅色條紋兩行。雄蕊 2，藥室上下排列。

items.en: Capsule about 8 mm, hairless, 4-seeded.
items.zh: 蒴果長約 8 毫米，無毛，有種子 4 顆。

photos.en: A white flower, the lower lip streaked purple-red.
photos.zh: 一朵白花，下唇有紫紅色條紋。

photos.en: Two stamens, the anther cells one above the other.
photos.zh: 雄蕊兩枚，藥室上下排列。

photos.en: The plant on a rock ledge.
Cystoliths on the upper leaf surface.
A square stem and an opposite leaf.
photos.zh: 四稜的莖和一片對生葉。

facts.zh: 攀援植物，長可達 12 米。
6 月至 12 月。果期 12 月至次年 3 月。
灌木林及灌叢。

ecology.en: Fujian, Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Hunan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang and Taiwan; India to Myanmar and Malaysia.
ecology.zh: 福建、海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、湖南、江西、浙江及台灣；印度至緬甸及馬來西亞。

items.en: Climber, to 12 m or longer.
items.zh: 攀援植物，長可達 12 米或更長。

items.en: Opposite. Blade ovate to very narrowly ovate, 5–12 × 2–6 cm, thin to papery. Base broadly cuneate to nearly rounded. Apex acuminate. Lateral veins 5–7 pairs.
items.zh: 對生。葉片卵形至極狹卵形，5–12 × 2–6 厘米，膜質至紙質。基部闊楔形至近圓。先端漸尖。側脈 5–7 對。

items.en: Thyrses. Corolla yellow to orange, 1.2–1.9 cm. The tube is brownish outside, and the mouth has reddish spots. Lobes ovate, 5–9 mm. Anthers exserted.
items.zh: 聚傘圓錐花序。花冠黃至橙色，長 1.2–1.9 厘米。花冠管外面帶褐色，喉部有紅斑。裂片卵形，長 5–9 毫米。花藥伸出。

items.en: Capsule ellipsoid to ovoid, 10–14 × 6–8 mm, smooth and hairless. Seeds winged all round.
items.zh: 蒴果橢圓形至卵形，10–14 × 6–8 毫米，平滑無毛。種子周圍有翅。

photos.en: A yellow flower, face on, with red spots in the mouth.
photos.zh: 一朵黃花，正面，喉部有紅斑。

photos.en: A thyrse, the flower mouths spotted red.
photos.zh: 一條聚傘圓錐花序，花喉有紅斑。
綠色和成熟的蒴果在一起。

facts.en: Evergreen shrub or small tree, 1–3(–7) m.
facts.zh: 常綠灌木或小喬木，高 1–3（–7）米。
1 月至 4 月。果期 10 月至 12 月。

facts.en: Rocky outcrops, steep hillside forest, and streamsides.
facts.zh: 石崖、陡坡林地及溪邊。

ecology.en: Native. Locally restricted. Listed in Rare and Precious Plants of Hong Kong.
ecology.zh: 原生。分布局限。列入《香港稀有及珍貴植物》。

items.en: Evergreen shrub or small tree, 1–3(–7) m, much branched. Young branchlets are shortly glandular-hairy.
items.zh: 常綠灌木或小喬木，高 1–3（–7）米，多分枝。幼枝有短腺毛。

items.en: Leaves crowded towards the branch tips. Blade thin-leathery to papery, rhombic-elliptic to oblanceolate, 3.2–7.6 × 1.4–3.0 cm, base cuneate, apex acute to retuse, margin entire and slightly deflexed.
items.zh: 葉聚生於枝端。葉片薄革質至紙質，菱狀橢圓形至倒披針形，長 3.2–7.6 厘米，寬 1.4–3.0 厘米，基部楔形，先端急尖至微凹，全緣，邊緣稍反卷。

items.en: Flowers solitary, rarely paired, on a glandular-hairy pedicel 0.7–1.4 cm. Calyx 5-lobed. Corolla subrotate, white to pale lilac, with magenta spots.
items.zh: 花單生，稀成對。花梗長 0.7–1.4 厘米，有腺毛。萼 5 裂。花冠近輻狀，白色至淺紫色，有洋紅斑點。

items.en: Young capsules are green and glandular-hairy, on curved stalks.
items.zh: 幼果綠色，有腺毛，果柄彎曲。

photos.en: Two pale flowers, white to lilac, with magenta dots on the upper side and five stamens.
photos.zh: 兩朵淺色花，白至淡紫，上側有洋紅色點，雄蕊五枚。

photos.en: Wet white flowers in a cluster, with pointed buds among glossy leaves.
photos.zh: 一簇沾濕的白花，光亮葉間有尖的花蕾。

photos.en: A tight cluster of green scaly flower buds at the tip of wet leaves.
photos.zh: 濕葉先端，一簇緊密的綠色鱗片狀花蕾。

photos.en: Young globose capsules, glandular and warty, the styles still on them.
photos.zh: 幼嫩的球形蒴果，具腺、有疣，花柱仍在。

photos.en: A red hairy flush of new leaves on a woody branch.
photos.zh: 木質枝上帶紅的被毛新葉。

facts.zh: 直立或攀援草本，高 0.5–2 米。
3 月至 12 月。果期 8 月至 12 月。
沼澤及濕地。

ecology.en: Native. Listed in Rare and Precious Plants of Hong Kong.
ecology.zh: 原生。列入《香港稀有及珍貴植物》。

ecology.en: Guangdong and Hainan; Indochina and Malaysia.
ecology.zh: 廣東及海南；中南半島及馬來西亞。

items.en: Erect or climbing herb, 0.5–2 m. Young parts densely tomentose, later glabrescent.
items.zh: 直立或攀援草本，高 0.5–2 米。幼部密被絨毛，後變無毛。

items.en: Basal leaves form a dense rosette. The pitcher is narrowly ovoid to terete, 2–6 cm long, 2-winged.
items.zh: 基生葉成密蓮座。捕蟲囊狹卵形至圓柱形，長 2–6 厘米，有兩翼。

items.en: Cauline pitchers are subcylindrical, slightly enlarged at the base, 8–16 cm long and 2–5 cm across, often with purplish red dots.
items.zh: 莖生捕蟲囊近圓柱形，基部稍膨大，長 8–16 厘米，直徑 2–5 厘米，常有紫紅斑點。

items.en: Flowers are carried on a raceme. The fruit is a capsule.
items.zh: 花排成總狀花序。果為蒴果。

photos.en: A green lower pitcher with fringed wings, the mouth open, the tendril from a leaf tip.
photos.zh: 綠色下位瓶，翼有緣毛，口部開放，卷鬚生自葉端。

photos.en: A pale upper pitcher hanging among bleached ferns, the lid reddish.
photos.zh: 淺色上位瓶垂於枯白的蕨葉間，蓋帶紅。

photos.en: Many green and red-spotted pitchers on a rocky bank, some lids open and some shut.
photos.zh: 石岸上許多綠色帶紅斑的瓶，蓋有開有合。

photos.en: A mass of purple-red male racemes among fern fronds.
photos.zh: 蕨葉間一大片紫紅色雄性總狀花序。

photos.en: A dried raceme of brown four-valved capsules, over the water.
photos.zh: 水面上的乾總狀果序，褐色蒴果四瓣裂。

photos.en: Sprawling stems in grass, the leaves red-spotted, with pitchers and racemes.
photos.zh: 草叢中匍匐的莖，葉有紅斑，並有瓶和花序。

photos.en: A young pitcher still forming at the coiled tip of a hairy tendril.
photos.zh: 被毛卷鬚的拳卷先端，幼瓶正在形成。
