facts.zh: 常綠灌木或小喬木。
5 月至 6 月。果期 9 月至 10 月。
常綠闊葉林。

items.en: Evergreen shrub or small tree. Young twigs are green and hairy. Stipular scars nearly reach the petiole apex.
items.zh: 常綠灌木或小喬木。幼枝綠色，有毛。托葉痕幾乎到達葉柄先端。

items.en: Leaves elliptic to narrowly obovate-elliptic, 7–14(–20) × 2–4.5(–6.5) cm, leathery, glossy above, pale and more or less hairy on the midvein beneath.
items.zh: 葉橢圓形至狹倒卵狀橢圓形，長 7–14（–20）厘米，寬 2–4.5（–6.5）厘米，革質，上面亮綠色，下面淺色，中脈多少有毛。

items.en: Flowers globose, 1.5–2 cm across, very fragrant. Peduncle densely pale-yellow silky. Tepals 9: the outer three pale green, the inner six white and fleshy.
items.zh: 花近球形，直徑 1.5–2 厘米，很香。花梗密被淡黃絹毛。花被片 9：外輪 3 片淺綠色，內輪 6 片白色、肉質。

photos.en: A flower just opening, the outer tepals green and the inner ones white, among leathery elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 一朵正開的花，外輪花被片綠色，內輪白色，生於革質橢圓葉間。

photos.en: A small evergreen tree with several stems, beside a stone-walled path.
photos.zh: 常綠小樹，數幹並生，位於石牆路旁。

photos.en: Two open flowers together, white inside and green outside, among leathery elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 兩朵並開的花，內白外綠，生於革質橢圓葉間。

photos.en: Stipular scars along a green petiole, with hairs at the node.
photos.zh: 綠色葉柄上的托葉痕，節上有毛。

photos.en: Pale hairs along the midvein on the underside of a leaf.

publication.text: Hooker's J. Bot. Kew Gard. Misc. 4: 327 (1852)

facts.en: Evergreen shrub or small tree, to 6 m.
facts.zh: 常綠灌木或小喬木，高可達 6 米。
3 月至 4 月。果期 5 月至 12 月。
林地及灌叢。

items.en: Evergreen shrub or small tree, to 6 m. Current year's branchlets minutely pubescent, later glabrescent.
items.zh: 常綠灌木或小喬木，高可達 6 米。當年枝有微毛，後變無毛。

items.en: Petiole very short, 2–4 mm. Blade oblong-oblanceolate, 5–15 × 2–4 cm, margin minutely crenate or serrate, lateral veins 9–11 on each side.
items.zh: 葉柄很短，長 2–4 毫米。葉片長圓狀倒披針形，長 5–15 厘米，寬 2–4 厘米，邊緣有細圓齒或鋸齒，側脈每邊 9–11 條。

items.en: Flowers 4-merous, fasciculate on the previous year's growth. Staminate fascicles 3–9-flowered. Corolla rotate, about 7 mm across.
items.zh: 花 4 數，簇生於去年生枝上。雄花簇有花 3–9 朵。花冠輻狀，直徑約 7 毫米。

items.en: Fruits are small and green while young, in clusters on the leafy shoots.
items.zh: 幼果小而綠色，成簇生於帶葉的枝上。

photos.en: Pale yellow four-parted male flowers in axillary clusters on old wood.
photos.zh: 老枝上腋生成簇的淺黃色四數雄花。

photos.en: A male flower in close view, four-parted, the anthers pale, with buds on the old twig.
photos.zh: 雄花近景，四數，花藥淺色，老枝上並有花蕾。

photos.en: Young green globose fruits, the stigma a brown disc at the tip.
photos.zh: 幼嫩的綠色球形果，先端柱頭呈褐色盤狀。

photos.en: Pale four-parted flowers and buds on a green twig, the leaves on very short petioles.
photos.zh: 綠色小枝上的淺色四數花和花蕾，葉柄極短。

photos.en: Many clusters of green globose fruits on a leafy branch.
photos.zh: 帶葉枝上許多成簇的綠色球形果。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 無莖的多年生草本。
5 月至次年 2 月。果期 8 月至次年 2 月。

facts.en: Wet shady places by streams, or on rocks in valleys.
facts.zh: 溪邊陰濕處，或山谷石上。

items.en: Perennial herb, stemless. Leaves basal.
items.zh: 多年生草本，無莖。葉基生。

items.en: Petiole 4–8 cm, villose. Blade papery, ovate to oblong, (4–)5–10 × (2–)3.5–8 cm, appressed-pubescent and pilose, margin repand to crenate.
items.zh: 葉柄長 4–8 厘米，被長柔毛。葉片紙質，卵形至長圓形，長（4–）5–10 厘米，寬（2–）3.5–8 厘米，貼伏短柔毛並有長毛，邊緣波狀至圓齒。

items.en: Cymes axillary, 2–6-flowered, peduncle 8–14 cm, villose. Corolla purple or white, 3.5–4 cm, with two yellow lines inside the tube.
items.zh: 聚繖花序腋生，有花 2–6 朵，花葶長 8–14 厘米，被長柔毛。花冠紫色或白色，長 3.5–4 厘米，筒內有兩條黃紋。

items.en: Capsules elongate, about 4 cm, on the stemless plant.
items.zh: 蒴果伸長，長約 4 厘米，生於無莖的植株上。

photos.en: A colony of stemless plants on wet rock, the open flowers pale purple.
photos.zh: 濕石上的一群無莖植物，開放的花淺紫色。

photos.en: A stemless rosette on mossy rock, with several pale flower stalks.
photos.zh: 苔石上的無莖蓮座，抽出數枝淺色花葶。

photos.en: A pale purple two-lipped flower, with yellow lines in the throat.
photos.zh: 淺紫色二唇花，喉部有黃色條紋。

photos.en: A stemless rosette with long slender green capsules on dark stalks.
photos.zh: 無莖蓮座，深色花葶上有細長的綠色蒴果。

photos.en: Stemless rosettes on mossy rock, the leaves with pale netted veins.
photos.zh: 苔石上的無莖蓮座，葉有淺色網脈。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 木質藤本。
4 月至 6 月。果期 6 月至 11 月。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Hainan, Guangxi, Guizhou, Fujian, Jiangxi and Hunan; Laos and Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 廣東、海南、廣西、貴州、福建、江西及湖南；老撾及越南。

items.en: Bark pale or greyish brown, lenticels usually conspicuous.
items.zh: 樹皮淺色或灰褐色，皮孔通常明顯。

items.en: Petiole 5–8(–10) mm. Blade elliptic to narrowly elliptic or long-obovate, 4–10 × 2.5 cm, leathery.
items.zh: 葉柄長 5–8（–10）毫米。葉片橢圓形至狹橢圓形或長倒卵形，長 4–10 厘米，寬 2.5 厘米，革質。

items.en: Male inflorescences simple or once branched, with 5–10 involucral collars.
items.zh: 雄球花序不分枝或一次分枝，有 5–10 輪總苞領。

items.en: Female spikes are slender and green, hanging from the leafy nodes.
items.zh: 雌球花穗細長、綠色，自帶葉的節上垂下。

photos.en: A once-branched male spike with ringed collars, beside a glossy elliptic leaf.
photos.zh: 一次分枝的雄穗，環節明顯，旁有一枚光亮的橢圓形葉。

photos.en: A young female spike, the green ovules pointed and the nodes stacked.
photos.zh: 幼雌穗，綠色胚珠尖出，節層層相疊。

photos.en: A close view of the ringed collars on a male spike, beside an elliptic leaf.
photos.zh: 雄穗近景，環節清晰，旁有一枚橢圓形葉。

photos.en: A branched cluster of green male spikes among elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 橢圓形葉間，一簇分枝的綠色雄穗。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 假莖高 2–3 米。
4 月至 6 月。果期 7 月至 10 月。

facts.en: Common in Hong Kong; also cultivated (including variegated cultivars).
facts.zh: 香港常見；亦見栽培（包括花葉栽培品種）。

ecology.en: Common in Hong Kong; also cultivated (including variegated cultivars).
ecology.zh: 香港常見；亦見栽培（包括花葉栽培品種）。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan and Taiwan; Vietnam to India and Malesia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、雲南及台灣；越南至印度及馬來群島。

items.en: Pseudostems 2–3 m. Ligule 5–10 mm, hairy beneath.
items.zh: 假莖高 2–3 米。葉舌長 5–10 毫米，背面有毛。

items.en: Leaf blade lanceolate, 30–60 × 5–10 cm, base attenuate, apex acuminate with a spiral mucro, glabrous except the pubescent margin.
items.zh: 葉片披針形，長 30–60 厘米，寬 5–10 厘米，基部漸狹，先端漸尖並有旋卷的尖頭，除邊緣有毛外無毛。

items.en: Panicles drooping, to 30 cm. Rachis purple-red and velvety. Bracteoles white with a pink apex. Labellum yellow with purple-red stripes, 4–6 cm, crisped.
items.zh: 圓錐花序下垂，長可達 30 厘米。花序軸紫紅色，被絨毛。小苞片白色，先端粉紅。唇瓣黃色，有紫紅條紋，長 4–6 厘米，邊緣皺波狀。

items.en: Capsule vermilion, globose, about 2 cm across, ribbed, with a persistent calyx. Young fruits are green and hairy.
items.zh: 蒴果朱紅色，近球形，直徑約 2 厘米，有棱，宿存萼。幼果綠色，有毛。

photos.en: A drooping panicle, the bracts white to pink and shell-like.
photos.zh: 下垂的圓錐花序，苞片白至粉紅色，形如貝殼。

photos.en: A yellow lip, crisped, with purple-red stripes, and milky lobes tipped pink.
photos.zh: 黃色唇瓣皺曲，有紫紅色條紋，乳白色裂片先端帶粉紅。

photos.en: A young green capsule, densely hairy, with the remains of the calyx on a hairy stalk.
photos.zh: 幼嫩的綠色蒴果，密被毛，毛茸茸的果序上留有萼的殘跡。

photos.en: Tall pseudostems with long lanceolate leaves.
photos.zh: 高大的假莖，葉長披針形。

photos.en: White bracts tipped pink, shell-like, enclosing the buds.
photos.zh: 白色苞片先端帶粉紅，貝殼狀，包着花蕾。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 攀援灌木，高 1–5 米。
3 月至 5 月。果期 9 月至 11 月。
低地次生林或灌叢。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian, Taiwan, Yunnan and Guizhou.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、福建、台灣、雲南及貴州。

items.en: Scandent shrub, 1–5 m. Spines on the branches straight, broad and flat at the base.
items.zh: 攀援灌木，高 1–5 米。枝刺直，基部寬而扁。

items.en: Leaves imparipinnate. Leaflets (3–)5–11, opposite, 3–12 × 1.5–6 cm, margin sparsely shallow-dentate, the teeth glandular-dotted.
items.zh: 葉奇數羽狀複葉。小葉（3–）5–11 片，對生，長 3–12 厘米，寬 1.5–6 厘米，邊緣有疏淺齒，齒有腺點。

items.en: Flowers yellowish green, 4-merous, axillary at the shoot apex, and also on old wood.
items.zh: 花黃綠色，4 數，生於枝端葉腋，也可從老枝上開出。

items.en: Fruits green and gland-dotted while young. A dried fruit may stay on the shoot beside the next flowers.
items.zh: 幼果綠色，有腺點。乾果可留在枝上，旁邊再開新花。

photos.en: A scrambling mass climbing a corrugated wall, the leaves pinnate.
photos.zh: 攀在瓦楞牆上的一大叢，葉羽狀。

photos.en: Young green follicles, globose, the skin dotted with oil glands.
photos.zh: 幼嫩的綠色蓇葖，球形，果皮密布油點。

photos.en: Open male flowers, four-parted, the stamens standing out, the petals yellowish green.
photos.zh: 開放的雄花，四數，雄蕊伸出，花瓣黃綠色。

photos.en: Male flowers on old wood, the stamens standing out from yellowish-green petals.
photos.zh: 老枝上的雄花，黃綠色花瓣間雄蕊伸出。

photos.en: A broad-based spine on a woody stem, with red flower buds on the rachis.
photos.zh: 木質莖上基部寬的刺，花序軸上有紅色花蕾。

photos.en: Open yellowish flowers beside a black seed from a split follicle.
photos.zh: 開放的淡黃色花，旁有一顆從開裂蓇葖露出的黑色種子。

reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 草質纏繞藤本。
7 月至 10 月。果期 8 月至 11 月。

facts.en: Margins of forest, thickets, ravines and river banks.
facts.zh: 林緣、灌叢、山澗及河岸。

ecology.en: Widespread in southern and central China; also Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, India, Africa and Oceania.
ecology.zh: 中國南部及中部廣布；亦見於朝鮮、日本、東南亞、印度、非洲及大洋洲。

items.en: Herbaceous vine. Stem twining to the left, glabrous, bearing bulbils in the leaf axils. Tuber usually solitary, globular to pyriform, 4–10 cm thick.
items.zh: 草質藤本。莖向左纏繞，無毛，葉腋生珠芽。塊莖通常單生，球形至梨形，厚 4–10 厘米。

items.en: Leaves alternate, simple, broadly cordate, 5–15(–26) × 4–14(–26) cm, apex caudate-acuminate, glabrous.
items.zh: 葉互生，單葉，寬心形，長 5–15（–26）厘米，寬 4–14（–26）厘米，先端尾狀漸尖，無毛。

items.en: Round bulbils sit in the leaf axils.
items.zh: 圓形珠芽生於葉腋。

items.en: Male spikes usually clustered in the leaf axils, drooping, 3–10 cm or longer; perianth purple. Female spikes often two or more together, 20–50 cm.
items.zh: 雄花穗通常簇生於葉腋，下垂，長 3–10 厘米或更長；花被紫色。雌花穗常 2 條或更多並生，長 20–50 厘米。

items.en: Capsule of three flat wing-like lobes, 1.5–3 cm, straw-coloured.
items.zh: 蒴果有 3 枚扁平的翅狀裂片，長 1.5–3 厘米，禾稈色。

photos.en: Two warty aerial bulbils in a leaf axil, on a stem spotted purple.
photos.zh: 葉腋生兩枚疣狀氣生珠芽，莖有紫色斑點。

photos.en: Broad heart-shaped leaves, alternate, on a twining stem.
photos.zh: 寬心形葉互生，生於纏繞的莖上。

photos.en: A drooping male spike, purple toward the tip and white below, with green buds at the base.
photos.zh: 下垂的雄穗，先端紫色、下部白色，基部有綠色花蕾。

photos.en: Many long pendulous female spikes among heart-shaped leaves on a twining stem.
photos.zh: 纏繞莖上的心形葉間，許多長而下垂的雌穗。

photos.en: Heart-shaped leaves twining up a trunk.
photos.zh: 心形葉沿樹幹纏繞上升。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 20 米。
4 月至 6 月。果期 10 月至 12 月。
次生林。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Hunan, Jiangxi and Fujian; northern Thailand and northern Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、湖南、江西及福建；泰國北部及越南北部。

items.en: Tree, to 20 m. Bud-scales and the tips of young leaves are reddish purple or yellowish brown puberulent.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 20 米。芽鱗及幼葉先端被紅紫色或黃褐色微柔毛。

items.en: Leaves thickly papery, elliptic to obovate-elliptic, usually 11–23(–30) × 5–9 cm, margin undulate and crenate on the lower half. Lateral veins 15–20(–28) on each side.
items.zh: 葉厚紙質，橢圓形至倒卵狀橢圓形，通常長 11–23（–30）厘米，寬 5–9 厘米，下半部邊緣波狀並有圓齒。側脈每邊 15–20（–28）條。

items.en: Spikes erect, 8–15 cm, forming a terminal panicle. Male spikes are numerous.
items.zh: 穗狀花序直立，長 8–15 厘米，組成頂生圓錐花序。雄花穗多數。

items.en: Cupule ovoid to ellipsoid, 1–1.5 cm across, enclosing the nut when young, later splitting into 2–3(–4) segments.
items.zh: 殼斗卵形至橢圓形，直徑 1–1.5 厘米，幼時全包堅果，後裂成 2–3（–4）片。

photos.en: A tree crown covered in pale cream flower spikes, in secondary woodland.
photos.zh: 次生林中的樹冠，覆滿淺乳白色花穗。

photos.en: A canopy full of dense cream male catkins, against a blue sky.
photos.zh: 樹冠開滿密集的乳白色雄柔荑花序，襯着藍天。

photos.en: A young green ovoid cupule on wet litter, the scales triangular and overlapping, not spiny.
photos.zh: 濕落葉上的幼嫩綠色卵形殼斗，鱗片三角形、覆瓦狀，不具刺。

photos.en: Elliptic to obovate leaves, with many lateral veins and a wavy, crenate margin.
photos.zh: 橢圓形至倒卵形葉，側脈多，邊緣波狀而具圓齒。

photos.en: A single green cupule, the scales overlapping, some already turning brown.
photos.zh: 單一的綠色殼斗，鱗片覆瓦狀，部分已轉褐。

photos.en: Male flowers in close view, the anthers cream.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 多年生匍匐草本。
4 月至 11 月。

facts.en: Forests and wet places near villages.
facts.zh: 林地及村落附近的濕地。

ecology.en: Fujian, Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan and Xizang; India to Malesia.
ecology.zh: 福建、海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南及西藏；印度至馬來群島。

items.en: Perennial stoloniferous herb, most parts very finely powdery-pubescent at least when young. Fertile stems more or less erect.
items.zh: 多年生匍匐草本，至少幼時大部分有極細的粉狀短柔毛。能育莖近直立。

items.en: Leaves toward the stem base ovate to suborbicular, those toward the apex smaller, 7–14 × 6–13 cm, base cordate to rounded. Veins 7, very prominent beneath.
items.zh: 莖基部的葉卵形至近圓形，近先端的較小，長 7–14 厘米，寬 6–13 厘米，基部心形至圓形。脈 7 條，背面很明顯。

items.en: Flowers unisexual, in leaf-opposed spikes. Male spikes white, 1.5–2.5 cm long and 2–3 mm thick.
items.zh: 花單性，穗狀花序與葉對生。雄花穗白色，長 1.5–2.5 厘米，粗 2–3 毫米。

photos.en: A short white spike opposite a leaf, with a younger green spike beside it.
photos.zh: 葉對生的短白花穗，旁有一枝較幼的綠穗。

photos.en: A low colony spreading along the edge of a wall and a path.
photos.zh: 矮生的一群，沿牆腳和路緣展開。

photos.en: The surface of a white spike, the bracts peltate, on a green stalk.
photos.zh: 白色花穗的表面，苞片盾狀，生於綠色梗上。

photos.en: Heart-shaped leaves covering a fence, with a few short white spikes.
photos.zh: 心形葉覆在鐵絲網上，間有少數短的白色花穗。

facts.en: Evergreen tree to 20 m tall, 1 m in d.b.h.; current year's growth usually glabrous.
facts.zh: 常綠喬木，高可達 20 米，胸徑可達 1 米；當年枝通常無毛。
3 月至 4 月。果期 10 月至 12 月。
常綠林。

items.en: Evergreen tree to 20 m tall, 1 m in d.b.h.; current year's growth usually glabrous.
items.zh: 常綠喬木，高可達 20 米，胸徑可達 1 米；當年枝通常無毛。

items.en: Leaves stipulate; petioles 8–20 mm. Blade thin-leathery or papery, ovate, obovate or elliptic, 4–9 × 1.8–4 cm, base cuneate or obtuse, apex shortly acuminate (acumen deltoid, 5–8 mm), margin entire, glabrous on both surfaces.
items.zh: 葉有托葉；葉柄長 8–20 毫米。葉片薄革質或紙質，卵形、倒卵形或橢圓形，長 4–9 厘米，寬 1.8–4 厘米，基部楔形或鈍，先端短漸尖（尖頭三角形，長 5–8 毫米），全緣，兩面無毛。

items.en: Inflorescences cymose, 4–6-flowered, solitary, axillary, on current year's growth. Staminate flowers 4-merous; corolla rotate, 6 mm across; stamens longer than petals. Pistillate flowers white, 5–7-merous; ovary ovoid-conic, stigma subglobose.
items.zh: 聚傘花序，有花 4–6 朵，單生於當年枝葉腋。雄花 4 數；花冠輻狀，直徑 6 毫米；雄蕊長於花瓣。雌花白色，5–7 數；子房卵狀圓錐形，柱頭近球形。

items.en: Fruits 6–8 mm in diam.; stigma discoid. Pyrenes 5–7, lanceolate in outline, trigonous in cross-section.
items.zh: 果直徑 6–8 毫米；柱頭盤狀。分核 5–7 枚，輪廓披針形，橫切面三角形。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Guizhou, Hunan, Hubei, Jiangxi, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, Taiwan; Korea, Japan, N Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、雲南、貴州、湖南、湖北、江西、安徽、江蘇、浙江、福建、臺灣；朝鮮、日本、越南北部。

photos.en: A small multi-stemmed tree on a hillside, pale bark, laden with red fruit.
photos.zh: 山坡上的多幹小樹，樹皮淺色，結滿紅色果。

photos.en: Axillary cymes of small white flowers on a leafy branch.
photos.zh: 帶葉枝上腋生的聚傘花序，花小、白色。

photos.en: Grey-brown rough bark, fissured, with lichen, and fruiting sprays behind.
photos.zh: 灰褐色粗糙樹皮，縱裂，有地衣，後方有結果的小枝。

photos.en: Young green fruits in a cyme, on short stalks, beside a glossy leaf.
photos.zh: 聚傘果序上的幼嫩青果，果柄短，旁有光亮的葉。

facts.en: Tree. Branches brown, with scattered labiate lenticels; young branches with bud scale scars at the base.
facts.zh: 喬木。枝褐色，有散生唇形皮孔；幼枝基部有芽鱗痕。
2 月。果期 4 月至 5 月。
混交林。

items.en: Tree. Branches brown, with scattered labiate lenticels; young branches with bud scale scars at the base.
items.zh: 喬木。枝褐色，有散生唇形皮孔；幼枝基部有芽鱗痕。

items.en: Leaves usually aggregate at apex of branchlets; petioles slender, 8–15 mm. Blade leathery or thin-leathery, oblanceolate, 6.5–13 × 2–3.6 cm, base attenuate, apex caudate-acuminate, ± falcate; lateral veins 10–12 on each side of midvein.
items.zh: 葉常聚生於枝端；葉柄細，長 8–15 毫米。葉片革質或薄革質，倒披針形，長 6.5–13 厘米，寬 2–3.6 厘米，基部漸狹，先端尾狀漸尖，多少鐮狀；側脈每邊 10–12 條。

items.en: Infructescence 7–9 cm, borne on the base of branchlets of the current year's growth, greyish puberulous. Fruit globose, ca. 7 mm in diam.; fruiting pedicels ca. 4 mm, with peduncles purplish reddish when fresh.
items.zh: 果序長 7–9 厘米，生於當年枝基部，被灰色微柔毛。果球形，直徑約 7 毫米；果梗長約 4 毫米，與序軸鮮時紫紅色。

photos.en: A flowering canopy among other trees.
A flowering branch with oblanceolate leaves.
A fruiting crown, the fruits globose among the leaves.
photos.zh: 結果的樹冠，球形果生於葉間。

photos.en: Leaves on the branches after the fruit has gone.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Trees to 15 m tall. Branchlets slender, glabrous or sparsely pilose.
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 15 米。小枝細，無毛或疏被柔毛。
4 月至 5 月。果期 5 月至 8 月。
常綠闊葉林。

items.en: Trees to 15 m tall. Branchlets slender, glabrous or sparsely pilose.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 15 米。小枝細，無毛或疏被柔毛。

items.en: Petioles 1–1.5 cm. Blade narrowly obovate, 4–8 × 2–4 cm, papery, base narrowly cuneate, apex ± rounded, margin crenate, glabrous; lateral veins usually 5–6 pairs.
items.zh: 葉柄長 1–1.5 厘米。葉片狹倒卵形，長 4–8 厘米，寬 2–4 厘米，紙質，基部狹楔形，先端近圓，邊緣有圓齒，無毛；側脈通常 5–6 對。

items.en: Racemes axillary, 4–6 cm, glabrous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals 5, lanceolate, ca. 4 mm. Petals 5, obovate, laciniate on distal half (segments 10–12). Stamens ca. 15.
items.zh: 總狀花序腋生，長 4–6 厘米，無毛。花兩性。萼片 5，披針形，長約 4 毫米。花瓣 5，倒卵形，上部細裂（裂片 10–12）。雄蕊約 15。

items.en: Drupe ellipsoid, 1–1.2 cm; endocarp thinly bony, with 3 ventral sutures.
items.zh: 核果橢圓形，長 1–1.2 厘米；內果皮薄骨质，有 3 條腹縫。

ecology.en: Fujian, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Hunan, Guangdong, Hainan, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan; Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 福建、浙江、江西、湖南、廣東、海南、廣西、貴州、雲南、四川；越南。

photos.en: A grey trunk in forest, with a flowering branch and some red leaves.
photos.zh: 林中灰色樹幹，旁有花枝和一些紅葉。

photos.en: An open white flower with laciniate petals, beside a narrowly obovate leaf.
photos.zh: 開放的白花，花瓣條裂，旁有一枚狹倒卵形葉。

photos.en: A flowering shrub-tree in forest, the crown massed with white flowers.
photos.zh: 林中開花的灌木狀小樹，樹冠開滿白花。

photos.en: An open flower in close view, the anthers dark at the tip and not awned.
photos.zh: 開放的花近景，花藥先端深色，不具芒。

photos.en: A whorl of leaves with an open flower in a raceme.
photos.zh: 輪生的葉，總狀花序中有一朵開放的花。

photos.en: A raceme of green ovoid buds, the leaves narrowly obovate and crenate.
photos.zh: 綠色卵形花蕾組成的總狀花序，葉狹倒卵形、具圓齒。

facts.en: Differs from var. rotundifolia by leaves ovate-oblong, 2.5–5.5 × 1–2.2 cm, base cuneate or obtuse, apex obtuse or shortly acuminate; reticulation of veins conspicuous on both surfaces.
facts.zh: 與原變種不同在於葉卵狀長圓形，長 2.5–5.5 厘米，寬 1–2.2 厘米，基部楔形或鈍，先端鈍或短漸尖；網脈兩面明顯。
8 月至 9 月。果期 9 月至 11 月。
疏林、灌叢。

items.en: Differs from var. rotundifolia by leaves ovate-oblong, 2.5–5.5 × 1–2.2 cm, base cuneate or obtuse, apex obtuse or shortly acuminate; reticulation of veins conspicuous on both surfaces.
items.zh: 與原變種不同在於葉卵狀長圓形，長 2.5–5.5 厘米，寬 1–2.2 厘米，基部楔形或鈍，先端鈍或短漸尖；網脈兩面明顯。

items.en: Leaves ovate-oblong, 2.5–5.5 × 1–2.2 cm, base cuneate or obtuse, apex obtuse or shortly acuminate; reticulation of veins conspicuous on both surfaces.
items.zh: 葉卵狀長圓形，長 2.5–5.5 厘米，寬 1–2.2 厘米，基部楔形或鈍，先端鈍或短漸尖；網脈兩面明顯。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Hunan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Taiwan; Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、湖南、江西、浙江、福建、臺灣；越南。

photos.en: An open flower, pale yellow, with stamens standing out among hairy green buds.
photos.zh: 開放的淺黃色花，雄蕊伸出，間有被毛的綠色花蕾。

photos.en: A leafy shoot carrying many small pale-yellow umbels above the forest floor.
photos.zh: 林地上的帶葉枝條，生有許多淺黃色小傘形花序。

photos.en: Small pale-yellow umbels along a shoot of ovate-oblong leaves.
photos.zh: 卵狀長圓形葉的枝上，排列淺黃色小傘形花序。

photos.en: Pale cream-yellow flowers open among green buds on a hairy twig.
photos.zh: 被毛小枝上，淺乳黃色花開放，間有綠色花蕾。

photos.en: A cluster of young green globose fruits among glossy ovate-oblong leaves.
photos.zh: 光亮的卵狀長圓形葉間，一簇幼嫩的綠色球形果。

photos.en: Ripe blue-black drupes in a cluster, one fruit still green, among ovate-oblong leaves.
photos.zh: 一簇成熟的藍黑色核果，其中一枚仍青，生於卵狀長圓形葉間。

facts.en: Deciduous or semi-deciduous shrub or trees, 1–3(–10) m tall, glabrous throughout, with whorled branches.
facts.zh: 落葉或半落葉灌木或喬木，高 1–3（–10）米，全體無毛，枝輪生。
1 月至 3 月。果期 9 月至 12 月。
開闊山坡灌叢，海拔 50–700 米。

items.en: Deciduous or semi-deciduous shrub or trees, 1–3(–10) m tall, glabrous throughout, with whorled branches.
items.zh: 落葉或半落葉灌木或喬木，高 1–3（–10）米，全體無毛，枝輪生。

items.en: Leaves crowded at ends of branches; petiole 0.5–1.5 cm. Blade obovate-lanceolate to elliptic, rarely lanceolate, 5–12.5 × 1.8–4 cm, base cuneate to attenuate, apex acuminate, margin entire, thick papery to leathery, shining adaxially.
items.zh: 葉聚生於枝端；葉柄長 0.5–1.5 厘米。葉片倒卵狀披針形至橢圓形，稀披針形，長 5–12.5 厘米，寬 1.8–4 厘米，基部楔形至漸狹，先端漸尖，全緣，厚紙質至革質，上面光亮。

items.en: Inflorescence terminal, umbellate, 6–8(–16)-flowered, enclosed in imbricate reddish scales in bud. Pedicels 1–2 cm, usually curved downward. Corolla broadly campanulate, ca. 1.2 cm across, pink, red, or white, shortly 5-lobed.
items.zh: 花序頂生，傘形，有花 6–8（–16）朵，芽時為覆瓦狀紅色鱗片所包。花梗長 1–2 厘米，通常下彎。花冠寬鐘狀，直徑約 1.2 厘米，粉紅、紅或白色，淺 5 裂。

items.en: Capsule ovoid, 5-angled, ca. 1.2 × 1.0 cm; stalk erect; seeds several to many.
items.zh: 蒴果卵形，有 5 稜，約 1.2 × 1.0 厘米；果梗直立；種子數枚至多數。

ecology.zh: 開闊山坡灌叢，海拔 50–700 米。

ecology.en: Native. Common in Hong Kong. Cap. 96.
ecology.zh: 原生。香港常見。受《林規》附表保護。

ecology.en: Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Yunnan; Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 福建、廣東、廣西、貴州、湖北、湖南、江西、四川、雲南；越南。

photos.en: Overlapping green and red bud scales, with bronze leaves and an old capsule.
photos.zh: 覆瓦狀的綠紅芽鱗，伴青銅色葉和一枚舊蒴果。

photos.en: Spent pink bracts open around young ovaries, among shining elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 光亮的橢圓形葉間，殘存的粉紅苞片圍着幼嫩子房。

photos.en: Brown capsules split into five valves, beside a green flower bud.
photos.zh: 褐色蒴果五瓣裂，旁有一枚綠色花蕾。

photos.en: A canopy of many pink umbels, with a bronze flush of elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 樹冠有許多粉紅色傘形花序，橢圓形葉呈青銅色。

photos.en: A small tree in woodland, massed with pink umbels and a bronze flush.
photos.zh: 林中的小樹，開滿粉紅色傘形花序，新葉青銅色。

photos.en: A bronze flush of young leaves, with spent pink bracts in crowded whorls.
photos.zh: 青銅色新葉，殘存的粉紅苞片生於密集的輪生葉間。

facts.en: Evergreen shrub or tree, usually 1–3 m, rarely 7–12 m tall; throughout glabrous except for the hairy ovary and capsules.
facts.zh: 常綠灌木或喬木，通常高 1–3 米，稀達 7–12 米；除子房及蒴果被毛外全體無毛。
4 月至 9 月。果期 7 月。
疏林、灌叢。

items.en: Evergreen shrub or tree, usually 1–3 m, rarely 7–12 m tall; throughout glabrous except for the hairy ovary and capsules.
items.zh: 常綠灌木或喬木，通常高 1–3 米，稀達 7–12 米；除子房及蒴果被毛外全體無毛。

items.en: Leaves leathery; petioles 3–5 mm. Blade elliptic, oblong or oblong-lanceolate, 6–16 × 2.5–6 cm, base acute or broadly cuneate; lateral veins 5–7 pairs.
items.zh: 葉革質；葉柄長 3–5 毫米。葉片橢圓形、長圓形或長圓狀披針形，長 6–16 厘米，寬 2.5–6 厘米，基部急尖或寬楔形；側脈 5–7 對。

items.en: Flowers in axillary clusters. Male flowers: pedicels 8–10 mm; sepals 6, yellow; stamens 5–6. Female flowers: ovary globose, 6–8-locular, densely pubescent.
items.zh: 花簇生於葉腋。雄花：花梗長 8–10 毫米；萼片 6，黃色；雄蕊 5–6。雌花：子房球形，6–8 室，密被柔毛。

items.en: Capsules subglobose, 12–18 × 7–10 mm, apex usually concave, 6–8-sulcate.
items.zh: 蒴果近球形，12–18 × 7–10 毫米，先端常凹入，有 6–8 槽。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Fujian, Guangxi, Yunnan; Cambodia, India, Laos, Thailand, Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、福建、廣西、雲南；柬埔寨、印度、老撾、泰國、越南。

photos.en: A shrub massed with green capsules, the leathery leaves spotted and flushed red.
photos.zh: 灌木結滿綠色蒴果，革質葉有斑並帶紅暈。

photos.en: A fruiting shrub in grassland, the capsules green and the leaves flushed red.
photos.zh: 草地中結果的灌木，蒴果綠色，葉帶紅暈。

photos.en: A multi-stemmed fruiting shrub, green capsules among red-spotted leaves.
photos.zh: 多幹的結果灌木，綠色蒴果生於帶紅斑的葉間。

photos.en: Leathery elliptic leaves with purple spots, and green capsules behind.
photos.zh: 革質橢圓形葉有紫斑，後方有綠色蒴果。

photos.en: Deep purple-red leathery leaves, with a few green capsules on the branch.
photos.zh: 深紫紅色革質葉，枝上有少數綠色蒴果。

photos.en: A cluster of tiny green axillary buds on a hairless green stem.
photos.zh: 無毛的綠色莖上，一簇細小的綠色腋芽。

facts.en: Evergreen small tree or tree; young branchlets, buds and leaves glabrous.
facts.zh: 常綠小喬木或喬木；幼枝、芽及葉無毛。
6 月至 11 月。果期 12 月至 5 月。
次生林。

items.en: Evergreen small tree or tree; young branchlets, buds and leaves glabrous.
items.zh: 常綠小喬木或喬木；幼枝、芽及葉無毛。

items.en: Leaves leathery or thick leathery; petioles 0.8–1.4 cm. Blade ovate-elliptic, elliptic or narrowly elliptic, 6.5–10 × 2.5–4 cm, base cuneate, apex acuminate, margin entire or sparsely serrate; midvein raised adaxially.
items.zh: 葉革質或厚革質；葉柄長 0.8–1.4 厘米。葉片卵狀橢圓形、橢圓形或狹橢圓形，長 6.5–10 厘米，寬 2.5–4 厘米，基部楔形，先端漸尖，全緣或疏鋸齒；中脈上面隆起。

items.en: Racemes 1–2 cm, pubescent, branched basally, 4–7-flowered. Corolla white, 4–5 mm, 5-lobed nearly to base. Stamens 60–80.
items.zh: 總狀花序長 1–2 厘米，被柔毛，基部有分枝，有花 4–7 朵。花冠白色，長 4–5 毫米，近基部 5 裂。雄蕊 60–80。

items.en: Drupes oblong-ovoid or obovoid, 1–1.5 cm, apex with persistent erect or slightly inflexed calyx-lobes.
items.zh: 核果長圓狀卵形或倒卵形，長 1–1.5 厘米，先端有宿存直立或稍內折的萼裂片。

photos.en: Thick elliptic leaves and green budded racemes, on a grey trunk.
photos.zh: 厚的橢圓形葉和綠色花蕾組成的總狀花序，生於灰色樹幹上。

photos.en: A small multi-stemmed tree, with thick leaves and clusters of buds.
photos.zh: 多幹的小樹，葉厚，花蕾成簇。

photos.en: Green racemes, still in bud or young fruit, among thick elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 綠色總狀花序，仍為花蕾或幼果，生於厚的橢圓形葉間。

photos.en: Axillary clusters of fruit on a leafy stem.
A small tree in flower at the forest edge.
A shrub-tree on a rocky slope, with clusters of green fruit.
photos.zh: 石坡上的灌木狀小樹，結有綠色果簇。

facts.en: Shrub or small tree, glabrous throughout; young branchlets 2-ribbed.
facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，全體無毛；幼枝有 2 稜。
11 月至 1 月。果期 7 月至 9 月。
林地及灌叢。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, glabrous throughout; young branchlets 2-ribbed.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，全體無毛；幼枝有 2 稜。

items.en: Leaves thinly leathery; petioles ca. 3 mm. Blade oblong or obovate-oblong, 4–7 × 1.5–2.5 cm, base cuneate, apex acuminate, margin closely serrulate or crenulate, dark green and shining adaxially; lateral veins 9–12 on each side of midvein.
items.zh: 葉薄革質；葉柄長約 3 毫米。葉片長圓形或倒卵狀長圓形，長 4–7 厘米，寬 1.5–2.5 厘米，基部楔形，先端漸尖，邊緣密生細鋸齒或圓齒，上面深绿而光亮；側脈每邊 9–12 條。

items.en: Flowers axillary, solitary or 3–4 clustered. Male: petals obovate, 3.5–4 mm; stamens 14–17. Female: ovary ovoid, 3-locular; styles 1.5–3 mm, apex 3-lobed.
items.zh: 花腋生，單生或 3–4 朵簇生。雄花：花瓣倒卵形，長 3.5–4 毫米；雄蕊 14–17。雌花：子房卵形，3 室；花柱長 1.5–3 毫米，先端 3 裂。

items.en: Fruit globose, 3–4 mm in diam., bluish black.
items.zh: 果球形，直徑 3–4 毫米，藍黑色。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan, Hubei, S Hunan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian; Vietnam, Myanmar, Malaya, Indonesia, Philippines.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、四川、湖北、湖南南部、江西、浙江、福建；越南、緬甸、馬來半島、印度尼西亞、菲律賓。

photos.en: A flowering canopy on a hillside, the flowers pale and axillary.
photos.zh: 山坡上開花的樹冠，花淺色、腋生。

photos.en: Open pale-cream flowers and young green globose fruits on the same shoot.
photos.zh: 同一枝上有開放的淺乳白色花和幼嫩的綠色球形果。

photos.en: Flower buds opening cream, among shining oblong leaves.
photos.zh: 乳白色花蕾正開，生於光亮的長圓形葉間。

photos.en: A sunlit mass of open male flowers, the anthers orange.
photos.zh: 日照下密集的開放雄花，花藥橙色。

publication.text: Verh. Nat. Gesch. Ned. Bezitt., Bot.: 115 (1841)

facts.zh: 3 月至 5 月。果期 8 月至 11 月。

items.en: Deciduous tree, 4–6(–15) m tall. Leaves digitately ternate; petioles 4–12 cm, with glands at apex.
items.zh: 落葉喬木，高 4–6（–15）米。葉指狀三出；葉柄長 4–12 厘米，先端有腺體。

items.en: Leaflets thinly leathery; blade ovate or elliptic, (4–)7–18 × (2.5–)3–8 cm, base cuneate, apex acuminate or acute, glabrous, adaxially ± shining; lateral veins usually 8–11 on each side of midvein.
items.zh: 小葉薄革質；葉片卵形或橢圓形，長 (4–)7–18 厘米，寬 (2.5–)3–8 厘米，基部楔形，先端漸尖或急尖，無毛，上面稍光亮；側脈每邊通常 8–11 條。

items.en: Corymbs terminal. Petals white or pale yellow; petal-blade ovate or oblong, 1–3.5 × 0.5–2.5 cm. Stamens 13–30. Gynophore 4–7 cm.
items.zh: 傘房花序頂生。花瓣白色或淡黃色；瓣片卵形或長圓形，長 1–3.5 厘米，寬 0.5–2.5 厘米。雄蕊 13–30。雌蕊柄長 4–7 厘米。

items.en: Fruit subglobose, 2.5–4 cm in diam., initially smooth, with yellow or cream tubercles when mature.
items.zh: 果近球形，直徑 2.5–4 厘米，初時平滑，成熟時有黃或乳黃色瘤狀突起。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian, Yunnan; tropical Asia and Australia.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、福建、雲南；亞洲熱帶及澳洲。

photos.en: A full crown dense with cream-yellow corymbs.
photos.zh: 整個樹冠密生乳黃白色傘房花序。

photos.en: A corymb of pale yellow-white flowers, the petals clawed and the stamens long and purple.
photos.zh: 傘房花序，花淺黃白色，花瓣有爪，雄蕊長而紫色。

photos.en: Pale yellow-white flowers in a corymb, with long purple stamens and a bee.
photos.zh: 傘房花序上的淺黃白色花，雄蕊長而紫色，有一隻蜂。

photos.en: A hanging subglobose fruit, the surface yellow-cream and tuberculate, among ternate leaves.
photos.zh: 下垂的近球形果，表面乳黃色、有疣突，旁為三出複葉。

photos.en: A cluster of cream tuberculate fruits, the leaflets wet and drawn out at the tip.
photos.zh: 一簇乳黃色有疣突的果，小葉濕、先端漸尖。

photos.en: A flowering tree on a lawn, the crown carrying cream corymbs.
photos.zh: 草地上開花的樹，樹冠有乳白色傘房花序。

facts.en: Tree, to 12 m tall; young branches glabrous.
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 12 米；幼枝無毛。
2 月至 4 月。果期 5 月至 8 月。
森林。

items.en: Tree, to 12 m tall; young branches glabrous.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 12 米；幼枝無毛。

items.en: Petioles 3–5.5 cm. Blade ovate, 7–13 × 4.5–6.5 cm, leathery, base broadly cuneate, apex obtuse or subacute, green and shining adaxially, whitish grey abaxially; lateral veins 7–9 pairs.
items.zh: 葉柄長 3–5.5 厘米。葉片卵形，長 7–13 厘米，寬 4.5–6.5 厘米，革質，基部寬楔形，先端鈍或近急尖，上面緑而光亮，下面灰白色；側脈 7–9 對。

items.en: Inflorescences 3–4 cm, pendulous; peduncle 2–3 cm. Petals spathulate, 2.5–3.5(–4) × 0.4–0.8 cm. Stamens as long as petals.
items.zh: 花序長 3–4 厘米，下垂；花序梗長 2–3 厘米。花瓣匙形，長 2.5–3.5（–4）厘米，寬 0.4–0.8 厘米。雄蕊與花瓣等長。

items.en: Infructescence ca. 3 cm wide, with 5 capsules. Capsule ovoid-globose, ca. 1.2–1.5 cm, without persistent styles.
items.zh: 果序寬約 3 厘米，有蒴果 5 枚。蒴果卵球形，約 1.2–1.5 厘米，無宿存花柱。

ecology.en: Native. Listed in Rare and Precious Plants of Hong Kong.
ecology.zh: 原生。列入《香港稀有及珍貴植物》。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Hainan, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan; Indonesia (Sumatra), W Malaysia, Myanmar, Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 廣東、海南、廣西、貴州、雲南；印度尼西亞（蘇門答臘）、西馬來西亞、緬甸、越南。

photos.en: A canopy massed with pink flowers, and many brown buds among leathery leaves.
photos.zh: 樹冠開滿粉紅色花，革質葉間有許多褐色花蕾。

photos.en: Clusters of brown hairy ovoid buds, with old split capsules still on the shoot.
photos.zh: 褐色被毛的卵形花蕾成簇，枝上仍有開裂的舊蒴果。

photos.en: A single brown hairy ovoid bud, on a long petiole.
photos.zh: 單一的褐色被毛卵形花蕾，葉柄長。

photos.en: Green ovoid woody capsules among leathery leaves.
photos.zh: 革質葉間的綠色卵形木質蒴果。

photos.en: Open pink flowers, the stamens dark, among glossy leaves.
photos.zh: 開放的粉紅色花，雄蕊深色，生於光亮的葉間。

facts.zh: 喬木。
4 月至 5 月。果期 8 月至 9 月。
低地次生林及山谷。

items.en: Tree. Leaves leathery, elliptic, lanceolate or elliptic-oblong, 9–20 × 3.5–8 cm.
items.zh: 喬木。葉革質，橢圓形、披針形或橢圓狀長圓形，長 9–20 厘米，寬 3.5–8 厘米。

items.en: Petioles 2.5–3.5 cm. Blade elliptic, lanceolate or elliptic-oblong, 9–20 × 3.5–8 cm, base obtuse or subrounded, apex acute, margin entire; lateral veins 7–9 pairs.
items.zh: 葉柄長 2.5–3.5 厘米。葉片橢圓形、披針形或橢圓狀長圓形，長 9–20 厘米，寬 3.5–8 厘米，基部鈍或近圓，先端急尖，全緣；側脈 7–9 對。

items.en: Panicles much branched, axillary, more or less tomentose. Calyx 5-parted nearly to base, segments stellately spreading, green and slightly reddish at base, oblong-lanceolate, 4–6 mm.
items.zh: 圓錐花序多分枝，腋生，多少被絨毛。萼近基部 5 裂，裂片星狀展開，綠色而基部稍帶紅，長圓狀披針形，長 4–6 毫米。

items.en: Follicles bright scarlet, long-ovate or oblong, 5–7 × 2–2.5 cm, base attenuate, apex rostrate, densely pubescent. Seeds black-brown, ellipsoid-ovoid, 1 cm in diam.
items.zh: 蓇葖鮮紅色，長卵形或長圓形，長 5–7 厘米，寬 2–2.5 厘米，基部漸狹，先端喙狀，密被柔毛。種子黑褐色，橢圓狀卵形，直徑 1 厘米。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan; Myanmar, Vietnam, Thailand, Laos.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、雲南、貴州、四川；緬甸、越南、泰國、老撾。

photos.en: A low plant on rock, with many axillary panicles.
photos.zh: 石上的低矮植株，腋生許多圓錐花序。

photos.en: A tree at the forest edge, in pink-red flower, the leaves glossy.
photos.zh: 林緣的樹，開粉紅花，葉光亮。

photos.en: A canopy with open scarlet follicles among elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 樹冠中猩紅色蓇葖開裂，葉橢圓形。

photos.en: Several open scarlet to orange follicles in the canopy.
photos.zh: 樹冠中數枚開裂的蓇葖，猩紅色至橙色。

photos.en: A mature trunk, grey and fissured, under a leafy canopy.
photos.zh: 成熟的樹幹，灰色縱裂，上為帶葉的樹冠。

photos.en: Scarlet follicles split open, showing glossy black seeds.
photos.zh: 猩紅色蓇葖開裂，露出光亮的黑色種子。

facts.en: Shrub or small tree, 2–5(–12) m tall, all parts glabrous.
facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木, 2–5(–12) 米, 各部無毛.
3 月至 5 月。果期 9 月至 11 月。
森林或灌叢。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, 2–5(–12) m tall, all parts glabrous.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木, 2–5(–12) 米, 各部無毛.

items.en: Leaves ± clustered on apex of branch, 15–30 cm including the petiole; petioles 6–9 cm, not winged; leaflets 7–13, opposite, shortly petiolulate or sessile; blade papery, elliptic-oblong or ovate-lanceolate, 5–10 × 1.5–3.5 cm, base oblique, rounded, apex caudate, margin entire, shining adaxially, pale green or greyish green abaxially; lateral veins 15–20 on each side of midvein.
items.zh: 葉多少聚生於枝端，連葉柄長 15–30 厘米；葉柄長 6–9 厘米，無翅；小葉 7–13 枚，對生，具短小葉柄或無柄；葉片紙質，橢圓狀長圓形或卵狀披針形，長 5–10 厘米，寬 1.5–3.5 厘米，基部偏斜、圓形，先端尾尖，全緣，上面有光澤，下面淺綠色或灰綠色；側脈每側 15–20 條。

items.en: Panicles axillary, 5–15 cm. Flowers small; pedicels short and slender. Calyx-lobes ovate, apex obtuse. Petals yellowish green, oblong, ca. 2 mm, apex obtuse.
items.zh: 圓錐花序腋生，長 5–15 厘米。花小；花梗短而細。萼裂片卵形，先端鈍。花瓣黃綠色，長圓形，長約 2 毫米，先端鈍。

items.en: Drupe oblique, compressed, ca. 6–8 mm wide, pericarp thin, separating, mesocarp thick, waxy, stone bony.
items.zh: 核果偏斜，壓扁，寬約 6–8 毫米，外果皮薄、易分離，中果皮厚、蠟質，核骨質。

ecology.en: Area S of Changjiang River; SE to E Asia.
ecology.zh: 長江以南；東南亞至東亞。

photos.en: A branch with flowers and pinnate leaves.
Dried fruits, new leaves, and young panicles on the same shoot.
photos.zh: 同一枝上有乾果、新葉和幼嫩圓錐花序。

photos.en: Pinnate foliage with fruits, at the edge of scrub.
photos.zh: 灌叢邊緣的羽狀葉，並結果。

photos.en: A wider view of a small tree, the crown odd-pinnate.
photos.zh: 小樹的較寬畫面，樹冠為奇數羽狀複葉。

photos.en: Dried brown fruit clusters on a small tree in open scrub.
photos.zh: 開闊灌叢中的小樹，結有褐色乾果簇。

photos.en: Clusters of dried waxy drupes on the tree.
photos.zh: 樹上成簇的乾核果，表面有蠟質。

facts.en: Small tree, all parts strongly camphor-scented; branchlets angular, glabrous or minutely tomentulose near apex.
facts.zh: 小喬木，全株有濃樟香；小枝有棱，無毛，或近先端被微絨毛。
4 月至 6 月。
疏林。

items.en: Small tree, all parts strongly camphor-scented; branchlets angular, glabrous or minutely tomentulose near apex.
items.zh: 小喬木，全株有濃樟香；小枝有棱，無毛，或近先端被微絨毛。

items.en: Leaves alternate; petioles 0.8 –1.3 cm, glabrous; leaf blade thick-leathery, elliptic, 4–9.5 × 2–3.5 cm, base cuneate, apex abruptly and shortly acuminate, tip blunt, dark green and shining adaxially, paler and reddish abaxially, triplinerved; midvein and lateral veins slightly impressed adaxially and strongly raised abaxially, transversal veins inconspicuous.
items.zh: 葉互生；葉柄長 0.8–1.3 厘米，無毛；葉片厚革質，橢圓形，長 4–9.5 厘米，寬 2–3.5 厘米，基部楔形，先端驟然短漸尖，尖頭鈍，上面深綠色而有光澤，下面較淺並帶紅，離基三出脈；中脈和側脈在上面稍下陷、在下面明顯隆起，橫脈不明顯。

items.en: Panicles about the length of the substanding leaves, cymosely branching, the utmost branch 3-flowered. Pedicels very short, greyish white sericeous.
items.zh: 圓錐花序約與所對的葉等長，聚傘狀分枝，最末級分枝有花 3 朵。花梗極短，被灰白色絹毛。

items.en: Fruit unknown.
items.zh: 果實未見。

photos.en: Flowering branches in the canopy, with many small panicles of open flowers and buds.
photos.zh: 樹冠中的花枝，許多小圓錐花序同時有開放的花和花蕾。

photos.en: A small flowering tree in thin forest, the young leaves still pale.
photos.zh: 疏林中開花的小樹，幼葉仍淺色。

photos.en: An open flower in close view, with stamens and a few buds.
photos.zh: 開放的花近景，可見雄蕊，旁有數枚花蕾。

photos.en: An upright small tree in flower at the forest edge, the young leaves pale.
photos.zh: 林緣直立的開花小樹，幼葉淺色。

photos.en: Flowering branches hanging over a path, the glossy leaves three-nerved from the base.
photos.zh: 花枝垂向路旁，光亮的葉基出三脈。

photos.en: Several flowering branches, each with many small panicles.
photos.zh: 數條花枝，各生許多小圓錐花序。

facts.en: Deciduous, aromatic shrub or small tree, 8–10 m tall.
facts.zh: 落葉、有香氣的灌木或小喬木，高 8–10 米。
2 月至 3 月。果期 7 月至 8 月。
向陽山坡、灌叢和疏林。

items.en: Deciduous, aromatic shrub or small tree, 8–10 m tall.
items.zh: 落葉、有香氣的灌木或小喬木，高 8–10 米。

items.en: Leaves alternate; petioles 6–20 mm, glabrous; leaf blade papery, lanceolate, oblong or elliptic, 4–11 × 1.1 –2.4 cm, base cuneate, apex acuminate or acute, dark green adaxially, glaucous abaxially, glabrous on both surfaces; pinnately veined, lateral veins slender, 6–16 on each side of midvein, together with midvein raised on both surfaces.
items.zh: 葉互生；葉柄長 6–20 毫米，無毛；葉片紙質，披針形、長圓形或橢圓形，長 4–11 厘米，寬 1.1–2.4 厘米，基部楔形，先端漸尖或急尖，上面深綠色，下面被白粉，兩面無毛；羽狀脈，側脈細，每側 6–16 條，與中脈在兩面均隆起。

items.en: Umbels 4–6-flowered, solitary or fascicled; peduncles slender, 6–10 mm; bracts ciliate. Fertile stamens 9; filaments pubescent in the lower part; staminodes in female flowers pubescent on the lower part. Ovary ovoid, stigma capitate.
items.zh: 傘形花序有花 4–6 朵，單生或簇生；總花梗細，長 6–10 毫米；苞片具緣毛。能育雄蕊 9；花絲下部被毛；雌花中的退化雄蕊下部被毛。子房卵形，柱頭頭狀。

items.en: Fruit subglobose, ca. 5 mm in diam., black at maturity; fruiting pedicels 2–4 mm, slightly enlarged at the apex.
items.zh: 果近球形，直徑約 5 毫米，成熟時黑色；果梗長 2–4 毫米，先端稍膨大。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Sichuan, Xizang, Yunnan, Guizhou, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, Taiwan; SE Asia.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、四川、西藏、雲南、貴州、湖北、湖南、江西、安徽、江蘇、浙江、福建及台灣；東南亞。

photos.en: A canopy filled with cream flowers at the forest edge.
photos.zh: 林緣的樹冠開滿乳白色花。

photos.en: A full tree on a slope, the crown massed with cream umbels.
photos.zh: 坡上的全株，樹冠密生乳白色傘形花序。

photos.en: Green fruiting umbels in the canopy, among lanceolate leaves.
photos.zh: 樹冠中的綠色果序，葉披針形。

photos.en: Immature green fruits in umbels, with lanceolate leaves in the canopy.
photos.zh: 傘形果序上的幼嫩青果，樹冠中葉披針形。

photos.en: Radiating whorls of lanceolate leaves, with green fruiting umbels in the canopy.
photos.zh: 披針形葉輪生開展，樹冠中有綠色果序。

photos.en: Dense cream umbels filling the branching crown.
photos.zh: 分枝的樹冠開滿密集的乳白色傘形花序。

facts.en: Thickets or open forests on hillslopes or in valleys.
facts.zh: 山坡或山谷的灌叢或疏林。

items.en: Tree, 6 –20 m tall.

Leaves usually clustered towards apex of branchlets; petioles slender, 8 –13 mm; leaf blade leathery, elliptic to narrowly elliptic, occasionally oblanceolate, 7–15(–17) × 2– 4(–5) cm, apex acuminate or caudate-acuminate, tip blunt, adaxial surface dark green and glabrous, abaxial surface except for the midvein and lateral veins densely covered with appressed tawny short hairs; lateral veins slender, 12–17 on each side of midvein, veinlets inconspicuous on both surfaces.
items.zh: 葉通常聚生於小枝先端；葉柄細，長 8–13 毫米；葉片革質，橢圓形至狹橢圓形，偶為倒披針形，長 7–15（–17）厘米，寬 2–4（–5）厘米，先端漸尖或尾狀漸尖，尖頭鈍，上面深綠色、無毛，下面除中脈和側脈外密被貼伏的黃褐色短毛；側脈細，每側 12–17 條，細脈在兩面均不明顯。

items.en: Inflorescence cymose-paniculate, arising from the base of the current year's branchlets, puberulous. Pedicels slender, 8 –13 mm.
items.zh: 花序為聚傘狀圓錐花序，生於當年生枝基部，被微柔毛。花梗細，長 8–13 毫米。

items.en: Fruit globose, ca. 1 cm in diam., black when mature.
items.zh: 果球形，直徑約 1 厘米，成熟時黑色。

ecology.en: Thickets or open forests on hillslopes or in valleys.
ecology.zh: 山坡或山谷的灌叢或疏林。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hunan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、湖南、江西、浙江及福建。

photos.en: A canopy massed with yellow-green panicles, the elliptic leaves clustered at the tips.
photos.zh: 樹冠密生黃綠色圓錐花序，橢圓形葉聚於枝端。

photos.en: A full tree in flower, the crown covered in yellow panicles.
photos.zh: 全株開花，樹冠覆滿黃色圓錐花序。

photos.en: A canopy of spent pink panicles, with a copper flush of new leaves.
photos.zh: 樹冠上殘留粉紅色花序，新葉呈銅色。

photos.en: An open flower among dense buds, on the upper surface of a leaf.
photos.zh: 葉面上，一朵開放的花生於密集花蕾間。

photos.en: A tree covered in massed panicles.
photos.zh: 一株樹開滿密集的圓錐花序。

photos.en: A spreading flowering tree on a roadside slope.
photos.zh: 路旁坡地上，樹冠開展並正在開花。

facts.zh: 6 月至 6 月。果期 10 月至 10 月。
溪邊或溝谷的林中。

items.en: Tree, 10 –15 m tall.

Leaves leathery; petioles 1–2.5 cm, glabrous; leaf blade lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate or broadly ovate-oblong, 5–12 × 1.5 – 4 cm, base cuneate or sub-rounded, apex acuminate to caudate-acuminate, margin serrulate above middle, adaxially green, abaxially glaucous, becoming dark grey when dry, glabrous on both surfaces; lateral veins 10–14 on each side of midvein.
items.zh: 葉革質；葉柄長 1–2.5 厘米，無毛；葉片披針形至長圓狀披針形，或寬卵狀長圓形，長 5–12 厘米，寬 1.5–4 厘米，基部楔形或近圓形，先端漸尖至尾狀漸尖，中部以上具細鋸齒，上面綠色，下面被白粉，乾後變深灰色，兩面無毛；側脈每側 10–14 條。

items.en: Male spike 4 – 6(–9) cm, rachis slender, ± tawny tomentose. Female spikes 1.5–3 cm, with 2–3 cupules.
items.zh: 雄花序穗狀，長 4–6（–9）厘米，序軸細，多少被黃褐色絨毛。雌花序長 1.5–3 厘米，有殼斗 2–3 枚。

items.en: Nut ellipsoid, 1.3 –2 cm high, 0.8 –1.1 cm in diam., glabrous, apex rounded; scar flat, ca. 6 mm in diam.
items.zh: 堅果橢圓形，高 1.3–2 厘米，直徑 0.8–1.1 厘米，無毛，先端圓；果臍扁平，直徑約 6 毫米。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Sichuan, Yunnan, Hunan, Hubei, Henan, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, Taiwan; Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Laos, Thailand.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、貴州、四川、雲南、湖南、湖北、河南、陝西、江西、安徽、江蘇、浙江、福建及台灣；韓國、日本、越南、老撾、泰國。

photos.en: A fruiting canopy in the woods, with many immature acorns among dense lanceolate leaves.
photos.zh: 林中結果的樹冠，披針形密葉間有許多未成熟的橡實。

photos.en: A shrub by a rocky path, with a brown flush and many male spikes.
photos.zh: 石徑旁的灌木，新葉褐色，雄穗多。

photos.en: A bronze-purple flush at the tips, the mature leaves lanceolate and finely serrate.
photos.zh: 枝端新葉青銅帶紫，成熟葉披針形、具細鋸齒。

photos.en: An evergreen tree on a rocky slope, the crown dense with lanceolate leaves.
photos.zh: 石坡上的常綠樹，樹冠密生披針形葉。

photos.en: A dense crown of lanceolate leaves.
An open branch in scrub, with lanceolate leaves and young spikes.
photos.zh: 灌叢中的疏枝，葉披針形，有幼穗。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).

facts.zh: 6 月至 10 月。果期 11 月至 4 月。
山谷林中，以及向陽山坡。

items.en: Tree, 3 –20 m tall.

Leaves bipinnate or sometimes pinnate, 10– 18 cm; pinnae 2 – 6 pairs; petiolules 0.5 – 1 mm; leaflets 5 – 9 pairs, papery or thinly leathery, oblique elliptic or rhomboid-oblong, 2.5–5 × 1–2 cm, base oblique, cuneate, apex obtuse and emarginate, margin obtusely dentate or entire, slightly pubescent along veins adaxially, glabrous abaxially; reticulate veins sparse, inconspicuous.
items.zh: 葉二回羽狀，有時一回羽狀，長 10–18 厘米；羽片 2–6 對；小葉柄長 0.5–1 毫米；小葉 5–9 對，紙質或薄革質，斜橢圓形或菱狀長圓形，長 2.5–5 厘米，寬 1–2 厘米，基部偏斜、楔形，先端鈍並微凹，邊緣具鈍齒或全緣，上面沿脈稍被毛，下面無毛；網脈疏，不明顯。

items.en: Inflorescence paniculate, terminal or axillary, to 28 cm. Male inflorescences many-flowered; bisexual inflorescences few-flowered. Flowers polygamous, pale green or greenish white. Pedicels 1–2.5 mm. Male flowers: 4 – 5 mm in diam.; calyx lobes lanceolate, as long as hypanthium, densely puberulous abaxially; petals elliptic, ca. 2 mm, densely pubescent on both surfaces. Bisexual flowers: 7 – 9 mm; hypanthium ca. 2 mm, glabrous, lobes 5–6, lanceolate, ca. 3 mm, puberulous abaxially, densely pale brown villous adaxially; petals 5 – 6, elliptic, pubescent abaxially, densely villous adaxially; stamens 5, included; ovary sessile, densely pale brown silky hairy.
items.zh: 花序圓錐狀，頂生或腋生，長可達 28 厘米。雄花序多花；兩性花序少花。花雜性，淡綠色或綠白色。花梗長 1–2.5 毫米。雄花直徑 4–5 毫米；萼裂片披針形，與花托等長，下面密被微柔毛；花瓣橢圓形，長約 2 毫米，兩面密被毛。兩性花直徑 7–9 毫米；花托長約 2 毫米，無毛，裂片 5–6，披針形，長約 3 毫米，下面被微柔毛，上面密被淡褐色長柔毛；花瓣 5–6，橢圓形，下面被毛，上面密被長柔毛；雄蕊 5，內藏；子房無柄，密被淡褐色絹毛。

items.en: Pods linear-ellipsoidal, 8 – 12 × 1– 2.5 cm, straight or curved, brownish black. Seeds 5–12, elliptic or oblong, 7–11 × 4 – 5 mm, blackish brown.
items.zh: 莢果線狀橢圓形，長 8–12 厘米，寬 1–2.5 厘米，直或彎，黑褐色。種子 5–12 顆，橢圓形或長圓形，長 7–11 毫米，寬 4–5 毫米，黑褐色。

ecology.zh: 山谷林中，以及向陽山坡。

photos.en: A tree crown carrying mature pods.
photos.zh: 樹冠上掛着成熟的莢果。

photos.en: A dense bipinnate crown, with greenish panicles and old brown linear pods.
photos.zh: 羽狀複葉的濃密樹冠，有淡綠色圓錐花序和褐色線形舊莢。

photos.en: A sunlit bipinnate crown, the leaflets oblong and blunt.
photos.zh: 日照下的羽狀複葉樹冠，小葉長圓形、先端鈍。

facts.en: Small tree, 5–12 m tall, glabrous throughout.
facts.zh: 小喬木, 5–12 米, 全體無毛.
4 月至 6 月。果期 7 月至 10 月。
森林和灌叢。

items.en: Small tree, 5–12 m tall, glabrous throughout.
items.zh: 小喬木, 5–12 米, 全體無毛.

items.en: Leaves papery; petioles 2–7.5 cm, with 2 glands at apex; stipules small, subovate, ca. 1 mm.; leaf blade elliptic or oblong-ovate, 4–10 × 2.5 – 5 cm, base cuneate, apex obtuse or shortly acuminate, more or less glaucous abaxially; lateral veins 8–12 on each side of midvein.
items.zh: 葉紙質；葉柄長 2–7.5 厘米，先端有腺體 2 枚；托葉小，近卵形，長約 1 毫米；葉片橢圓形或長圓狀卵形，長 4–10 厘米，寬 2.5–5 厘米，基部楔形，先端鈍或短漸尖，下面多少被白粉；側脈每側 8–12 條。

items.en: Racemes terminal, 4–9 cm, with several female flowers at base, and many male flowers on upper part. Male flowers: 5–7 in axil of bracts; pedicels 1–3 mm; bracts ovate, ca. 1.5 × 1 mm; calyx cup-shaped, irregular-serrulate; stamens 2–3, filaments short, anthers globose. Female flowers: solitary in axil of bracts; pedicels ca. 5 mm; bracts as in male flowers; calyx 3-partite to base, lobes triangular, ca. 2 mm; ovary ovoid, 3-locular; styles 3, divided to the middle.
items.zh: 總狀花序頂生，長 4–9 厘米，基部有雌花數朵，上部有雄花多朵。雄花 5–7 朵生於苞腋；花梗長 1–3 毫米；苞片卵形，約 1.5 × 1 毫米；萼杯狀，不規則細齒裂；雄蕊 2–3，花絲短，花藥球形。雌花單生於苞腋；花梗長約 5 毫米；苞片同雄花；萼 3 深裂至基部，裂片三角形，長約 2 毫米；子房卵形，3 室；花柱 3，中部以上分裂。

items.en: Capsules black, globose, 1–1.5 cm in diam.; seeds subglobose, 4–5 × 3 – 4 mm, covered with a very shiny layer of waxy aril.
items.zh: 蒴果黑色，球形，直徑 1–1.5 厘米；種子近球形，長 4–5 毫米，寬 3–4 毫米，外被一層很光亮的蠟質假種皮。

ecology.en: Area S of Changjiang; Vietnam, Laos, Myanmar, India, Malaysia, Indonesia.
ecology.zh: 長江以南；越南、老撾、緬甸、印度、馬來西亞、印度尼西亞。

photos.en: A dense whorl of dark green elliptic leaves, with the trunk at the left.
photos.zh: 深綠色橢圓形葉密集成輪，左側可見樹幹。

photos.en: Yellow terminal racemes, with young green capsules at the base, among elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 黃色頂生總狀花序，基部有幼嫩綠色蒴果，葉橢圓形。

photos.en: Globose capsules turning from green to brown, among elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 球形蒴果由綠轉褐，生於橢圓形葉間。

photos.en: A crown of elliptic leaves turning red among the green.
photos.zh: 樹冠中橢圓形葉，紅綠相間。

photos.en: A flowering canopy of many yellow terminal racemes.
photos.zh: 開花的樹冠，黃色頂生總狀花序多。

facts.en: Evergreen shrub, up to 2 m high.
facts.zh: 常綠灌木，高可達 2 米。
4 月至 4 月。果期 10 月至 11 月。

facts.en: Dry slopes, thickets and woods, roadsides.
facts.zh: 乾旱山坡、灌叢和林中，以及路旁。

items.en: Evergreen shrub, up to 2 m high.
items.zh: 常綠灌木，高可達 2 米。

items.en: Leaves leathery, stipulate; petioles 5 – 7 mm, puberulent; leaf blade ovate-oblong or rarely obovate, 3.5– 8.5 × 1.4– 3.5 cm, base cuneate, apex shortly and abruptly acuminate, acumen 2– 8 mm, margin entire, glabrous except for the puberulent midvein on abaxial surface; lateral veins inconspicuous.
items.zh: 葉革質，有托葉；葉柄長 5–7 毫米，被微柔毛；葉片卵狀長圓形，稀倒卵形，長 3.5–8.5 厘米，寬 1.4–3.5 厘米，基部楔形，先端短而驟漸尖，尖頭長 2–8 毫米，全緣，除下面中脈被微柔毛外無毛；側脈不明顯。

items.en: Inflorescences pseudo-fasciculate, axillary, on the second year's growth; the central axis 1 – 5 mm, with a dormant or active terminal bud; flowers 4 – 6-merous. Staminate branches of the fascicles 1– 3-flowered; peduncles 1–2 mm; pedicels 3–7 mm, puberulent; calyx patelliform, 2 mm across, puberulent, 5- or 6-lobed, lobes deltoid, obtuse, often erose, ciliate; corolla 5 – 6 mm across, base connate, petals 4 or 5, stamens 4 or 5, anthers ovoid; rudimentary ovary subglobose. Pistillate branches uniflorous; pedicels 6 – 8 mm; calyx and corolla as in the staminate flower; staminode puberulent; ovary subglobose-ovoid, 1.5– 2 mm in diam., style evident, ca. 1 mm, stigma capitate. Fruits globose, 6 mm in diam.; persistent calyx 3 mm across; stigma columnar; pyrenes 4 or 5, reticulately striate, elliptic-trigonous, 5 mm; endocarp coriaceous, rough and hairy.
items.zh: 花序假簇生，腋生於二年生枝；中軸長 1–5 毫米，先端有休眠或活動的頂芽；花 4–6 數。雄花枝有花 1–3 朵；花序梗長 1–2 毫米；花梗長 3–7 毫米，被微柔毛；萼碟形，徑 2 毫米，被微柔毛，5 或 6 裂，裂片三角形、鈍，常嚙蝕狀、具緣毛；花冠徑 5–6 毫米，基部合生，花瓣 4 或 5，雄蕊 4 或 5，花藥卵形；退化子房近球形。雌花枝有花 1 朵；花梗長 6–8 毫米；萼和花冠同雄花；退化雄蕊被微柔毛；子房近球狀卵形，直徑 1.5–2 毫米，花柱明顯，長約 1 毫米，柱頭頭狀。果球形，直徑 6 毫米；宿萼徑 3 毫米；柱頭柱狀；分核 4 或 5，具網狀條紋，橢圓狀三棱形，長 5 毫米；內果皮革質，粗糙而被毛。

ecology.en: Dry slopes, thickets and woods, roadsides.
ecology.zh: 乾旱山坡、灌叢和林中，以及路旁。

photos.en: An evergreen shrub, the leaves glossy and ovate-oblong, with tiny white axillary flowers and a reddish flush.
photos.zh: 常綠灌木，葉光亮、卵狀長圓形，有細小的白色腋生花，新葉帶紅。

photos.en: A flowering crown massed with white blossoms.
Young green globose drupes in the leaf axils.
photos.zh: 葉腋生的幼嫩綠色球形核果。

photos.en: Flowering branches, the white clusters running through the crown.
photos.zh: 花枝上白色花簇遍佈樹冠。

photos.en: A multi-stemmed shrub on a slope, the bark pale grey.
photos.zh: 坡上的多幹灌木，樹皮淺灰色。

photos.en: Branches on a woodland slope, the evergreen foliage dense.
photos.zh: 林坡上的枝條，常綠葉密集。

facts.en: Evergreen shrub or small trees, 1 – 5 m hight.
facts.zh: 常綠灌木或小喬木，高 1–5 米。
5 月至 6 月。果期 10 月至 10 月。
次生林和灌叢。

items.en: Evergreen shrub or small trees, 1 – 5 m hight.
items.zh: 常綠灌木或小喬木，高 1–5 米。

items.en: Leaves alternate; stipules narrowly deltoid; petioles 4 – 5 mm, narrowly winged by the decurrent leaf-base; leaf blade thick-leathery, ovate, obovate or elliptic, 2.5–7 × 1.5–3 cm, crenate-serrate, dull and conspicuously punctate abaxially.
items.zh: 葉互生；托葉狹三角形；葉柄長 4–5 毫米，因葉基下延而有狹翅；葉片厚革質，卵形、倒卵形或橢圓形，長 2.5–7 厘米，寬 1.5–3 厘米，具圓齒狀鋸齒，下面無光澤、密生細點。

items.en: Staminate cymes 1 – 5-flowered, solitary, axillary to the scales or lower leaves of the current year's growth or fasciculate on the second year's growth; peduncles 3– 5 mm; pedicels 2 mm; calyx 2– 3 mm across, glabrous, 4-lobed; corolla rotate, 7 mm across, connate at base; stamens shorter than petals; anthers oblong; rudimentary ovary minute. Pistillate flowers solitary, axillary, on current year's growth; pedicels 12– 15 mm; calyx 4– 5 mm in diam., glabrous, 4-lobed; corolla rotate, 7 mm across, petals connate at base; staminodes short; sterile anthers sagittate; ovary ovoid, stigma discoid.
items.zh: 雄聚傘花序有花 1–5 朵，單生，腋生於當年生枝的鱗片或下部葉，或簇生於二年生枝；花序梗長 3–5 毫米；花梗長 2 毫米；萼徑 2–3 毫米，無毛，4 裂；花冠輻狀，徑 7 毫米，基部合生；雄蕊短於花瓣；花藥長圓形；退化子房微小。雌花單生，腋生於當年生枝；花梗長 12–15 毫米；萼直徑 4–5 毫米，無毛，4 裂；花冠輻狀，徑 7 毫米，花瓣基部合生；退化雄蕊短；不育花藥箭形；子房卵形，柱頭盤狀。

items.en: Fruit globose, black, 8–9 mm in diam., stigma discoid-mammiform.
items.zh: 果球形，黑色，直徑 8–9 毫米，柱頭盤狀乳突形。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Hubei, Jiangxi, Anhui, Fujian.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、湖北、江西、安徽及福建。

photos.en: A shrub on a slope, the crown carrying a distant mass of ripe black fruit.
photos.zh: 坡上的灌木，樹冠遠處結有一片成熟的黑色果。

photos.en: Many ripe black globose fruits in the wet canopy.
photos.zh: 濕的樹冠中，許多成熟的黑色球形果。

photos.en: A cluster of green axillary buds among thick elliptic leaves, the margin crenate.
photos.zh: 厚的橢圓形葉間，一簇綠色腋生花蕾，葉緣具圓齒。

photos.en: A crown dense with flower buds, the leaves thick and crenate.
photos.zh: 樹冠密生花蕾，葉厚、具圓齒。

photos.en: An evergreen shrub on a slope, the elliptic leaves dense and a few buds scattered.
photos.zh: 坡上的常綠灌木，橢圓形葉密集，疏生花蕾。

photos.en: A multi-stemmed evergreen shrub in secondary thicket.
photos.zh: 次生灌叢中的多幹常綠灌木。

facts.en: Shrubs or trees, unarmed, 1–12 m tall.
facts.zh: 灌木或喬木, unarmed, 1–12 米.
4 月至 9 月。果期 7 月至 12 月。
灌叢和森林。

items.en: Shrubs or trees, unarmed, 1–12 m tall.
items.zh: 灌木或喬木, unarmed, 1–12 米.

items.en: Leaves papery or thinly leathery; petioles 5–18 mm; stipules broadly triangular, 3–8 mm, apex acute or acuminate, deciduous, leaf blade oblong‑elliptic, oblong‑lanceolate to lanceolate, 4–18 × 2–8 cm, base broadly cuneate or sometimes subrounded, apex acuminate to caudate‑acuminate, sometimes acute, glabrous; lateral veins slender, 3–7 on each side of midvein.
items.zh: 葉紙質或薄革質；葉柄長 5–18 毫米；托葉寬三角形，長 3–8 毫米，先端急尖或漸尖，脫落；葉片長圓狀橢圓形、長圓狀披針形至披針形，長 4–18 厘米，寬 2–8 厘米，基部寬楔形或有時近圓形，先端漸尖至尾狀漸尖，有時急尖，無毛；側脈細，每側 3–7 條。

items.en: Cymes umbel‑like, axillary, 3–5 cm in diam. Pedicels slender, 5–16 mm, glabrous. Calyx covered with appressed rusty hairs abaxially; tube turbinate, 4–6 mm; lobes 5, triangular, 1–2 mm, apex acute. Corolla salverform, white or yellow; tube 8–10 mm, glabrous abaxially, villose on the throat; lobes 5, oblong, 4–7 mm, apex acute, recurved.
items.zh: 聚傘花序傘形，腋生，直徑 3–5 厘米。花梗細，長 5–16 毫米，無毛。萼下面被貼伏的銹色毛；萼筒陀螺形，長 4–6 毫米；裂片 5，三角形，長 1–2 毫米，先端急尖。花冠高腳碟狀，白色或黃色；花冠筒長 8–10 毫米，外面無毛，喉部被長柔毛；裂片 5，長圓形，長 4–7 毫米，先端急尖，反卷。

items.en: Berry globose, 5–8 mm in diam., rusty pubescent or glabrescent.
items.zh: 漿果球形，直徑 5–8 毫米，被銹色毛或漸變無毛。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Fujian, Taiwan;  Japan, Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、雲南、福建及台灣；日本、越南。

photos.en: A flowering crown of axillary cymes, the leaves opposite.
photos.zh: 開花的樹冠，腋生聚傘花序，葉對生。

photos.en: A shrub or small tree in flower, the opposite leaves forming the crown.
photos.zh: 開花的灌木或小樹，對生葉構成樹冠。

photos.en: An axillary bud and a tiny globose young fruit on a pink stalk.
photos.zh: 腋生的花蕾，和一枚生於粉紅色柄上的細小球形幼果。

photos.en: A crown full of axillary buds, the leaves opposite and elliptic.
photos.zh: 樹冠滿布腋生花蕾，葉對生、橢圓形。

photos.en: A flowering shrub, the buds in axillary cymes among opposite elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 開花的灌木，花蕾組成腋生聚傘花序，葉對生、橢圓形。

photos.en: A crown with a few axillary flowers left among elliptic leaves.
photos.zh: 樹冠中橢圓形葉間，尚有少數腋生的花。

facts.en: Evergreen shrub, trailing or climbing, glabrous; branchlets purplish.
facts.zh: 常綠灌木，匍匐或攀援，無毛；小枝帶紫色。
5 月至 7 月。果期 7 月至 10 月。
森林。

items.en: Evergreen shrub, trailing or climbing, glabrous; branchlets purplish.
items.zh: 常綠灌木，匍匐或攀援，無毛；小枝帶紫色。

items.en: Petioles 6–7 mm; leaf blade oblong to elliptic-oblanceolate, 7–14 × 3–6 cm, base cuneate or rounded, apex acuminate or acute, margin sparsely serrate, lateral veins 5–7 on each side of midvein, veinlets closely spaced and parallel, conspicuous.
items.zh: 葉柄長 6–7 毫米；葉片長圓形至橢圓狀倒披針形，長 7–14 厘米，寬 3–6 厘米，基部楔形或圓形，先端漸尖或急尖，邊緣疏生鋸齒；側脈每側 5–7 條，細脈密而平行、明顯。

items.en: Pedicels 4–5 mm, articulate just above middle. Male flowers: calyx lobes nearly semi-orbicular, 1 mm; petals oblong, 2.5 mm, greenish, ciliate; disk cupular, shallowly lobed; stamens seated on margin of disk. Female flowers: ovary subglobose; staminodes ca. 1 mm.
items.zh: 花梗長 4–5 毫米，於中部稍上有關節。雄花：萼裂片近半圓形，長 1 毫米；花瓣長圓形，長 2.5 毫米，帶綠色，具緣毛；花盤杯狀，淺裂；雄蕊生於花盤邊緣。雌花：子房近球形；退化雄蕊長約 1 毫米。

items.en: Capsules subglobose, 7–9 × 6.5–8.5 mm, opening in 3 valves. Seeds subglobose, 5–8 mm, enclosed in orange pulpy aril.
items.zh: 蒴果近球形，長 7–9 毫米，寬 6.5–8.5 毫米，3 瓣裂。種子近球形，長 5–8 毫米，包於橙色肉質假種皮中。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Xizang, Sichuan, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Fujian; S to SE Asia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、西藏、四川、湖北、湖南、江西及福建；南亞至東南亞。

photos.en: A climber through a mixed canopy, with flower panicles and oblong leaves.
photos.zh: 穿行混交樹冠的藤本，有圓錐花序和長圓形葉。

photos.en: Green stalked buds, with the remains of a flower, beside a serrate leaf edge.
photos.zh: 具柄的綠色花蕾，留有花的殘跡，旁為具鋸齒的葉緣。

photos.en: Long stems climbing and trailing through forest scrub, with oblong leaves and flower buds.
photos.zh: 長莖在林緣灌叢中攀援、下垂，葉長圓形，有花蕾。

photos.en: Green twining stems, oblong to elliptic leaves, and many small panicles.
photos.zh: 綠色纏繞莖，葉長圓形至橢圓形，小圓錐花序多。

photos.en: The trailing base of the climber at a tree foot, among ferns.
photos.zh: 藤本在樹腳的下垂基部，生於蕨叢間。

publication.text: Hooker's J. Bot. Kew Gard. Misc. 3: 334 (1851)

facts.en: Evergreen tree; young branchlets brown, mostly glabrous.
facts.zh: 常綠喬木；幼枝褐色，多無毛。
2 月至 3 月。果期 6 月至 7 月。
山頂疏林。

items.en: Evergreen tree; young branchlets brown, mostly glabrous.
items.zh: 常綠喬木；幼枝褐色，多無毛。

items.en: Leaves thin leathery; petioles 0.5 –1 cm; leaf blade ovate, narrowly ovate, or elliptic-oblanceolate, 3.5– 8 × 1.5–3 cm, base cuneate or rounded, apex caudate-acuminate, margin slightly serrate or sinuolatedentate, glabrous; midvein adaxially impressed; lateral veins 4 – 6 on each side of midvein.
items.zh: 葉薄革質；葉柄長 0.5–1 厘米；葉片卵形、狹卵形或橢圓狀倒披針形，長 3.5–8 厘米，寬 1.5–3 厘米，基部楔形或圓形，先端尾狀漸尖，邊緣稍具鋸齒或波狀齒，無毛；中脈在上面下陷；側脈每側 4–6 條。

items.en: Racemes 2.5 – 4 cm, pubescent. Calyx 2–2.5 mm; tube glabrous; lobes 5, triangular-ovate, equal or slightly shorter than tube. Corolla white or yellow, 4 – 8 mm, divided nearly to base; lobes 5, obovate-elliptic, 3 –3.5 mm, slightly puberulent adaxially. Stamens 25–35; filaments united at base in fascicles. Ovary 3-locular; disc annular, glabrous. Drupes ovoidurceolate, 7–10 mm, apex with persistent erect calyx lobes.
items.zh: 總狀花序長 2.5–4 厘米，被毛。萼長 2–2.5 毫米；萼筒無毛；裂片 5，三角狀卵形，與萼筒等長或稍短。花冠白色或黃色，長 4–8 毫米，近基部分裂；裂片 5，倒卵狀橢圓形，長 3–3.5 毫米，上面稍被微柔毛。雄蕊 25–35；花絲基部合生成束。子房 3 室；花盤環狀，無毛。核果卵狀壇形，長 7–10 毫米，先端有宿存、直立的萼裂片。

ecology.en: Areas S of Changjiang River; Nepal, Bhutan, India.
ecology.zh: 長江以南；尼泊爾、不丹、印度。

photos.en: A flowering tree in summit scrub.
A crown massed with white flowers in summit scrub.
photos.zh: 山頂灌叢中的樹冠，開滿白花。

photos.en: A crown massed with flowers, in mist.
A domed crown packed with white flowers, the hills behind in mist.
photos.zh: 圓頂樹冠開滿白花，後方山丘在霧中。

photos.en: A domed crown dense with white flowers.

facts.zh: 喬木；樹皮灰褐色。
3 月至 4 月。果期 6 月至 10 月。
次生林、灌叢和草地。

items.en: Tree; bark grey-brown.
items.zh: 喬木；樹皮灰褐色。

items.en: Petioles 1–3 cm, inflated at both ends; leaves leathery, lanceolate or ovate-lanceolate, 5 –7 × 2.5 –3 cm, base round or obtuse, apex acute or acuminate, margin quite entire, glabrous on both surfaces.
items.zh: 葉柄長 1–3 厘米，兩端膨大；葉革質，披針形或卵狀披針形，長 5–7 厘米，寬 2.5–3 厘米，基部圓形或鈍，先端急尖或漸尖，全緣，兩面無毛。

items.en: Flowers dense; calyx campanulate, 6 mm, 5-lobed, stellate hairy abaxially; petals 5, white, spathulate, 1 cm, slightly spreading; androgynophore ca. 2 cm, with 15 anthers at apex forming a terminal head; ovary globose, 5-locular, hairy.
items.zh: 花密集；萼鐘形，長 6 毫米，5 裂，外面被星狀毛；花瓣 5，白色，匙形，長 1 厘米，稍開展；雌雄蕊柄長約 2 厘米，先端有花藥 15 枚聚成一頭狀；子房球形，5 室，被毛。

items.en: Capsules ellipsoid, pear-shaped, ca. 3 cm, 5-angulate.
items.zh: 蒴果橢圓形，梨形，長約 3 厘米，有五棱。

ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、雲南；越南、柬埔寨。

photos.en: A canopy against the sky, with an orange flush and old dark capsules.
photos.zh: 襯着天空的樹冠，新葉橙色，並有深色舊蒴果。

photos.en: A wide branch heavy with budded corymbs, and a few flowers open.
photos.zh: 寬展的枝上密生含蕾的傘房花序，少數花已開放。

photos.en: A wider view of the canopy, orange new leaves and old hanging fruits.
photos.zh: 樹冠的較寬畫面，新葉橙色，舊果下垂。

photos.en: A mass of white flowers, the stamens on long stalks, among the leaves.
photos.zh: 葉間開滿白花，雄蕊生於長柄上。

photos.en: A heavy crop of brown pear-shaped capsules on glossy foliage.
photos.zh: 光亮的葉上結滿褐色梨形蒴果。

facts.en: Tree up to 10 m tall, branchlets glabrous except the buds.
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 10 米；小枝無毛，僅芽被毛。
3 月至 5 月。果期 6 月至 11 月。

items.en: Tree up to 10 m tall, branchlets glabrous except the buds.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 10 米；小枝無毛，僅芽被毛。

items.en: Leaves papery or leathery; stipules linear, caducous; petioles 3–10 mm; leaf blade oblong-elliptic, obovate or oblong-obovate, 8–16(–23) × 3–10 cm, base broadly cuneate or cuneate, apex acute to rounded, mucronate, dark-green and shining adaxially, glabrous or slightly pubescent on midven abaxially; lateral veins 7–11 pairs.
items.zh: 葉紙質或革質；托葉線形，早落；葉柄長 3–10 毫米；葉片長圓狀橢圓形、倒卵形或長圓狀倒卵形，長 8–16（–23）厘米，寬 3–10 厘米，基部寬楔形或楔形，先端急尖至圓形、具短尖，上面深綠色而有光澤，下面中脈無毛或稍被毛；側脈 7–11 對。

items.en: Male spikes 6–17 cm, glabrous or sparsely pubescent. Male flowers: calyx cup-shaped, 3–4-lobed, lobes ovate-triangular; stamens 3– 4, ca. 2.5 mm; disk cup-shaped, entire or irregularly lobed; rudimentary ovary clavate. Female racemes 5–12(–18) cm. Female flowers: calyx and disk as in male flowers; pistils slightly longer than the sepals; ovary broad-ovoid, glabrous; styles terminal; stigma short and broad, retuse at the apex.
items.zh: 雄花序穗狀，長 6–17 厘米，無毛或疏被毛。雄花：萼杯狀，3–4 裂，裂片卵狀三角形；雄蕊 3–4，長約 2.5 毫米；花盤杯狀，全緣或不規則淺裂；退化子房棒狀。雌花序總狀，長 5–12（–18）厘米。雌花：萼和花盤同雄花；雌蕊稍長於萼片；子房寬卵形，無毛；花柱頂生；柱頭短而寬，先端微缺。

items.en: Drupes subglobose, compressed-ovoid or ellipsoidal, 8–10 × 8 mm, red to black when mature; fruiting pedicels ca. 4 mm.
items.zh: 核果近球形、壓扁的卵形或橢圓形，長 8–10 毫米，寬 8 毫米，成熟時紅色至黑色；果梗長約 4 毫米。

photos.en: A fruiting canopy at the forest edge, massed with green drupes.
photos.zh: 林緣結果的樹冠，密生綠色核果。

photos.en: A crown heavy with ripe drupes, red, pink, cream and black, above a dark trunk.
photos.zh: 樹冠結滿成熟核果，紅、粉、乳白至黑色，下為深色樹幹。

photos.en: Oblong to elliptic leaves in the canopy, alternate on woody twigs.
photos.zh: 樹冠中的長圓形至橢圓形葉，在木質小枝上互生。

photos.en: A crown against the sky, heavy with red fruit.
photos.zh: 襯着天空的樹冠，結滿紅色果。

photos.en: A dense fruiting crown, the racemes many, above a trunk.
photos.zh: 結果的濃密樹冠，總狀果序多，下為樹幹。

photos.en: A fruiting crown massed with red drupes.
photos.zh: 結果的樹冠，密生紅色核果。

facts.en: Tree 4 –20 m tall; bark dark brown.
facts.zh: 喬木，高 4–20 米；樹皮深褐色。
3 月至 5 月。果期 8 月至 11 月。
疏林。

items.en: Tree 4 –20 m tall; bark dark brown.
items.zh: 喬木，高 4–20 米；樹皮深褐色。

items.en: Leaves alternate, leathery; petioles 1–1.5 cm; leaf blade elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, 5 –15 × 2–5 cm, base cuneate, apex acuminate or acute, margin subentire, glabrous adaxially, densely greyish or brownish stellate tomentose abaxially, lateral veins 5 –12 on each side of midvein.
items.zh: 葉互生，革質；葉柄長 1–1.5 厘米；葉片橢圓形至長圓狀披針形，長 5–15 厘米，寬 2–5 厘米，基部楔形，先端漸尖或急尖，邊緣近全緣，上面無毛，下面密被灰色或褐色星狀絨毛；側脈每側 5–12 條。

items.en: Young branchlets, petioles and inflorescence densesly rusty stellate tomentose. Inflorescences terminal or axillary, racemose or paniculate, many-flowered, 6 –12 cm; pedicels 1–3 mm; flowers white, 1–1.5 cm; calyx cup-shaped, 3–5(–7) × 2– 4(–7) mm, densely grey-yellow tomentose mixed with few stellate hairs; teeth ± rudimentary, deltoid to undulate; corolla tube ca. 3 mm, lobes 4 –5, lanceolate to oblong, 8 –12 × 2–3 mm, valvate in buds; stamens 8 –10, shorter than corolla; filaments expanded, stellate pubescent on free part; anthers oblong, 3 mm; styles subequal to corolla, glabrous. Fruit ovoid-globose, 1.2–3 × 0.8–1.6 cm, densely grey to brown stellate tomentose, 3-valvate dehiscent with persistent calyx enclosing to middle.
items.zh: 幼枝、葉柄和花序密被銹色星狀絨毛。花序頂生或腋生，總狀或圓錐狀，多花，長 6–12 厘米；花梗長 1–3 毫米；花白色，直徑 1–1.5 厘米；萼杯狀，長 3–5（–7）毫米，寬 2–4（–7）毫米，密被灰黃色絨毛，並雜有少數星狀毛；齒多少不發達，三角形至波狀；花冠筒長約 3 毫米，裂片 4–5，披針形至長圓形，長 8–12 毫米，寬 2–3 毫米，花蕾時鑷合狀排列；雄蕊 8–10，短於花冠；花絲擴展，分離部分被星狀毛；花藥長圓形，長 3 毫米；花柱約與花冠等長，無毛。果卵狀球形，長 1.2–3 厘米，寬 0.8–1.6 厘米，密被灰色至褐色星狀絨毛，3 瓣裂，宿萼包至中部。

items.en: Seeds 1–2, ellipsoid, brown, smooth or rugose, glabrous or scale-like pubescent.
items.zh: 種子 1–2 顆，橢圓形，褐色，平滑或有皺，無毛或被鱗片狀毛。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, Taiwan; Myanmar, Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、四川、湖北、湖南、江西、安徽、江蘇、浙江、福建及台灣；緬甸、越南。

photos.en: A single-trunked tree, the bark dark and fissured, the crown elliptic-leaved.
photos.zh: 單幹的樹，樹皮深色縱裂，樹冠葉橢圓形。

photos.en: Several pale hairy globose fruits, the leaf undersides pale.
photos.zh: 數枚淺色被毛的球形果，葉背淺色。

photos.en: A white flower with yellow stamens, the elliptic leaves pale underneath.
photos.zh: 白花，雄蕊黃色，橢圓形葉背面淺色。

photos.en: A young tree, tall and slender, the crown still narrow.
A flowering branch of white flowers on a hillside.
A canopy dense with tan hairy globose fruits.
photos.zh: 樹冠密生黃褐色被毛的球形果。

facts.en: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–5 m tall; branchlets minutely greyish pubescent to glabrous, with brownish red orbicular lenticels.
facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1.5–5 米；小枝被灰色微柔毛至無毛，有紅褐色圓形皮孔。
6 月至 8 月。果期 9 月至 11 月。
森林。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–5 m tall; branchlets minutely greyish pubescent to glabrous, with brownish red orbicular lenticels.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1.5–5 米；小枝被灰色微柔毛至無毛，有紅褐色圓形皮孔。

items.en: Leaves 20–25 cm including the petiole; rachis not winged; leaflets 9–17, shortly petiolulate or sessile; blade ovate-lanceolate or lanceolate, 5–9.5 × 2–3.5 cm, base oblique, apex acuminate to caudate, margin entire to sparsely serrate, slightly revolute, grey tomentose along midvein adaxially, densely white tomentose abaxially; lateral veins dense, 15–20 on each side of midvein, midvein and lateral veins slightly impressed adaxially, prominent abaxially.
items.zh: 葉連葉柄長 20–25 厘米；葉軸無翅；小葉 9–17 枚，具短小葉柄或無柄；葉片卵狀披針形或披針形，長 5–9.5 厘米，寬 2–3.5 厘米，基部偏斜，先端漸尖至尾尖，全緣至疏生鋸齒，稍反卷，上面沿中脈被灰色絨毛，下面密被白色絨毛；側脈密，每側 15–20 條，中脈和側脈在上面稍下陷、在下面隆起。

items.en: Inflorescence to 20 cm, greyish yellow tomentose; peduncles very short; pedicels 1–2 mm, greyish yellow tomentose. Calyx lobes 0.5 mm, minutely pubescent. Petals white, obovate-oblong, ca. 2 mm. Ovary globose, densely white hairy.
items.zh: 花序長可達 20 厘米，被灰黃色絨毛；花序梗極短；花梗長 1–2 毫米，被灰黃色絨毛。萼裂片長 0.5 毫米，被微柔毛。花瓣白色，倒卵狀長圓形，長約 2 毫米。子房球形，密被白色毛。

items.en: Drupe ca. 4 mm in diam., red glandular-pubescent.
items.zh: 核果直徑約 4 毫米，被紅色腺毛。

photos.en: A cream panicle among pinnate leaves in scrub.
photos.zh: 灌叢中的乳白色圓錐花序，葉羽狀。

photos.en: A crown massed with white panicles, the leaves pinnate.
photos.zh: 樹冠開滿白色圓錐花序，葉羽狀。

photos.en: A fruiting branch above a valley.
A cream panicle and odd-pinnate leaves in scrub.
photos.zh: 灌叢中的乳白色圓錐花序和奇數羽狀複葉。

photos.en: Massed cream panicles in a mixed forest canopy.

facts.en: Deciduous tree, 7–20 m tall; branchlets ± robust, dark purplish brown, glabrous, lenticellate.
facts.zh: 落葉喬木，高 7–20 米；小枝較粗壯，暗紫褐色，無毛，有皮孔。
3 月至 4 月。果期 7 月至 10 月。
森林。

items.en: Deciduous tree, 7–20 m tall; branchlets ± robust, dark purplish brown, glabrous, lenticellate.
items.zh: 落葉喬木，高 7–20 米；小枝較粗壯，暗紫褐色，無毛，有皮孔。

items.en: Leaves 20–25 cm including the petiole; rachis puberulous; petioles inflated at base, puberulous; leaflets 7–15, opposite or alternate; petiolules 0.5–1.2 cm, glabrous to puberulous; blade papery, ovate to lanceolate, 4–12 × 2–4.5 cm, base ± oblique, broadly cuneate to rounded, apex long-acuminate, entire or serrate at the base, puberulous or subglabrous on both surfaces, or with tufts of hair in the axils of veins abaxially; lateral veins 8–10 on each side of midvein, prominent on both surfaces.
items.zh: 葉連葉柄長 20–25 厘米；葉軸被微柔毛；葉柄基部膨大，被微柔毛；小葉 7–15 枚，對生或互生；小葉柄長 0.5–1.2 厘米，無毛至被微柔毛；葉片紙質，卵形至披針形，長 4–12 厘米，寬 2–4.5 厘米，基部多少偏斜，寬楔形至圓形，先端長漸尖，全緣或基部有鋸齒，兩面被微柔毛或近無毛，或下面脈腋有簇毛；側脈每側 8–10 條，兩面隆起。

items.en: Male inflorescences 4–10 cm, minutely pubescent to glabrous. Calyx minutely pubescent to glabrous; lobes triangular, ca. 1 mm. Petals purple, oblong-lanceolate, 2.5–3 mm. Stamens exserted. Female flower solitary in axils of distal leaves, larger than male flowers. Ovary ca. 1.5 mm, 5-locular.
items.zh: 雄花序長 4–10 厘米，被微柔毛至無毛。萼被微柔毛至無毛；裂片三角形，長約 1 毫米。花瓣紫色，長圓狀披針形，長 2.5–3 毫米。雄蕊伸出。雌花單生於上部葉腋，比雄花大。子房長約 1.5 毫米，5 室。

items.en: Drupe ellipsoidal or ovoid, yellow at maturity, 2.5–3 × 2 cm, rounded at both ends.
items.zh: 核果橢圓形或卵形，成熟時黃色，長 2.5–3 厘米，寬 2 厘米，兩端圓。

ecology.en: S & SW China; S Japan, NE India, Myanmar, Vietnam, Laos and Thailand.
ecology.zh: 華南及西南；日本南部、印度東北部、緬甸、越南、老撾及泰國。

photos.en: Odd-pinnate leaves, with a distant male inflorescence, on a trail.
photos.zh: 奇數羽狀複葉，遠處有雄花序，位於小徑旁。

photos.en: A male panicle of small purple-brown flowers, the anthers yellow.
photos.zh: 雄性圓錐花序，小花紫褐色，花藥黃色。

photos.en: A few green drupes on wet odd-pinnate leaves, on a hill.
photos.zh: 山坡上，濕的奇數羽狀複葉間有少數綠色核果。

photos.en: A trunk with brown fissured bark, and a crown of pinnate leaves.
photos.zh: 樹幹樹皮褐色縱裂，樹冠為羽狀複葉。

photos.en: A deciduous tree, the crown odd-pinnate.
photos.zh: 落葉樹，樹冠為奇數羽狀複葉。

photos.en: A canopy of odd-pinnate leaves, the leaflets ovate-lanceolate, in hill forest.
photos.zh: 山坡林中的樹冠，奇數羽狀複葉，小葉卵狀披針形。

facts.en: Shrub or tree, 4 –15 m tall, glabrous except bracteoles and sepals.
facts.zh: 灌木或喬木，高 4–15 米，除小苞片和萼片外無毛。
4 月至 6 月。果期 10 月至 11 月。
灌叢和森林。

items.en: Shrub or tree, 4 –15 m tall, glabrous except bracteoles and sepals.
items.zh: 灌木或喬木，高 4–15 米，除小苞片和萼片外無毛。

items.en: Petioles 1–1.5 cm, grooved adaxially; leaf blade ovate, ovate-oblong or oblong–-lanceolate, 4–9 × 2– 5 cm, leathery, base rounded to broadly cuneate, apex caudate, margin entire and slightly revolute, dark green adaxially, pale green abaxially, lateral veins 6 – 8 pairs.
items.zh: 葉柄長 1–1.5 厘米，上面有溝；葉片卵形、卵狀長圓形或長圓狀披針形，長 4–9 厘米，寬 2–5 厘米，革質，基部圓形至寬楔形，先端尾尖，全緣並稍反卷，上面深綠色，下面淺綠色；側脈 6–8 對。

items.en: Pedicels ca. 0.5 mm; bracteoles triangular, 1–1.5 mm, sparsely white puberulous adaxially, margin ciliolate. Petals white, oblong-lanceolate to oblanceolate, 4– 5 × 1.5 –2 mm, apex retuse to 2-cleft; filaments oblong, petaloid, 2.5 –3.5 mm; anthers globose, ca. 0.5 mm in diam. Ovary ca. 1 mm long; style columnar, ca. 2 mm, 5-ridged.
items.zh: 花梗長約 0.5 毫米；小苞片三角形，長 1–1.5 毫米，上面疏被白色微柔毛，邊緣有細緣毛。花瓣白色，長圓狀披針形至倒披針形，長 4–5 毫米，寬 1.5–2 毫米，先端微缺至 2 裂；花絲長圓形，花瓣狀，長 2.5–3.5 毫米；花藥球形，直徑約 0.5 毫米。子房長約 1 毫米；花柱柱狀，長約 2 毫米，有 5 棱。

items.en: Capsule ellipsoid, 6–9 × 4 – 5 mm, purplish brown to dark brown, dehiscing into 5-valves when mature. Seeds reddish brown, 5 – 6 mm long, apex very compressed or winged.
items.zh: 蒴果橢圓形，長 6–9 毫米，寬 4–5 毫米，紫褐色至深褐色，成熟時 5 瓣裂。種子紅褐色，長 5–6 毫米，先端極壓扁或有翅。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Hunan, Jiangxi, Fujian; Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、湖南、江西及福建；越南、馬來西亞、印度尼西亞。

photos.en: A trunk and crown with scattered white racemes, the bark grey-brown.
photos.zh: 樹幹和樹冠，疏生白色總狀花序，樹皮灰褐色。

photos.en: The main trunk, grey-brown and mottled with lichen, and flowers in the crown.
photos.zh: 主幹灰褐色，有地衣斑，樹冠中有花。

photos.en: A wide crown, with a pink flush among glossy green leaves.
photos.zh: 寬展的樹冠，光亮綠葉間有粉紅色新梢。

photos.en: A shrub in a thicket, the new leaves pink-red among dark green mature foliage.
photos.zh: 灌叢中的灌木，深綠色老葉間有粉紅的新葉。

facts.zh: 喬木 to 25 米.
3 月至 4 月。果期 9 月至 10 月。
常綠闊葉林。

items.en: Tree to 25 m tall.
items.zh: 喬木 to 25 米.

items.en: Petioles slender, 1–2.5 cm; leaf blade oblong or lanceolate, 5–7(–10) × 2–2.5(–4) cm, thin leathery, base broadly cuneate or obtuse, apex acute or acuminate, margin crenate, glabrous; lateral veins 8–10 pairs, reticulation of veins conspicuous when dry.
items.zh: 葉柄細，長 1–2.5 厘米；葉片長圓形或披針形，長 5–7（–10）厘米，寬 2–2.5（–4）厘米，薄革質，基部寬楔形或鈍，先端急尖或漸尖，邊緣具圓齒，無毛；側脈 8–10 對，乾後網脈明顯。

items.en: Racemes axillary, 3–5 cm; peduncles silvery grey-white pubescent, 4 –7-flowered. Pedicels 7–9 mm. Petals 5, as long as sepals, oblong, 7–8 × ca. 2.5 mm, grey-white-pubescent on both surfaces, distal 1/3 laciniate; segments 9–11. Stamens 20 –23; anthers ca. 3.5 mm, with awns (ca. 1.5 mm) at apex. Ovary 3-locular, pubescent; style ca. 5 mm.
items.zh: 總狀花序腋生，長 3–5 厘米；花序梗被銀白色短柔毛，有花 4–7 朵。花梗長 7–9 毫米。花瓣 5，與萼片等長，長圓形，長 7–8 毫米，寬約 2.5 毫米，兩面被灰白色短柔毛，上部三分之一條裂；裂片 9–11。雄蕊 20–23；花藥長約 3.5 毫米，先端有芒，芒長約 1.5 毫米。子房 3 室，被毛；花柱長約 5 毫米。

items.en: Drupe ellipsoid, 1–1.3 cm, glabrous; endocarp bony, with 3 ventral sutures.
items.zh: 核果橢圓形，長 1–1.3 厘米，無毛；內果皮骨質，腹縫線 3 條。

ecology.zh: 廣東、海南、廣西、雲南；越南。

photos.en: The top of a tree in mass flower, against a foggy sky, the leaves oblong.
photos.zh: 樹頂盛花，襯着霧天，葉長圓形。

photos.en: Glossy oblong leaves in the canopy, with a few scattered racemes.
photos.zh: 樹冠中光亮的長圓形葉，間有疏生的總狀花序。

photos.en: A crown seen from below, in flower, against the sky.
photos.zh: 自下仰視開花的樹冠，襯着天空。

photos.en: A roadside tree, still in leaf, at the edge of evergreen forest.
photos.zh: 路旁的樹，葉仍在，位於常綠林緣。

photos.en: A full tree along a path, the crown evergreen.

photos.zh: 草地中的幼樹，頂枝高而直。

facts.zh: 小喬木, 5 –15 米.
6 月至 7 月。果期 9 月至 11 月。
常綠闊葉林。

items.en: Small tree, 5 –15 m tall.
items.zh: 小喬木, 5 –15 米.

items.en: Petioles ca. 1 cm; leaf blade oblanceolate, 7–12 × 2– 4 cm, leathery, base attenuate, apex acuminate, tip blunt, margin serrulate, glabrous on both surfaces; lateral veins 7–9 pairs.
items.zh: 葉柄長約 1 厘米；葉片倒披針形，長 7–12 厘米，寬 2–4 厘米，革質，基部漸狹，先端漸尖，尖頭鈍，邊緣具細鋸齒，兩面無毛；側脈 7–9 對。

items.en: Racemes 5 –10 cm, puberulous; peduncles slender; pedicels 4 – 5 mm. Flowers bisexual. Petals 5, white, obovate, as long as sepals, puberulous near base adaxially, glabrous abaxially, laciniate on distal half; segments 10 –16. Stamens 25 –30, anthers without appendage at apex. Ovary 3-locular, tomentose; ovules 2 per locule.
items.zh: 總狀花序長 5–10 厘米，被微柔毛；花序梗細；花梗長 4–5 毫米。花兩性。花瓣 5，白色，倒卵形，與萼片等長，上面近基部被微柔毛，下面無毛，上半部條裂；裂片 10–16。雄蕊 25–30，花藥先端無附屬物。子房 3 室，被絨毛；每室胚珠 2。

items.en: Drupe ellipsoid, 1-locular, 2–3 cm; exocarp glabrous; endocarp bony, with many ventral sutures; seed 1, ca. 1.5 cm.
items.zh: 核果橢圓形，1 室，長 2–3 厘米；外果皮無毛；內果皮骨質，腹縫線多條；種子 1 顆，長約 1.5 厘米。

ecology.en: Taiwan, Fujian, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Hunan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan; Japan, Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 台灣、福建、浙江、江西、湖南、廣東、廣西、貴州及雲南；日本、越南。

photos.en: A canopy with a red flush of old leaves and a cluster of fruit.
photos.zh: 樹冠中有變紅的老葉，並有一簇果。

photos.en: Three young green drupes among oblanceolate leaves.
photos.zh: 倒披針形葉間的三枚幼嫩青核果。

photos.en: A whorl of leaves at the tip, with a cluster of fruit.
photos.zh: 枝端輪生的葉，旁有一簇果。

photos.en: A single drupe beside a whorl of leaves at the tip.
photos.zh: 枝端輪生葉旁的一枚核果。

facts.en: Evergreen small tree or shrub, 4 – 12 m tall; branchlets brown, glabrous or ± pubescent, sparsely leticellate; winter buds ovoid, with several ciliate scales.
facts.zh: 常綠小喬木或灌木，高 4–12 米；小枝褐色，無毛或多少被毛，疏生皮孔；冬芽卵形，鱗片數枚、具緣毛。
3 月至 5 月。果期 4 月至 11 月。
森林和開曠地。

items.en: Evergreen small tree or shrub, 4 – 12 m tall; branchlets brown, glabrous or ± pubescent, sparsely leticellate; winter buds ovoid, with several ciliate scales.
items.zh: 常綠小喬木或灌木，高 4–12 米；小枝褐色，無毛或多少被毛，疏生皮孔；冬芽卵形，鱗片數枚、具緣毛。

items.en: Petioles 0.3 – 1 cm, glabrous, eglandular; stipules lanceolate, glabrous, caducous; leaf blade leathery, narrowly elliptic, oblong or oblong-lanceolate, rarely obovate-oblong, 6 – 12 × 2 – 4 cm, base cuneate, broadly cuneate or nearly rounded, with 2 large flat glands near the base, apex caudate or acuminate, margin entire, glabrous on both surfaces, abaxially densely black glandular punctate, lateral veins 6–10 on each side of midvein.
items.zh: 葉柄長 0.3–1 厘米，無毛，無腺；托葉披針形，無毛，早落；葉片革質，狹橢圓形、長圓形或長圓狀披針形，稀倒卵狀長圓形，長 6–12 厘米，寬 2–4 厘米，基部楔形、寬楔形或近圓形，近基部有大而扁平的腺體 2 枚，先端尾尖或漸尖，全緣，兩面無毛，下面密生黑色腺點；側脈每側 6–10 條。

items.en: Racemes axillary, solitary, several– 10-flowered, 2.5–7 cm, glabrous or sparsely pubescent; pedicels 3–5 mm; sepals 5, ovate-triangular, 1– 2 mm, apex obtuse, margin serrate and ciliate; petals 5, white, suborbicular, 2 –3 × 2–3 mm, glabrous; stamens 20–35, 5 – 6 mm; ovary glabrous or subglabrous, styles ca. 5 mm.
items.zh: 總狀花序腋生，單生，有花數朵至 10 朵，長 2.5–7 厘米，無毛或疏被毛；花梗長 3–5 毫米；萼片 5，卵狀三角形，長 1–2 毫米，先端鈍，邊緣有鋸齒並具緣毛；花瓣 5，白色，近圓形，長 2–3 毫米，寬 2–3 毫米，無毛；雄蕊 20–35，長 5–6 毫米；子房無毛或近無毛，花柱長約 5 毫米。

items.en: Drupe purplish black, subglobose or ellipsoidal, ca. 1 cm in diam., glabrous; stone smooth.
items.zh: 核果紫黑色，近球形或橢圓形，直徑約 1 厘米，無毛；核平滑。

ecology.en: Yunnan, Guizhou, Guangxi, Guangdong, Hunan, Jiangxi, Fujian, Zhejiang, Taiwan; Japan, India, Myanmar, Bangladesh, Thailand, Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 雲南、貴州、廣西、廣東、湖南、江西、福建、浙江及台灣；日本、印度、緬甸、孟加拉、泰國、越南。

photos.en: A flowering shrub on wet rock, the leaves still on the shoots.
photos.zh: 濕石上開花的灌木，枝上仍有葉。

photos.en: A flowering branch, the axis brown, with axillary racemes.
photos.zh: 花枝，軸褐色，葉腋生總狀花序。

photos.en: Immature green drupes on the racemes, among oblong-lanceolate leaves.
photos.zh: 總狀果序上的幼嫩青核果，葉長圓狀披針形。

photos.en: White axillary racemes, with narrowly elliptic entire leaves and a few buds.
photos.zh: 白色腋生總狀花序，葉狹橢圓形、全緣，間有花蕾。

photos.en: A tree on a cliff, the crown covered in white racemes.
photos.zh: 崖上的樹，樹冠覆滿白色總狀花序。

photos.en: A small flowering tree, white racemes over lanceolate evergreen leaves.
photos.zh: 開花的小樹，白色總狀花序生於披針形常綠葉之上。
